'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AP-M) is a [[.366 TKM|.366 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .366 TKM (9.55x39mm) AP-M cartridge loaded with an 16 gram armor-piercing bullet from a 9x39mm SP-6 gs cartridge, composed of a hardened carbon steel core with a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a modified steel case. This ingeniously improvised cartridge was created by Mechanic due to the precarious situation of its customers in Tarkov, resulting in a cartridge that can pierce through basic and intermediate ballistic body protection, as well as providing a considerable stopping power effect, however, its own design alters its flight pattern, making it less accurate. Its design also allows it to be used in 7.62x39mm AK magazines without any problem.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (UCW) is a [[.338 Lapua Magnum|.338 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .338 Lapua Magnum (8.6x70mm) UCW cartridge with a 16.2 gram lead core bullet with a brass jacket; intended for hunting and target practice, produced by Ulyanovsk Cartridge Works. This cartridge is intended for Big Game Hunting, as despite rudimentary design, it has an outstanding stopping power effect and is capable of causing severe adverse effects on the target after impact and can even pierce basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AP) is a [[.338 Lapua Magnum|.338 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .338 Lapua Magnum (8.6x70mm) AP cartridge with a two-part armor-piercing projectile of 15.4 grams, the bullet consists of a sabot and tungsten carbide penetrator body, in a brass case. This cartridge was designed to increase, in a limited way, the anti-materiel capabilities of the .338 Lapua Magnum caliber rifles, managing to pierce through light armored vehicles not to mention its excellent results against the modern specialized ballistic body protections as well as having a considerable stopping power effect and be able to inflict devastating adverse effects on the target after impact. However, due to its design, it has a significant probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TAC-X) is a [[.338 Lapua Magnum|.338 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .338 Lapua Magnum (8.6x70mm) TAC-X cartridge with a 18.4 gram expansive bullet made entirely of copper in a brass case. The bullet of this cartridge provides a good impact grouping at long distances and is designed to be used in Big Game Hunting, as it has a superior stopping power effect for its caliber and is capable of causing critical adverse effects on the target. After impact, however, despite the high energy of the .338 Lapua Magnum caliber and due to the TAC-X bullet design, it has difficulties of piercing basic ballistic body protections and has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Whisper) is a [[.300 Blackout|.300 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Whisper cartridge is a lightweight, hyper velocity design using an aluminum core and pre-stressed jacket. The aluminum core initiates the expansion slightly after contact, pressing back into the pre-stressed jacket and activating a violent, incapacitating energy transfer. The cartridge is ideal for close fire contacts of unarmored and/or lightly armored targets. Not to be mistaken for .300 Blackout, since Whisper was developed almost 20 years before it.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Trivia==
* This round is based on the "[http://web.archive.org/web/20160321064034/http://www.lehighdefense.com/collections/cq/products/308-78gr-cq-bullet Close Quarters 78gr Bullet]" from Lehigh Defense.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (V-Max) is a [[.300 Blackout|.300 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) V-Max cartridge with a 7.1 gram lead core polymer tipped expansive bullet with a copper metal jacket, in a brass case. This bullet features a ballistic tip that improves its accuracy and acts as a wedge on the lead core upon impact, allowing the bullet to expand and cause considerable damage on the target. Despite the peculiarity of its design, it is able to pierce basic ballistic body protections. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any issues.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M62) is a [[.300 Blackout|.300 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .300 Blackout (7.62x35mm) M62 Tracer cartridge loaded with a 9.2 gram tracer bullet from a 7.62x51mm NATO M62 cartridge, composed of a lead-antimony alloy core with a bimetallic jacket, in a brass case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). Despite the bullet's own characteristics when used in a full-power cartridge, these are affected when transferred to an intermediate cartridge, still, the bullet continues to have capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models. Hoever, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces. Its design also allows it to be used in STANAG 5.56x45mm NATO magazines without any issues.

==Notes==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Negotiation) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

* In [[Jacket]]s

In the middle office inside the Zmeisky 6 building at [[Streets of Tarkov]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' ("The Eye") is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A special device that utilizes a whole network of detectors, communication systems and satellites. Mechanic built it from the blueprints of a certain someone named Mr. Kerman. Although the device doesn't allow you to connect to digital maps of the area, it can warn you of an impending mortar attack.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
* While a player has the device equipped, there is a notification in the bottom right corner of the screen when a mortar fire barrage happens. When it's near a major landmark, the location is also mentioned.
:[[File:TheEyeNotification.png]]
* The device vibrates (sound indicator) when a mortar fire barrage is very close. This can also be heard by other players.
:[[File:TheEyeMortarStrikeNotification.wav|282px]]
* This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[A Helping Hand]]

==Trivia==
* This item was first introduced in the [[Events#Mortar_Strike_(26_September_2024)|Mortar Strike]] event

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (LOKT) is an ammo box type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A pack of [[.308 ME LOKT]] ammo, 20 rounds.

==Trivia==
* Horny Ammunition is a play on Hornady Ammunition.
*''LVR Advance with Tip Safe Technology'' is a fictional stand-in for Hornady's ''LEVERrevolution with Flex Tip Technology''. It is a pointed bullet with an elastic polymer tip to allow it to be loaded in a tubular-magazine rifle - like most lever actions and some bolt actions - safely and reliably. Otherwise a pointed bullet with a metal-tip might set off the primer of the cartridge ahead of it.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PS12) is a [[12.7x55mm|12.7x55mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 12.7x55mm PS12 special cartridge with a 33 gram subsonic heavy bullet with a lead core and a bimetallic jacket, in a brass case. This cartridge was designed in the early 2010s for the ASh-12 assault rifle and despite its rudimentary design, the bullet is capable of piercing basic ballistic body protections, in addition to providing a considerable stopping power effect and being able to inflict severe adverse effects on the target after impact. However, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PS12A) is a [[12.7x55mm|12.7x55mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 12.7x55mm PS12A special cartridge with a 7 gram lightweight bullet with an aluminum core and two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior, and a bimetallic exterior, in a brass case. The bullet in this cartridge was designed to crumble and rapidly lose speed when hitting a solid object in order to reduce the probability of ricochets during urban operations at the cost of penetration capabilities, consequently, this endows it with an outstanding stopping power effect thanks to its caliber and capability to inflict critical adverse effects on the target after impact.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RIP) is a [[.45 ACP|.45 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
.45 ACP (11.43x23mm) RIP (Radically Invasive Projectile) is a cartridge with a 10.5 gram frangible bullet designed to produce multiple wound channels to incapacitate assailants quickly. In a departure from conventional hollow-point design, the "R.I.P." round features 8 machined lead-free copper petals, designed to fragment quickly and move in multiple directions, thus providing a superior stopping power effect of its caliber, in addition to being able to inflict severe adverse effects on the target after impact.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Piranha) is a [[12/70|12/70 ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This 12 gauge round contains dozens of razor sharp steel tacks that blast out at high velocity which virtually guarantees that there will be no response from the perpetrator. Each round is buffed with #12 shot thus creating a double shock to the wound area. Absolutely will not harm your shotgun. To be used no closer than 10 feet and no further than 50 feet.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (3-(b-TG)) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Combat drug. It has a stimulating effect on the Central nervous system. Increases perception and attention. It can slightly improve strength indicators, due to more powerful signals to the muscles. The active substance is 3-(b-Phenylisopropyl)-sydnonimine hydrochloride. Allowed for use only by military doctors and paramedics.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Samples]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Sanitar]] and his guards
*Medical [[Airdrop crate|Airdrops]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[This Tape Sucks]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Zvezda) is a [[23x75mm‎R|23x75mm‎ ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 23x75 mmR "Zvezda" ("Star") flash-bang grenade cartridge made for psychological effect on the enemy.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* When fired, [[File:contusion.png|46px|Concussion]] is added to the shooter for 7 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio
* When fired, shooter-facing entities in a 160° cone in front of the barrel receive [[File:Stun.png|46px|Stun]] for 20 seconds, causing a blinding effect that starts to fade out after 10 seconds, as well as a visual impairment which lasts 90 seconds
* Within a 10m radius around the shooter, [[File:contusion.png|46px|Concussion]] is added to entities for 15 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Green) is a [[26x75mm|26x75mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 26x75mm green flare cartridge for the SP-81 flare gun.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Unlike the [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Red)|Red Flare Cartridge]], this one does not call in an [[airdrop]].
* Required for the "Klimov Street" extraction on [[Streets of Tarkov]]
* Required for the "Mira Ave" extraction on [[Ground Zero]].
* Required for the "Power Line Passage" extraction on [[Woods]].
* Required for the "Railroad Passage" extraction on [[Customs]].
* Required for the "Path to River" extraction on [[Interchange]].
* Required for the "Helicopter" extraction on [[Icebreaker]].
* Firing this flare will illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition

[[File:pistolflare green.png|400px]]

==Usage==
To open a flare extraction, shoot the flare into the sky while being inside the respective signal flare area. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. Only one person amongst a lobby-made group needs to shoot a flare to open the extraction for all members of the group.

Upon entering a signal flare area, a notification pops up in the bottom right corner of the screen: [[File:KlimovStreetSignalAreaNote.png]].

If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: [[File:FlareSuccessNote.png]].

*[[Weapon box (4x4)]]
*[[Wooden ammo box]]
*[[Wooden crate]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AG) is a [[26x75mm|26x75mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 26x75mm acid green flare cartridge for the SP-81 flare gun. The unusual color indicates that the cartridge is used for some special signals to "friendlies". Worth trying to and use it to save yourself when near aggressive Scavs and Bosses.

==Notes==
* Cannot be taken into a raid.
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Unlike the [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Red)|Red Flare Cartridge]], this one does not call in an [[airdrop]].
* Firing this flare '''into the sky''' will make [[Scavs]], as well as [[Bosses]] from the [[Rogues]] and [[Scavs]] faction in the area friendly until you shoot them. Leaving the area will allow you to be targeted again.
* Firing this flare will illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition

[[File:pistolflare green.png|400px]]

==Location==
* [[Cultists]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* [[Wooden ammo box]]
* [[Wooden crate]]

===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

==Trivia==
* This flare was first added as part of Escape from Tarkov's 2022 Halloween celebration

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (2A2-(b-TG)) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
TerraGroup's next development after the 3-(b-TG) stimulant. The goal of the project was to obtain a drug that would give an advantage in reconnaissance and crossing combat zones far away from supply points. At the same time, the drug is required to be manufacturable in handicraft conditions. The obtained substance allows to keep the CNS in tone for a long period of time, which positively affects the fighter's efficiency to assess the environment, and also enhances their ability to carry equipment. The stimulant’s effective duration is accompanied by increased loss of hydration.

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*Medical [[Airdrop crate|Airdrops]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm BP gs (GRAU Index - 7N22) cartridge with a 3.7 gram armor-piercing bullet with a hardened carbon steel core with lead cladding on the tip and bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. This BP bullet (Broneboynaya Pulya; "Armor-piercing Bullet") was developed by TsNIITOCHMASH in 1998 based on the 5.45x39mm PP gs cartridge to improve its design and penetration capabilities, resulting in an improvement at piercing some intermediate models of body ballistic protection, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability off various surfaces.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (BS) is a [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm BS gs (GRAU Index - 7N24) cartridge with a 4.1 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed tungsten carbide core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. This BS bullet (Broneboynyy Serdechnik - "Armor-piercing Core") was developed by TsNIITochMash in 1998 to greatly increase the penetration capabilities of Russian 5.45x39mm caliber weapons, by being able to pierce basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition to provide outstanding results against some specialized protection models, despite having a relatively low muzzle velocity compared to other cartridges. However, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm PS gs (GRAU Index - 7N6) cartridge with a 3.4 gram steel core bullet with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. The PS cartridge (Púlya so Stal'ným serdéchnikom - "Bullet with a Steel Core") was introduced into service in 1974 alongside with Soviet 5.45x39mm caliber weaponry, providing the Soviet Army with capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Action SX) is a [[4.6x30mm HK|4.6x30mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 4.6x30mm HK Action SX cartridge with a 2 gram hollow-point bullet made entirely of brass, in a brass case. This cartridge is designed to effectively incapacitate an aggressor during close-quarters operations thanks to its considerable stopping power effect, in addition to preventing over-piercing, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AP SX) is a [[4.6x30mm HK|4.6x30mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 4.6x30mm HK AP SX cartridge with a 2 gram copper-plated steel core armor-piercing bullet in a brass case. The AP SX cartridge provides the highest penetration capability of the 4.6x30mm caliber, allowing the shooter to pierce basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition to providing outstanding results against some specialized protection models, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Subsonic SX) is a [[4.6x30mm HK|4.6x30mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 4.6x30mm HK Subsonic SX cartridge with a 5 gram copper-plated tungsten alloy core subsonic bullet in a brass case with a reduced charge. The powder load in this subsonic cartridge is adjusted to operate with the MP7 family of submachine guns, ensuring the weapon's fire cycling and achieving excellent noise reduction when used in conjunction with a suppressor. Despite its low muzzle velocity, the bullet has ballistic capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections and provides excellent results against intermediate protection models, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PPBS) is a [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm PPBS gs (GRAU Index - 7N39) cartridge with a 4 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed tungsten carbide core with two-layer jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a steel case. This experimental cartridge was developed by TsNIITochMash and TechKomplekt under the name of PPBS (Povyshennoy Probivayemosti, Broneboynyy Serdechnik - "Increased Penetration, Armor-Piercing Core") "Ilgólnik" ("Needlecase") based on the 5.45x39mm BS gs cartridge to increase its penetration capabilities, providing excellent results against the most modern specialized ballistic body protections, in addition to being capable of piercing light covers and light armored vehicles, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (7N40) is a [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The newest legendary 5.45x39mm 7N40 cartridge with a 4.2 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed hardened carbon steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. Made as part of the Ratnik program together with 7N39 PPBS "Igolnik". It is capable of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability on various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SP) is a [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm cartridge with a 3.6 gram lead core soft-point (SP) bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket in a steel case, intended for hunting, home defense, and target practice. This bullet has a good initial expansion on impact due to the exposure of the lead core at the tip, giving it considerable stopping power effects at the cost of penetration capabilities, even against basic ballistic protection, as well as being able to cause substantial adverse effects on the target after impact.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (T) is a [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm T gs (GRAU Index - 7T3) cartridge with a 3.2 gram lead core tracer bullet with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). This T cartridge (Trassíruyushchaya - "Tracer") was introduced in 1974 alongside with the PS gs cartridge (GRAU Index - 7N6) to provide tracing capabilities to Soviet 5.45x39mm caliber weaponry, as well as being able of piercing basic ballistic body protection, besides having significant stopping power effect. However, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (US gs) is a [[5.45x39mm|5.45x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.45x39mm US gs (GRAU Index - 7U1) cartridge with a 5.1 gram subsonic bullet with a pointed tungsten carbide core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case with a reduced charge. This US cartridge (Umén'shennoy Skórosti - "Reduced Speed") was designed by TsNIITochMash in the mid-1980s for use in the AKS-74UB and AKS-74UBN models in conjunction with a suppressor, ensuring the weapon's fire cycling and achieving an excellent noise reduction in addition to granting a considerable stopping power effect, but despite the composition of the bullet, it has difficulties piercing basic ballistic body protections and due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M855) is a [[5.56x45mm NATO|5.56x45mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.56x45mm NATO M855 cartridge with a 4 gram bullet with a steel penetrator tip over a lead core with a copper jacket in a brass case. This cartridge was designed in the 1980s as the equivalent to the FN SS109 cartridge for the 5.56x45mm NATO caliber armament used by the United States Army. Thanks to its design, the bullet in this cartridge is capable of piercing through basic ballistic protection equipment, as well as certain intermediate protection equipment, however, it has a high probability of rebound on various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M856) is a [[5.56x45mm NATO|5.56x45mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.56x45mm NATO M856 cartridge with a 4.1 gram lead core tracer bullet with a copper jacket, in a brass case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Red). This cartridge was designed in the 1980s to provide tracing capabilities to the 5.56x45mm NATO caliber weaponry used by the United States Army when used in conjunction with the M855 cartridge. Despite not having a steel penetrator tip, compared to the M855, the bullet in this cartridge is capable of piercing basic ballistic body protections, it has a high probability of rebound on various surfaces.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Warmageddon) is a [[5.56x45mm NATO|5.56x45mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A .223 Remington (5.56x45mm) Warmageddon cartridge with a 3.6 gram lead core polymer tipped expansive bullet with a copper alloy jacket in a brass case; intended for hunting. This bullet features a ballistic tip that acts as a wedge on the lead core upon impact, allowing the bullet to expand and cause outstanding damage on the target, as well as being capable of causing severe adverse effects to the target upon impact, despite not having the full energy of an intermediate cartridge.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

== Trivia ==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: 5.56x45mm Warmageddon is based off "[https://www.nosler.com/products/ammunition/product-line/varmageddonr.html Nosler's Varmageddon 223 Rem Varmint ammunition]" this particular one is 55 grain FB (Flat Base) Tipped.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SB193) is a [[5.7x28mm FN|5.7x28mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.7x28mm FN SB193 cartridge with a 4 gram lead core subsonic bullet with a reinforced copper jacket, in a brass case with a reduced charge. The powder load in this cartridge is adjusted to ensure the weapon's fire cycling when fired from the FN Five-seveN pistol and the FN P90 submachine gun, achieving excellent noise reduction when used in conjunction with a suppressor, and despite its low muzzle velocity, the bullet has ballistic capabilities to pierce basic ballistic body protections and provides excellent results against intermediate protection models, however, due to its design, it has a significant bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SS190) is a [[5.7x28mm FN|5.7x28mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.7x28mm FN SS190 cartridge with a 2 gram armor-piercing bullet with a steel penetrator over an aluminum core with a reinforced copper jacket, in a brass case. Thanks to its muzzle velocity and design, this cartridge is capable of piercing basic ballistic body protections and provides excellent results against intermediate protection models, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SOST) is a [[5.56x45mm NATO|5.56x45mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.56x45mm NATO MK 318 Mod 0 (SOST) cartridge with a 4 gram open-point bullet with a lead core over a copper base with a copper jacket, in a brass case. The cartridge was specially designed for the United States Marine Corps, under the name SOST (Special Operations Science and Technology) to provide penetration of objects with low structural strength and provide a considerable stopping power effect, even being able of piercing basic ballistic body protections.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Quests==
* 4,500 need to be obtained for the quest [[Never Too Late To Learn]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SSA AP) is a [[5.56x45mm NATO|5.56x45mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.56x45mm NATO SSA AP cartridge with a two-part armor-piercing projectile, the bullet consists of a sabot and a tungsten carbide penetrator body, in a brass case. This bullet was designed to surpass the one used in the 5.56x45mm NATO M995 cartridge in regard to its penetration capabilities, thanks to its muzzle velocity and peculiar design, it is capable of pierce basic and intermediate ballistic body protections, in addition to providing outstanding results against some modern specialized protection models, however, due to its design, it has a high bounce probability on various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKBS) is a [[7.62x25mm Tokarev|7.62x25mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x25mm Tokarev cartridge with a 5.5 gram non-magnetic bullet in a brass case; intended for sport shooting and hunting. This cartridge is manufactured with superior attention to detail, giving the shooter more benefits in relation to other cartridges of the same caliber used by the military, such as a reduction in recoil without altering its muzzle velocity and granting considerable damage to the target, making it ideal for the hunting.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Trivia==
* AKBS ('''Агентство Коммерческой безопасности Специзделия''' > ''Agentstvo Kommercheskoy Bezopasnosti Spetsizdeliya'' = "Agency for Commercial Security Specialized Products") was a Russian company founded in 1993 that made security equipment like small arms and ammunition. It was reorganized in 2012 as FORTUNA.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (6B43) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The 6B43 bulletproof vest is designed for protection from light weapon bullets - including BP and PP - fragments of grenades, mines, and melee weapons, as well as reducing the risk of after-penetration effects during combat situations.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Quests==
* 2 are needed for the quest [[Sew it Good - Part 3]]
* Must be equipped to kill 10 PMCs on [[Factory]] for the quest [[The Good Times - Part 1]] ("Edge of Darkness" game edition buyers only)

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained by completing the quest [[Escort]]

==Location==
* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s
* In [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* In [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* On [[Glukhar]]'s followers
* On [[Kaban]]'s followers
* On [[Kollontay]]'s followers
* On [[Sanitar]]'s followers
* On [[Shturman]]'s followers

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SS197SR) is a [[5.7x28mm FN|5.7x28mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.7x28mm FN SS197SR cartridge with a 2.6 gram lead core polymer tipped expansive bullet with a copper metal jacket, in a brass case. This bullet features a ballistic tip that acts as a wedge on the lead core upon impact, allowing the bullet to expand and cause significant damage on the target, and despite the peculiarity of its design and its low speed compared to other cartridges of its caliber, it is able to pierce basic ballistic body protections.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SS198LF) is a [[5.7x28mm FN|5.7x28mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 5.7x28mm FN SS198LF cartridge with a 1.8 gram aluminum core open-point bullet with a copper jacket, in a brass case. This cartridge was designed for use by police forces, reaching higher muzzle velocities compared to other cartridges of the same caliber and providing a significant stopping power effect, although its own design decreased its capabilities to pierce even the most basic ballistic body protections.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (6Sh118) is a [[Backpacks|backpack]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The 6Sh118 raid backpack is part of the 2nd generation "Ratnik" gear kit for combat. The 6Sh118 tactical army backpack is a modernization of the 6B38 Permyachka model raid backpack. The 6Sh118 raid backpack is designed to carry fire support equipment, weapons, ammunition, elements of mountain equipment, as well as the personal belongings of individual soldiers. The backpack can be used during combat operations, long hikes, and raid events.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Only 1 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (6B47 EMR) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and night vision devices. The helmet can be fitted with a variety of covers for different environments. Equipped with an EMR (Digital Flora) camouflage cover.

==Quests==
* Can be used for [[Prapor]]'s quest [[The Punisher - Part 5]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Hybrid) is a [[6.8x51mm|6.8x51mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A mil-spec 6.8x51mm (.277 FURY) rifle round with bi-metallic case (stainless steel base coupled to a brass body), manufactured by SIG Sauer. Provides a higher velocity, more energy hitting being transferred to the target, and a lighter cartridge than 5.56x45, and hits harder than 7.62x51, while also having a great penetration power against modern body armor.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (6B47) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and night vision devices. The helmet can be fitted with a variety of covers for different environments.

==Quests==
* 1 is needed for the quest [[Hot Delivery]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKBS) is an ammo box type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A box of [[7.62x25mm TT AKBS]] cartridges, 25 pieces.

==Trivia==
*AKBS stands for «АКБС» (АГЕНТСТВО КОММЕРЧЕСКОЙ БЕЗОПАСНОСТИ СПЕЦИЗДЕЛИЯ > ''Agentstvo Kommercheskoy Bezopasnosti Spetsizdeliya'' = "Commercial Security Agency – Special Products"). It is a Russian company founded in 1993 that manufactures arms and ammunition for the civilian hunting and armed security markets. 
*The box's text reads ПАТРОНЫ / ДΛЯ ГРАЖДАНСКОГО ОРУЖИЯ / С НАРЕЗНЫМ СТВОΛОМ / КАΛИБРА 7,62×25MM ТОКАREV / 25 ШТУК (''Patrony / Dlya Grazhdanskogo Oruzhiya / S Nareznym Stvolom / Kalibra 7.62mm Tokarev / 25 Shtuk'' = "Cartridges / for civilian firearms  / with a rifled barrel / Caliber: 7.62mm Tokarev / 25 pieces"). 
**The Greek letter Λ (lambda) is used instead of the Cyrillic letter Л (Latin: "L"). 
**Tokarev is spelled in Latinate text rather than Cyrillic (Токарева > ''Tokareva'').

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (LRNPC) is an ammo box type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A box of [[7.62x25mm TT LRNPC]] cartridges, 25 pieces.

==Trivia==
*The box's text reads ПАТРОНЫ / ДΛЯ ГРАЖДАНСКОГО ОРУЖИЯ / С НАРЕЗНЫМ СТВОΛОМ / КАΛИБРА 7,62×25MM ТОКАREV / 25 ШТУК (''Patrony / Dlya Grazhdanskogo Oruzhiya / S Nareznym Stvolom / Kalibra 7.62mm Tokarev / 25 Shtuk'' = "Cartridges / for civilian firearms  / with a rifled barrel / Caliber: 7.62mm Tokarev / 25 pieces"). 
**The Greek letter Λ (lambda) is used instead of the Cyrillic letter Л (Latin: "L"). 
**Tokarev is spelled in Latin text rather than Cyrillic (Токарева > ''Tokareva'').

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (6B47 EMRA) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
6B47 is an aramid helmet of Russian origin. As part of the Ratnik program, it is the new standard-issue helmet for most of the Russian Armed Forces. The 6B47 is similar to previous generation helmets such as the 6B7-1M and 6B27. It has equal protection but weighs slightly less, floats in water, and has mounting equipment for lights and night vision devices. The helmet can be fitted with a variety of covers for different environments. Equipped with an arctic EMR camouflage cover.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PS) is a [[7.62x39mm|7.62x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x39mm PS gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-231) cartridge with a 7.9 gram bullet with a heat-strengthened steel core with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. The PS cartridge (Púlya so Stal'ným serdéchnikom - "Bullet with a Steel core") was introduced into service in 1949 for Soviet 7.62x39mm caliber weaponry, and over the years has undergone numerous changes in the materials used for its construction. Thanks to the tempered steel core that this model has, it is able to pierce through basic ballistic body protections as well as some intermediate models in addition to provide a significant stopping power effect, however, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Description==
A 7.62x39mm BP gzh (GRAU Index - 7N23) cartridge with a 7.9 gram armor-piercing bullet with a hardened carbon steel core with lead cladding on the tip and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (BT) is a [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x54mm R BT gzh (GRAU Index - 7BT1) cartridge with a 9.2 gram armor-piercing tracer bullet with a pointed heat-strengthened steel core with a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Green). This BT bullet (Bronebóynaya Trassíruyushchaya - "Armor-piercing Tracer") it's an improved version of the used in the 7.62x54mm R T-46M cartridge, since the lead core was replaced by one of heat-strengthened steel, providing automatic firearms with penetration capabilities against basic, intermediate and specialized ballistic body protections as well as providing a significant stopping power effect.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Quests==
* 200 need to be obtained for the story chapter [[Boreas]] if you have completed [[Choose Your Friends Wisely]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TCW SP) is a [[7.62x51mm NATO|7.62x51mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A 7.62x51mm cartridge with a 10.7 gram lead core soft-point (SP) bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket in a steel case; intended for hunting, home defense, and target practice, produced by Tula Cartridge Works. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MAI AP) is a [[7.62x39mm|7.62x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x39mm MAI AP cartridge with a two-part armor-piercing projectile, the bullet consists of a sabot and a tungsten carbide penetrator body, in a steel case. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (HP) is an ammo box type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 20-round package of [[7.62x39mm HP|7.62x39 HP]] cartridges.

==Trivia==
*The ammo package's design is based on that used by БПЗ (BPZ, ''Barnaul'skiy Patronnyy Zavod'' = "Barnaul Cartridge Factory"). The image shows the ammo packed loose in the pasteboard carton, but BPZ packs their ammo in a folded and stapled kraftpaper packet rather than a tray.     
*The Russian Cyrillic text reads: ''Massa puli 9g'' ("Bullet Mass: 9 grams"), ''Pulya obolochechnaya'' ("Jacketed Bullet"), ''Kapsul''' ("Primer"), ''Gil'za Stal'naya'' ("Cartridge Case, [Lacquered] Steel"). The text uses ''20 Patronov'' ("20 Cartridges") instead of ''20 Shtuk'' ("20 pieces").

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (P) is an ammo box type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A box of [[7.62x25mm TT P gl]] cartridges, 25 pieces.

==Trivia==
*The box's text reads ПАТРОНЫ / ДΛЯ ГРАЖДАНСКОГО ОРУЖИЯ / С НАРЕЗНЫМ СТВОΛОМ / КАΛИБРА 7,62×25MM ТОКАREV / 25 ШТУК (''Patrony / Dlya Grazhdanskogo Oruzhiya / S Nareznym Stvolom / Kalibra 7.62mm Tokarev / 25 Shtuk'' = "Cartridges / for civilian firearms  / with a rifled barrel / Caliber: 7.62mm Tokarev / 25 pieces"). 
**The Greek letter Λ (lambda) is used instead of the Cyrillic letter Л (Latin: "L"). 
**Tokarev is spelled in Latin text rather than Cyrillic (Токарева > ''Tokareva'').

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M80A1) is a [[7.62x51mm NATO|7.62x51mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x51mm NATO M80A1 cartridge with a 124 grain armor-piercing copper jacket bullet with an exposed hardened steel penetrator, in a stainless steel casing. Designed as a replacement for the M80 cartridge to improve the armor penetration and ballistics of the cartridge as part of a program to eliminate the use of lead in small arms ammunition in the U.S. Army.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PBM) is a [[9x18mm Makarov|9x18mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x18mm Makarov PBM gzh (GRAU Index - 7N25) cartridge with a 3.7 gram hardened carbon steel core armor-piercing bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was designed in the 1990s to increase the penetration capabilities of 9x18 PM weapons, and thanks to its high muzzle velocity it is capable of passing through basic ballistic protection equipment as well as certain intermediate protection equipment at short distances at the cost of a small increase in recoil.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PstM) is a [[9x18mm Makarov|9x18mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x18mm PMM PstM gzh (GAU Index - 57-N-181SM, GRAU Index - 7N16) cartridge with a 5.6 gram steel core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a truncated cone shape, in a bimetallic case. The 9x18mm PMM cartridge is the modernization of the 9x18mm PM cartridge, designed with the intention of increasing its piercing capabilities against basic ballistic body protections, and it has an increased powder charge, making it dangerous to fire in non-compatible weapons. It is intended to be used with the PMM pistol (Makarov Pistol Modernised) and the PP-9 "Klin" submachine gun.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Because of its increased powder charge, this round can't be fired from the [[PP-91 Kedr]] and [[PP-91-01 Kedr-B]] submachine guns. The [[PP-9 Klin]] can fire it.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PPe) is a [[9x18mm Makarov|9x18mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x18mm Makarov PPe gzh cartridge with a 7.6 gram lead core hollow-point bullet with a bimetallic semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case. The design of this bullet is based on experiences gained from other 9x18mm PM hollow-point cartridges. The PPe cartridge has a conical hole in its core and the jacket has six notches to improve its expandability on impact, thus achieving a significant stopping power effect.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Description==

The PRS bullet (Ponizhennoy Rikoshetiruyushchey Sposobnosti; "Reduced Ricochet Ability") is designed to crumble and rapidly lose speed when hitting a solid object in order to substantially reduce collateral damage from ricochets during urban operations carried out by law enforcement agencies and groups from the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PS) is a [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x54mm R PS gzh (GRAU Index - 7N1) cartridge with a 9.8 gram bullet with a pointed steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. This PS cartridge was developed by TsNIITochMash in the mid-1960s from the 7.62x54mm R LPS gzh cartridge specifically to increase its accuracy when fired from a sniper or designated marksman rifles, such as the SVD and its variants, being able of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections as well as providing an outstanding stopping power effect.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SNB) is a [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x54mm R SNB gzh (GRAU Index - 7N14) cartridge with a 9.8 gram armor-piercing bullet with a pointed heat-strengthened steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. This SNB cartridge (SNíperskiy s Bronebóynoy púley - "Sniper with Armor-piercing bullet") was developed in the mid-1990s as a modernization of the 7.62x54mm R PS gzh cartridge to improve its penetration capabilities when fired from a sniper or designated marksman rifles, managing of piercing specialized ballistic body protections as well as providing a significant stopping power effect.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (LPS) is a [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x54mm R LPS gzh (GRAU Index - 57-N-323S) cartridge with a 9.6 gram steel core bullet with a lead cladding and a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case. The LPS cartridge (Lyógkaya Púlya so Stal'ným serdéchnikom - "Light Steel core Bullet") was introduced into service in 1953 for Soviet 7.62x54mm R caliber weaponry, and over the years has undergone numerous changes in the materials used for its construction. Thanks to its steel core, it is capable of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition to providing a considerable stopping power effect, however, it has a high bounce probability off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (T-46M) is a [[7.62x54mmR|7.62x54mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 7.62x54mm R T-46M gzh (GRAU Index - 7T2M) cartridge with a 9.6 gram lead core tracer bullet with a bimetallic jacket, in a bimetallic case; intended for target designation and fire adjustment in battle (Trace color: Green). This tracer cartridge is a modernized version of the T-46 model (GRAU Index - 7T2), as it provides longer distance tracing capabilities and has similar ballistic effectiveness to the LPS gzh cartridge (GRAU Index - 57-N-323S), because despite the bullet rudimentary design, it is able of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition to providing a considerable stopping power effect, however, it has a significant bounce probability off various surfaces.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Pst gzh) is a [[9x19mm Parabellum|9x19mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x19mm Parabellum Pst gzh (RG057, GRAU Index - 7N21) cartridge with a 5.4 gram heat-strengthened steel core bullet with two-layer semi-jacket, a polyethylene interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a bimetallic case. This modified PS cartridge (Púlya Stal'náya - "Steel Bullet") was developed by TsNIITochMash in the early 1990s based on the 9x21mm PS gzh "SP10" cartridge to increase the penetration capabilities of Russian 9x19mm weapons against basic ballistic protections from up to 50 meters, in addition to providing better muzzle velocity.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RG028) is a [[9x18mm Makarov|9x18mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A 9x18mm Makarov RG028 gzh cartridge with a 6 gram hollow-point bullet with a cylindrical hardened steel core with lead cladding and a bimetallic semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SP8) is a [[9x18mm Makarov|9x18mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x18mm Makarov SP8 gzh cartridge with a 3.9 gram frangible hollow-point bullet with a lead core in a plastic plug with a brass semi-jacket, in a bimetallic case with a reduced charge. Developed in the mid-1980s by TsNIITochMash in order to provide a low penetration cartridge to minimize the destruction and over-piercing of objects with low structural strength (for example, during counter-terrorism operations in an aircraft) and still provide a considerable stopping power effect as well as causing substantial adverse effects on the target after impact.

==Notes==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PS gzh) is a [[9x21mm Gyurza|9x21mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (P gzh) is a [[9x21mm Gyurza|9x21mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x21mm Gyurza P gzh (SP11, GRAU Index - 7N28) cartridge with a 7.5 gram soft lead core bullet with a bimetallic jacket in a bimetallic case. This cartridge was designed by TsNIITochMash due to the need to create a cheaper 9x21mm PS "SP10" cartridge for practice shooting during experimentation with weapons of the same caliber. Because of this, the cartridge had to meet similar criteria, such as recoil, muzzle velocity, and trajectories. The result was so satisfactory that it was adopted by the FSB due to its substantial stopping power effect, even against basic ballistic protection equipment at short distances, as well as having a reduced ricochet ability compared to other cartridges of the same caliber.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RIP) is a [[9x19mm Parabellum|9x19mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x19mm Parabellum RIP (Radically Invasive Projectile), is a cartridge with a 6 gram frangible bullet designed to produce multiple wound channels to incapacitate assailants quickly. In a departure from conventional hollow-point design, the "R.I.P." round features 8 machined lead-free copper petals or "trocars", designed to fragment quickly and move in multiple directions, thus providing a superior stopping power effect of its caliber, in addition to being able to inflict substantial adverse effects on the target after impact.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (BP gs) is a [[9x39mm|9x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x39 mm BP gs (GRAU Index - 7N12) special cartridge with a 15.5 gram subsonic armor-piercing bullet with a hardened carbon steel core with a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a steel case. This BP cartridge (Bronebóynaya Púlya - "Armor-Piercing Bullet") was developed in the early 2000s based on the 9x39mm SP-6 cartridge to improve its design and penetration capabilities, resulting in an improvement at piercing most models of specialized ballistic body protections, in addition to provide a significant stopping power effect. However, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AP 6.3) is a [[9x19mm Parabellum|9x19mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A 9x19mm Parabellum AP 6.3 cartridge with a two-part controlled fragmenting projectile, an armor-piercing bullet that features a brass sabot and a hardened steel penetrator of 6.3mm. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SP-5) is a [[9x39mm|9x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x39mm SP-5 gs (GRAU Index - 7N8) special cartridge with a 16 gram subsonic bullet with a pointed steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic jacket, in a steel case. This cartridge was designed in the mid-1980s based on the 7.62x39mm US gzh cartridge for use in the VSS Vintorez special sniper rifle, being capable of piercing through basic ballistic body protections as well as providing outstanding results against some intermediate protection models, added to its considerable stopping power effect, however, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SP-6) is a [[9x39mm|9x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x39mm SP-6 gs (GRAU Index - 7N9) special cartridge with a 16 gram subsonic armor-piercing bullet with a hardened carbon steel core with a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a steel case. This cartridge was designed in the mid-1980s to equip the AS VAL suppressed assault rifle with capabilities to neutralize hostile personnel equipped with basic and intermediate ballistic body protection, in addition to providing a significant stopping power effect, however, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AI-2) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AI-2 medikit was developed as a standard service first aid kit for various defence and law enforcement agencies and civil defense forces of USSR. In case of all-out conflict with the use of weapons of mass destruction it should have been distributed to the population  of the affected and surrounding areas.

*[[Sport bag]]

*[[Medical supply crate]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SPP gs) is a [[9x39mm|9x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x39mm SPP gs (GRAU Index - 7N9) special cartridge with a 15.7 gram subsonic armor-piercing bullet with a pointed hardened carbon steel core over a lead base with a bimetallic semi-jacket, in a steel case. This cartridge was developed in the early 2000s based on the 9x39mm SP-5 gs cartridge to improve its design and penetration capabilities. Resulting in an improvement at piercing basic and intermediate ballistic body protections, in addition to providing a considerable stopping power effect and being able to inflict severe adverse effects on the target after impact. However, due to its design, it has a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AHF1-M) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A military drug based on human antihemophilic factor. Developed by TerraGroup Labs as a powerful coagulant specifically for USEC operatives. Temporarily stops bleeding and increases resistance to new ones. Slightly improves health indicators, leads to dehydration.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Samples]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Sanitar]] and his guards
*Medical [[Airdrop crate|Airdrops]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* On the left set of white boxes when entering the Sterile Laboratory (G22) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 2]]</big><br/>47 minutes

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AFAK) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AFAK (Adaptive First Aid Kit). A more advanced version of the IFAK individual first aid kit. The compact kit provides the individual soldier or law enforcement officer with a necessary lifesaving equipment to effectively treat injuries commonly associated with combat trauma.

==Notes==
* Healing [[File:Bleeding.png|46px|Bloodloss]] removes 30 HP from the AFAK
* Healing [[File:HeavyBleeding.png|46px|Heavy bleeding]] removes 170 HP from the AFAK

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Jacket (114 key)]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Wooden crate]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PAB-9) is a [[9x39mm|9x39mm ammunition]] type in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 9x39mm PAB-9 special cartridge with a 17.2 gram subsonic armor-piercing bullet with an extended hardened carbon steel core with a two-layer semi-jacket, a lead interior and a bimetallic exterior, in a steel case. The PAB-9 (Patrón Avtomátnyy Bronebóynyy - "Armor-piercing Cartridge for Automatic rifles") is a modified version of the SP-6 cartridge. It has a heavier bullet and a higher muzzle velocity, making it capable of piercing through basic and intermediate ballistic body protections in addition to providing outstanding results against some specialized protection models, and having a considerable stopping power effect, at the cost of deterioration in its accuracy and having a high probability of bouncing off various surfaces. In the ranks of the special forces of the Russian Federation, it is not recommended for use due to the increased negative impact on the resource of the weapon.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Meet 1) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A tape from the lecture hall recording one of the TerraGroup meetings.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[The Unheard]]
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Content==
[[File:A.P. meeting audio tape Part 1 audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
A.P.: Friends! Who's still out there? Dmitry Sergeevich, come in and close the door, please. Thank you. Are all departments represented? I see they are. Let us begin, then.

A.P.: By now, everyone's noticed that communications have been down since this morning and many divisions are in lockdown. I'd like to say this is just another drill, but this time it's very serious. We received an order from New York today. We're evacuating.

A.P.: Quiet, colleagues! I understand your concern, but we have to stay focused. I initiated the protocol a few hours ago. The specialists are already working on data destruction and sealing the premises. 

A.P..: All projects in Tarkov are being shut down, including affiliated enterprises. From now on, contact with them will be handled only through… hmm… Gennady Viktorovich, I don't see you, raise your hand, please. There, that's the man you'll need. I believe there shouldn't be any issues. Those drills we ran weren't for nothing…

Question from the audience: Half of my samples aren't ready yet. What's going to happen to them?

A.P.: Pyotr Alekseevich, please, hold your questions…

Question from the audience: Excuse me, what about the large equipment?

A.P.: The centrifuge has already been disassembled, literally an hour ago. Enough! Time is precious right now!

A.P.: You'll be able to ask your questions at the end, but for now, let's stay on topic. Key personnel will be evacuated to the Health Resort — many of you have already vacationed there before. It's now being used as an interim evacuation site. Logistics, escort, and security are handled by United Security personnel.

A.P.: But be careful! Our cooperation with them ends immediately after arrival at the Health Resort! After that point, a new contractor will make contact, and management strongly advises against approaching USEC operatives.

[[Category:Audio tapes]]
[[Category:Minor TerraGroup evidence]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Meet 2) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A tape from the lecture hall recording one of the TerraGroup meetings.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[The Unheard]]
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Content==
[[File:A.P. meeting audio tape Part 2 audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
A.P.: I understand your concerns! I don't have all the information myself, but I'm confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel. TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.

A.P.: Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we're working under such a rush, but there's no other way.

A.P.: I've received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here! I'll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?

Korneev: Yes.

A.P.: Good. Once everything is sealed, we'll head to the Health Resort.

A.P.: I understand, colleagues. It's hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won't be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…

Shout from the audience: How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!

A.P.: Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.

A.P.: Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…

A.P.: Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I'll find a spot.

A.P.: Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I'll be back soon.

[[Category:Audio tapes]]
[[Category:Minor TerraGroup evidence]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (B-11) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|handguard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The integrally machined B-11 foregrip is manufactured from aluminum alloy D16T with black coating and can be installed instead of the standard-issue foregrip on the AKS-74U. The foregrip is fitted with Picatinny rail mounts on three sides, allowing for the installation of additional equipment such as tactical foregrips, flashlights, and laser designators. Manufactured by Zenit.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (GEN M3) is a [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|magazine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A 30-round polymer Magpul Pmag 30 AK/AKM GEN M3 magazine for 7.62x39 AK and compatible weapons. Can also be supplied with .366 TKM ammo for use with the corresponding caliber AK-compatible weapons. Comes in black and banana yellow.

==Quests==
* 1 <font color="red">black variant</font> needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - AKM]]
* 1 <font color="red">black variant</font> needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 5]]

==Trivia==
[[Easter eggs and References]]: The banana yellow variant has a QR code on the side that reads "Тебе делать совсем нехуй ?". This roughly translates to "Do you seriously have nothing fucking better to do?"

This integrally machined handguard can be installed instead of the standard-issue foregrip on the AKS-74U. It comes fitted with place for M-LOK rail mounts on three sides, allowing for the installation of additional equipment such as tactical foregrips, flashlights, and laser designators.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ARS 4P) is a [[Weapon mods#Muzzle devices .28Functional Mods.29|flash hider/muzzle brake]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A well-known muzzle device commonly called "The Bulgarian" in Russia. Its reverse-cone shape makes it highly effective at reducing muzzle flash, and it also slightly lessens the concussive effect when firing indoors. Compatible with any caliber from 5.45 to 7.62 on the AK-74 platform, or with the appropriate adapter on AKM or AK-12 assault rifles.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (K-Rail 3) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|handguard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The K-Rail Model 3 is a lightweight, CNC machined handguard designed for short-barreled AK-pattern rifles and carbines. Its two-piece design mounts directly to the barrel and features a low-profile configuration that doesn't obstruct the sight line. Equipped with four MIL-STD-1913 rails for mounting flashlights, foregrips, and other tactical accessories. Manufactured by Samson MFG.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (B-33) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|dust cover]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
B-33 dust cover with integrated Picatinny rail is compatible with all models of Kalashnikov automatic rifles and carbines based on AK system. Allows installation of all Picatinny-mountable sights, ensuring the consistency of median aimpoint even after repeated removal and replacement of dust cover. © Zenit

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (B-30+B-31S) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|handguard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The all-milled B-30 handguard is made of D16T aluminum alloy with a black coating, it is intended for installing on the AK assault rifle series 103, 104, 105, 74S, 74M, AKM, AKMS in the standard place of the handguard. The B-31S rail mount above the gas tube is an all-milled bracket made of D16T aluminum alloy with a black coating, mounted on the B-30 handguard. © «Zenit»

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - AKS-74N]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ST-EF) is a [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|stock]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A buttpad that extends the length of the standard metal frame folding buttstock of the AK-platform weapons. The advantage of this extension is that the width of the pad is equal to the width of the AK-100 series plastic pad. The buttpad adds comfort when shooting and reduces the recoil effect. Manufactured by Custom Arms.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AMG-10) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Aviation-grade hydraulic oil AMG-10 with excellent viscosity characteristics, designed for use in hydraulic systems of aircraft and ground equipment operating in extreme Arctic conditions. Ensures reliable performance across a wide temperature range from -60°C to +55°C.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Oil Change]]

==Location==
===[[Icebreaker]]===
* Inside the supply closet room on level 0
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:AMG10 Supply Closet Spawn 1.png|On the shelves
File:AMG10 Supply Closet Spawn 2.png|On the floor under a shelf
File:AMG10 Supply Closet Spawn 3.png|On the shelves
</gallery></li>
* Inside a small room above the helipad on level 4
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:AMG10 Above Helipad Spawn 1.png|Next to the entrance door
File:AMG10 Above Helipad Spawn 2.png|In the back of the room next to a box
File:AMG10 Above Helipad Spawn 3.png|Next to a trash bin on the back of the room
</gallery></li>
* Inside the drone room on level 2
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:AMG10 Drone Room Spawn 1.png|Inside a toolbox
File:AMG10 Drone Room Spawn 2.png|On a shelf in the second room
</gallery></li>
* Inside the storage area under the helipad on level 1 and 0
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

File:AMG10 Under Helipad Spawn 2.png|Behind the stairs

<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

==Description==
The Daniel Defense RIS II 9.5 foregrip is a part of the SOPMOD Block II program to replace the standard M4CQBR or Mk18 foregrips in the US SOCOM service. It's made with light but durable aircraft aluminum alloy and comes equipped with 4 mounts for the installation of additional devices and accessories. Comes in black and coyote brown.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MK12) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|gas block]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The MK12 Gas Block is only compatible with the RIS II (M4A1 & MK18) family of rail systems manufactured by Daniel Defense. It is not compatible with any other Daniel Defense rail system. This is due to various clearance issues. This only applies to rail system lengths that would completely shroud the gas block. If you are mounting the gas block to the barrel without being shrouded by the rail system, then this does not apply. In that case, it will fit as long as the barrel's diameter is .750.

The Daniel Defense RIS II 12.25 foregrip is a part of the SOPMOD Block II program to replace the standard M4CQBR or Mk18 foregrips in the US SOCOM service. This foregrip option is incompatible with the M203 UBGL.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MOE) is a [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|stock]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A drop-in replacement buttstock for AR-15/M16 carbines by Magpul Original Equipment. Uses mil-spec sized receiver extension tubes. Frame profile avoids snagging and shields the release latch to prevent accidental activation, includes a standard 0.30" thick rubber butt-pad to prevent slippage even with body armor or modular gear. Comes in black, flat dark earth, olive drab, foliage green, and stealth grey.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (KX3 556) is a [[Weapon mods#Muzzle devices .28Functional Mods.29|flash hider/muzzle brake]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Noveske KX3 Flash hider, aka the Burning Pig, is designed to increase reliability in short-barreled members of AR-15 family by increasing backpressure and directing the muzzle blast forward of the shooter. Although originally designed for short-barreled AR-15s, it will work on any barrel length and have since been introduced for a variety of mounts. This particular KX3 may be used on 5.56mm barrels with 1/2x28 threading.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MOE AR15) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|pistol grip]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The polymer Magpul MOE (Magpul Original Equipment) pistol grip can be installed on any weapon compatible with AR-15 pistol grips. Thanks to the ergonomic shape and anti-slip texture, it makes the weapon grip and control more comfortably. The inside of the grip contains free space for spare parts, tools, batteries, and an accessories kit. Comes in black and flat dark earth.

Drop-in replacement buttstock for AR15/M16 carbines by Magpul Original Equipment. Uses mil-spec sized receiver extension tubes. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PRS GEN3) is a [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|Stock]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Magpul Precision Rifle/Sniper GEN3 is a field precision stock for AR-15/M16 and AR-10/SR-25 platforms. Featuring tool-less length of pull and cheek piece height adjustments via aluminum detent knobs, the PRS GEN3 stock provides a stable interface intended for semi-automatic sniper or varmint rifles. Comes in black and grey.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 11]]

==Description==
Drop-in replacement buttstock for AR15/M16 carbines by Magpul Original Equipment. Uses mil-spec sized receiver extension tubes. Frame profile avoids snagging and shields the release latch to prevent accidental activation, includes a standard 0.30" thick rubber butt-pad to prevent slippage even with body armor or modular gear. Comes in black and flat dark earth.

The Advanced Receiver Extension buffer tube, Mil-Spec diameter will fit any AR-15-based carbine or rifle. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Adrenaline) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A sterile disposable syringe with a dose of adrenaline - the main hormone of the adrenal medulla. It is used to enhance the physiological response associated with the preparation of all muscles to increased activity. Temporarily boosts strength and endurance. Relieves the sensation of pain.

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Thirsty - Secrets]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Charity]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]
*[[Knight]]
*[[Sanitar]] and his guards

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Car Repair]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Health Care Privacy - Part 3]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Urban Medicine]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (COMP M4) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Aimpoint CompM4 series of sights are the toughest sights that Aimpoint has ever produced and they are the standard infantry soldier sight in many NATO countries. These optics are extremely rugged and operate continuously for up to 8 years using a single AA battery. The Aimpoint CompM4s is the latest version of the U.S. Army's M68CCO (Close-Combat Optic), continuing a legacy that Aimpoint has maintained since 1997.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ASh-12) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The ASh-12.7 (which stands for "Automatic assault rifle, 12.7mm") battle rifle is a dedicated CQB/Urban Operations weapon, developed by TsKIB SOO ("Central Design and Research Bureau of Sporting and Hunting Arms"), a subsidiary of the KBP Instrument Design Bureau of Tula, Russia, by request from the Russian FSB (Federal Security Service). The weapon was designed with extreme short-range stopping power in mind for FSB urban combat units.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PRO) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Aimpoint PRO (Patrol Rifle Optic) reflex sight is installed on the QRP2 or LRP mount that attaches to picatinny rails without any additional tools. The optic has flip-up lens covers – the solid front and transparent rear – allowing the user to shoot with the lens caps closed and both eyes open in an emergency situation. The PRO sight is fully compatible with all generations of night vision devices.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AXMC) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AXMC is the latest in a long and distinguished line of combat proven sniper rifles designed and manufactured by the British company Accuracy International. Chambered in .338 Lapua Magnum, but can be quickly converted to .300 Winchester Magnum and .308 Winchester by changing the barrel, bolt, and magazine/insert.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MCC) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A DC/DC converter that provides a regulated DC voltage. Using voltage converters makes it possible to eliminate malfunctions in the system. This converter has increased physical security and quality of components, which allows it to be used in highly loaded systems with increased physical impact factors.

==Notes==

* Cannot be put inside [[secure containers]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Aband.) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A mysterious key to an unknown door at the abandoned city factory. There is a strange symbol scratched onto it.

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[Broadcast - Part 4]]
* Used in the story chapter [[They Are Already Here]] when you don't have any of the other marked keys
* Used in the story chapter [[The Ticket]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Location==
Marked room on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building at [[Streets of Tarkov]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Velociraptor) is a silenced [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AS VAL MOD.4) is a silenced [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AS VAL MOD.4 is the fourth special modification of the integrally suppressed assault rifle, intended for Russian special operations units and task groups. The MOD.4 features improved controls: an enlarged magazine release button, additional safety selector lever, and an integrated custom charging handle. Developed by members of the BEAR Norvinsk brigade.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Trivia==
* The AS VAL MOD.4 is the next iteration in the line of quasi-fictitious custom weapons based on the real-life [[AS VAL 9x39 special assault rifle|AS VAL]] (GRAU index - 6P30) special rifle. Originally conceptualized for the early 2010s cancelled ''Russia 2028'' game prototype as the AS VAL MOD.2 and AS VAL MOD.3, the weapon was later repurposed for Escape From Tarkov's predecessors and prequels, ''Contract Wars'' and ''Hired Ops'', with an iteration appearing in every game in the series thus far.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Admin) was a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Alu splint) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An aluminum splint for fixing damaged bones in place.

==Notes==
When applying the splint to your leg you will be unable to move for the duration of the application. You are able to move while it is applied to an arm.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Axe) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An antique axe with a damaged handle that belonged to the ancient clan of hatchlings called WYCC.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Collector]]

==Location==
* [[Common fund stash]]
* [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* [[Scavs]]
* [[Scav Raiders]]
* [[Reshala]]'s guards

==Trivia==
* Before patch 0.11.7 it wasn't usable as a melee weapon.
* [[Easter eggs and References]]:

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Aramid) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Aramid fibers are a class of heat-resistant and strong synthetic fibers. They are used in aerospace and military applications, for ballistic-rated body armor fabric and ballistic composites, in bicycle tires, marine cordage, marine hull reinforcement, and as an asbestos substitute.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (CPC MOD.1) is an [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The first generation of the modified CPC plate carrier originally designed by Crye Precision and adapted by Ars Arma for Russian law enforcement and military units. The anatomically shaped polymer harness provides a close fit to the torso, eliminating unwanted shifting during movement and contributing to a more even weight distribution. Equipped with a pouch setup in assault configuration. Manufactured by Ars Arma.
