'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Prayer) is an [[Armbands|Armband]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A prayer armband made by Gribnik to protect the owner from a special mosquito subspecies, observed only in the Norvinsk region. Back during Contract Wars, the news posted articles on the Hazardous Environment Combat Special mosquito (abbreviated "SBEU" in Russian), but only a small fraction of the data provided had been scientifically verified.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* This armband is only available to players who preordered the "The Unheard" edition of the game.

==Trivia==
The abbreviation "SBEU" is based on a direct translation from the Russian "СБЭУ", which stands for "Симуляция Боя в Экстремальных Условиях" and translates to "Hazardous Environment Combat Simulator", or short HECS. This term was used for a long time by the developers to promote the "extensive and realistic" systems in the game. In the Russian part of the community it is often used to make fun of the unrealistic aspects of the game.

"KOMAR" is a direct translation from the Russian "Комар", which means mosquito. This is direct reference to a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a999zQ9yhjQ YouTube video] titled "Инцидент 0293: Тарковский Комар", in English "Incident 0293: Tarkovsky Mosquito".

{{Navbox armbands}}
[[Category:Armbands]]

[[ru:Повязка на руку Оберег от SBEU KOMAR]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Armored Case) is a quest item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A mysterious briefcase, apparently containing a certain "Ticket" out of Tarkov.

==Notes==
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Falling Skies]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Experimental signal jammer tool.png|link=Experimental signal jammer]] x1<br/>[[Experimental signal jammer]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Toolsicon.png|link=Toolset]] x1<br/>[[Toolset]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Armored case icon.png|Locked Armored case|link=Armored case]] x1<br/>[[Armored case|<font color="red">Locked</font> Armored case]]

|}

==Loot Table==
The case always contains the [[Kruglov's RFID keycard]], a colored [[Keys_%26_Intel#The_Lab|keycard]], two [[TerraGroup Labs access keycard]]s, a random amount of [[Euros]] and any two of the following items: [[Golden egg]], [[Golden neck chain]], [[Gold skull ring]], [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Rec.) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A regular audio recorder. In Tarkov, they became widely used right after the city was cut off from the outside world.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* The recorder is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Usage==
The recorder must be equipped to play found audio tapes (Default keybind: M) in raid. Collected audio tapes can also be listened to in the handbook without having the recorder equipped.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Evidence) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An audio tape prepared by Kozlov for Anastasia. According to Kozlov's letters, it contains irrefutable proof of the city administration's ties to the local criminal underworld.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Accidental Witness]]
* This is one of the '''major evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Content==
[[File:Audio tape with incriminating evidence audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Deputy Minister Shkurenko: …so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.

Chepyga:
And the cops? I'm not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.

Deputy Minister Shkurenko: The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.

Chepyga: So the old scheme, then?

Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.

Chepyga: Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.

Deputy Minister Shkurenko: There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together. Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won't leave you without support.

Chepyga: We'll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don't start nosing around. It'll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.

Deputy Minister Shkurenko: If you handle it cleanly, I'll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won't have trouble finding volunteers.

Chepyga: Aight. When do we get the guns?

Shkurenko's assistant: Yaroslav Grigoryevich, look…

Chepyga: Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!

[[Category:Audio tapes]]
[[Category:Major TerraGroup evidence]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Report) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An audio tape recording the conversations between the Gnezdo outpost fighters and the Bogatyr squad.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Batya]]
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Content==
[[File:Audio tape with report audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Voevoda: To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive. We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (LShZ-2DTM) is a [[Headwear]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The LSHZ-2DTM helmet is intended for periodic wearing with the purpose of protection from bullets of small arms of a user’s head, as well as for protection from bullets of small arms of a user’s face and neck when equipped with a visor and aventail.

==Mods==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Plates) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A spacious case for storing ballistic plates.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 96 inventory slots in a 8x12 grid and only takes up 8 inventory slots itself. Only [[armor plates]] can be stored in it.

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: The Ballistic plate case is modeled after the [https://www.pelican.com/us/en/product/cases/cargo/bx135/ BX135 Cargo Case by Pelican].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Armor repair kit) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A bag with everything you need to repair body armor - from the lightest to the heaviest.

==Notes==
*Requires the [[Hideout]] module "Lavatory" to be used
*Used to [[Item repair|repair]] [[Body armor|armored items]]
*Cannot be used in raid
*Usage increases the [[Light Vests]] or [[Heavy Vests]] skill, depending on the type of armor repaired

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Gear Rack level 3]]

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Battery Change]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:ArmorRepairKit3.png|link=Body armor repair kit]] x1<br/>[[Body armor repair kit|Body armor repair kit (used)]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Cordura Icon.png|link=Cordura polyamide fabric]] x1<br/>[[Cordura polyamide fabric]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Ripstop icon.png|link=Ripstop fabric]] x1<br/>[[Ripstop fabric]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Fleece Icon.png|link=Fleece fabric]] x1<br/>[[Fleece fabric]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:SewingKit Icon.png|link=Sewing kit]] x1<br/>[[Sewing kit]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 3]]</big><br/>25 minutes
!<big>→</big>
![[File:ArmorRepairKit3.png|link=Body armor repair kit]] x1<br/>[[Body armor repair kit]]
|}

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Moonshine) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A first-class moonshine straight from the Hideout. Sixfold distillation, purification, crystallization, and ionization of the boiling process led to the creation of this 79-degree drink. Remember that drinking alcohol can lead to tragic consequences.

==Notes==
* Can be used as payment for the "Scav case" module in the [[Hideout]]

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Provocation]]
* 1 is used in the quest [[Sensory Analysis - Part 1]] (1 is provided)
* 15 need to be obtained for the quest [[A Life Lesson]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[A Bitter Victory]]

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Scav Case]]

==Location==
* In [[Sport bag]]s
* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s
* In [[Buried barrel cache]]s

*In the basement of warehouse 4 next to the sleeping bag
*In the back of the van between old gas station and railway bridge
*In the repair shop on the right side of the greenscreen

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Whiskey) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The most popular whiskey among the PMCs. The unique filtration of the drink occurs through charcoal obtained from the burning of Samara sugar birch. The drink seems to be alcoholic, and alcohol is harmful. Especially for such a warrior like you.

==Quests==
* 10 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Booze]]
* 15 need to be obtained for the quest [[A Life Lesson]]

==Location==

* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s
* In [[Sport bag]]s
* In [[Common fund stash]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Kvass) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Norvinsky Premium, a truly refreshing kvass. Kvass is made by the natural fermentation of bread, such as wheat, rye, or barley, and sometimes flavoured using fruit, berries, raisins, or birch sap. One of the traditional Slavic drinks, it is not just a tasty, but also a healthy product. It is for a reason that in Russian tales it is constantly drunk by Bogatyrs to regain their power.

* In [[Sport bag]]s
* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Bomber) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A heraldic symbol of urban vagabonds. You need to wear it correctly, otherwise, the magic properties of the beanie will cease to work.

==Quests==
* Needed for the quest [[Dandies]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Nut Sack balaclava icon.png|link=Nut Sack balaclava]] x1<br/>[[Nut Sack balaclava]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Cultist Circle]]</big><br/>[[Hideout#Unique_Sacrifices|Unique Sacrifice]]<br/>1 h 6 min
!<big>→</big>
![[File:SSH-68Icon.png|link=SSh-68 steel helmet (Olive Drab)]] x1<br/>[[SSh-68 steel helmet (Olive Drab)]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Boss Cap Icon.png|link=BOSS cap]] x1<br/>[[BOSS cap]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Ushanka icon.png|link=Ushanka ear flap hat]] x2<br/>[[Ushanka ear flap hat]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:BomberBeanie icon.png|link=Bomber beanie]] x1<br/>[[Bomber beanie]]
|}

==Trivia==
[[Easter eggs and References]]: This is a reference to the beanie worn by Edd in the cartoon show Ed, Edd n Eddy.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Vitamins) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A bottle with multivitamins. A demanded item in conditions of reduced immunity.

==Quests==
* 10 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Crisis]]
* 4 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Thirsty - Secrets]]

==Hideout==
* 1 needs to be obtained  for the [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 1]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Medcase]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M3 Super 90) is a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Benelli M3 S90 is a dual-mode shotgun designed and manufactured by Benelli. The M3 is notable for allowing the user to choose between semi-automatic or pump-action operation. Benelli shotguns show excellent ballistic performance, and the finish and fine workmanship are the epitome of traditional Italian style.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Boreas) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An audio tape recovered from Compartment C-3, containing a message left behind by the last survivor about the icebreaker "Boreas".

==Usage==
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Location==
On a desk in the laboratory on level 1 of [[Icebreaker]]. A [[Compartment C-3 keycard]] is required to access it.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Compartment C-3 keycard map.jpg|Laboratory location marked on map
File:Compartment C-3 keycard door.png|Door to the laboratory
File:Boreas scientist audio tape spawn.png|The tape
</gallery></li>

==Content==
[[File:Boreas scientist audio tape audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Survivor: So… if I can't control this, then I must at least continue observation.

Survivor: I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker "Boreas". The vessel was…

Grigory Altman: …was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.

Grigory Altman: In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.

Grigory Altman: I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.

Grigory Altman: On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.

Grigory Altman: It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…

Grigory Altman: …It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.

Grigory Altman: It's critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…

[[Category:Audio tapes]]
[[Category:Minor TerraGroup evidence]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (BD keys) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A folder containing Black Division working notes, most of which are impossible to decipher without internal context. Among the records, however, are lists of encryption keys that may still be valid.

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Location==
* [[Black Division]] in the [[Seasons|Seasonal]] mode on [[Ground Zero|Ground Zero (Level 21+)]], [[Shoreline]], [[Streets of Tarkov]] and [[The Lab]].

==Quests==
* 1 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Key to Understanding]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (BD) is a [[Looting#Reward containers|Reward Loot Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A heavy transport crate with no identifying markings. Inside is a random package of Black Division equipment: helmets, body armor, chest rigs, backpacks, or protective gear. Judging by its contents, this crate was prepared for a team expected to operate far from any safe zone.

==Notes==
* Can only be opened outside of a raid
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

* Can be exchanged for 10 [[:Category:BattlePass documents|BattlePass documents]]

Each crate contains a random assortment of [[Black Division]] gear.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Cond. milk) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Condensed milk, also called "Sguschyonka" in Russian, once was a part of field ration for the Union soldiers in Civil War, but later reached unprecedented popularity in post-Soviet countries, becoming almost a staple product. Canned, it can be stored for decades and remain just as sweet, tasty and nutritious.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TAC30) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|scope]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The TAC30 offers a very wide field of view, and 1x magnification at the lower end - making for easy, fast target acquisition. The 4x full zoom and Ballistic CQ reticle make shots out to about 300 yards very practical. The illuminated center dot and large, bright circle allow for instant target engagement at close distances.

==Trivia==
The axe appears to be based off either a "[https://www.fiskars.com/en-us/gardening-and-yard-care/products/axes-mauls-and-machetes/x7-hatchet-14-378501-1005 Fiskars X7]" or a "[https://www.gerbergear.com/en-us/shop/cutting-tools/axes/14-freescape-hatchet-31-002647 Gerber 14-inch Freescape Hatchet]", it is most likely it was based of the former considering a model of what seems to be the early camper axe is a 1:1 recreation of the Fiskars X7, the model was scrapped and altered into an unbranded model presumably to avoid copyright issues, the original model was removed in the patch [[Changelog#0.12.0.4785%20(27%20Oct%202019)|0.12.0.4785]] along with another Gerber weapon which was the [[Grylls Ultimate Fixed Blade]], However a replacement model for it was never re-implemented, removing the weapon completely.

</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (CMS) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Compact surgical kit for treatment of bullet wounds and other serious injuries.

==Notes==
* The CMS kit restores a destroyed ("blacked-out") body part to 1 HP. The player can use medkits afterwards, to heal the body part further.
* Destroyed parts that are restored with a CMS kit will only have 25% - 45% of their maximum HP for the remainder of the raid. If the body part is destroyed a subsequent time, performing surgery again will lower the maximum HP of that body part further.
* Neither the head nor the thorax can be repaired after being destroyed.
* The kit is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Supply Plans]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Survivalist Path - Tough Guy]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Vodka) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
"Tarkov fire water". It is not recommended to consume it in general, alcohol is harmful and all that, but sometimes it is necessary to relax after the battle. No need to raid area 51 to see them aliens after all.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (CAT) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
CAT (Combat Application Tourniquet) prevents blood loss by blocking the blood outlet by applying pressure to the affected limb. It uses a self-adjusting tensioning system and a tug-resistant buckle.

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

==Crafting==

|-

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mk47) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
CMMG Mk47 Mutant, an American-made carbine chambered in 7.62x39mm, manufactured by CMMG Inc. Works with all types of AK magazines, including steel, polymer and drums. The carbine has shown exceptional reliability, which, together with the classic ergonomics of the AR system, gives an excellent example of a firearm. This variant features a fully automatic firing mode, for Law Enforcement and Millitary use only.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 10]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Bulbex) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A high-quality lever cable cutting tool. It is used for the installation and laying of cable routes and power lines.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 2 are used in the quest [[Special Comms]] (2 are provided)

==Hideout==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Generator level 2]]

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Toolbox]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Technical supply crate]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Tri-Zip) is a [[Backpacks|backpack]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A Mid-sized versatile assault pack. Spacious, sturdy and comfortable, this backpack is loved both by military and hikers worldwide. 34L of total space, a hydration system, easy access to side pockets, near-perfect suspension, and a MOLLE attachment system make it a great choice for up to 72 hours of autonomous hiking... or carrying a good load of loot. MultiCam camouflage version.

==Notes==
* Only 1 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Layout==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Briefcase) is a pickupable [[Looting#Loot_Containers|Loot Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

An unremarkable, inexpensive briefcase containing documents clearly never meant for anyone else's eyes. It seems one TerraGroup employee decided to hide important papers in the most obvious place possible — where no one would ever think to look.

==Notes==

* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

==Quests==

==Quest rewards==

* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Digital Puzzle]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Car battery) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Typical 12 V, 51 Ah lead-acid car batteries are in a big demand with traders, who resell them in the areas that have been left without power supply.

==Quests==
* 4 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Car Repair]]

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Vents level 2]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* In the Goshan store on the shelves in the back
* In the OLI store on the shelves near the cash registers, also in the southwest racks between bath section and back warehouse

===[[Shoreline]]===
* In the shelves at the entrance of west resort with hole in wall next to fence
* Inside the bus near the Gas station
*Inside the "Chairman's House" in the swamp area
*In the white shelf in the room next to the back entrance of west resort
*On the ground east of the northern warehouse in the Smugglers Base

===[[Factory]]===
* On top of unsearchable crates in container near Gate 3 exit
* Near the unsearchable crates in blue containers near Gate 0 exit
* On the seat of the forklift behind the 3 silos
* On the shelves in the hallway next to the office window extraction
*In the locker on the second floor of the office

===[[Woods]]===
* Ritual spot
* On the shelves in the workshop at the lumber mill
* In the front seat of the car at Checkpoint
*In the trail of debris behind the crashed plane
*On the bed in the Guardhouse at Sawmill

===[[Customs]]===
* On the shelves in the Storage Building
* On the shelves, or floor, in the Gas Station
* Behind the desk in the Customs Office
*On a bed in two-story Dormitory
*On the table in the [[USEC stash key|USEC Stash]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Thermite) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Thermite-based incendiary mixtures are a mixture of aluminum powder and iron oxide. These compounds have a very high combustion temperature and are capable of burning without the pressence of oxygen. Thermite has an extremely strong burning effect and is almost impossible to extinguish.

==Hideout==
* 5 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 3]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]
*[[Jacket (204 key)]]

===[[Customs]]===
* On the shelves in the Warehouses

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves behind IDEA and Goshan
* On the steps of the reach stacker in the shipping container lot Southwest of Oli and on nearby crates
*On the back shelfs of Brutal

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* Aside the truck near Southern road exfil
* On crates near the construction area on the main road

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Broadcast - Part 1]]
* 5 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Calibration]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Pest Control]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (CR 200DS 9mm) is a [[Weapons#Revolvers|revolver]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Rhino revolvers, manufactured by the Italian company Armi Chiappa, are distinguished by revolutionary patented design and construction with an unusual barrel arrangement for revolvers opposite the lower drum chamber. The short size "pocket" model with a 2 inch barrel chambered in 9x19mm.

==Notes==
* This weapon will never [[Weapon malfunctions|malfunction]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M4A1) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Colt M4A1 carbine is a fully automatic variant of the basic M4 Carbine and was primarily designed for special operations use. However, U.S. Special Operations Command (USSOCOM) was soon to adopt the M4A1 for almost all special operations units, followed later by general introduction of the M4A1 into service with the U.S. Army and Marine Corps.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[The Punisher - Part 5]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith - M4A1]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 9]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as initial equipment from [[Peacekeeping Mission]]

==Trivia==
* Due to its futuristic looks, the Space Trooper variant is a reference to either the weapons used by the "Stormtroopers" in the "Star Wars" movie series, or the weapons used by the soldiers in the movie "Starship Troopers".
* Despite being classified as an assault rifle in-game, the M4A1 is actually a carbine version of the M16 assault rifle, as it has a shorter standard barrel length of 14.5 inches, compared to the M16's 20-inch barrel.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Cordura) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A polyamide fabric, in which due to the special structure of the thread (made from cut and twisted fibers) fourfold resistance to abrasion is achieved compared to plain nylon, also consisting of polyamide. Significantly superior to conventional fabric in tensile strength and abrasion resistance. Used for the manufacture of equipment for various purposes: bags, backpacks, modular pouches, waist and bag belts, cases for carrying weapons and so on.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M1911A1) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Commonly known as just "1911", the M1911 is one of the most famous handguns on the planet. It went through both World Wars as the US Army's standard-issue, and despite being replaced in 1986, its further variations are still being used as the sidearm of different US Special Forces. The M1911A1 is the second generation of the original M1911 pistol. After World War I, the military's Model 1911 went through various changes including a shorter trigger with frame cuts, improved iron sights, an arched mainspring housing, and a redesigned grip safety.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 8]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M45A1) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The MEU(SOC) pistol, ("Marine Expeditionary Unit"; "Special Operations Capable") officially designated the M45 MEUSOC, is a magazine-fed, recoil-operated, single-action, semiautomatic pistol chambered for the .45 ACP cartridge. It's a variant of the M1911, and has been the standard-issue side arm for the Force Recon Element of the United States Marine Corps' Marine Expeditionary Units since 1985. The improved M45A1 features several changes to the original M1911A1 design. One feature is the dual recoil spring system that spreads out the recoil force of the .45 ACP round by lowering the peak force of the recoil pulse. It also has 3-dot tritium night sights, a 5-inch national match barrel, ambidextrous safety, a picatinny rail, and a desert tan Cerakote finish.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SBEU) is a [[Face cover]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A quality balaclava with a special technological material. Very Stylish version.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* [[Arena_BattlePass#Season_0|Arena BattlePass Season 0]] level 57
* 6 Battle Points

==Trivia==
The abbreviation "SBEU" is based on a direct translation from the Russian "СБЭУ", which stands for "Симуляция Боя в Экстремальных Условиях" and translates to "Hazardous Environment Combat Simulator", or short HECS. This term was used for a long time by the developers to promote the "extensive and realistic" systems in the game. In the Russian part of the community it is often used to make fun of the unrealistic aspects of the game.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M16A2) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A later evolution of the M16 platform, the M16A2 introduced a burst-fire mechanism, improved iron sights, handguard and buttstock for greater control and durability. Chambered for 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition, it served as the primary service rifle for the U.S. military throughout the 1980s and 1990s. Known for its precision and dependability, the M16A2 remains a benchmark for modern assault rifle design.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M16A1) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An American-made 5.56x45mm assault rifle developed by Colt in the late 1960s as an improved variant of the original AR-15/M16 design. The M16A1 became the standard service rifle of the US military during the Vietnam War, featuring a forward assist and other refinements for reliability in harsh conditions. Though considered outdated by modern standards, it remains a durable and accurate weapon prized by collectors and shooters alike.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (C-1) is a note in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This log has records of every entry into Compartment C-1. Judging by the records, it is the most restricted and classified area aboard the icebreaker "Boreas".

==Usage==
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

On the wall next to the [[Compartment C-1 keycard|Compartment C-1]] door on level 7 of [[Icebreaker]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (C-3) is a [[Keys & Intel|Keycard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A Paradigm Shipping keycard marked Compartment-3. It likely opens one of the restricted compartments aboard the Boreas icebreaker.

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the story chapter [[The Ticket]]

==Key Location==
This keycard can only be obtained once while progressing through the story chapter [[Boreas]].

==Lock Location==
Door to the laboratory on level 1 of [[Icebreaker]]. '''Note:''' The door can't be opened when players without the required progress in the story chapter [[Boreas]] entered the raid.

* Loose loot ([[Loot#Medical supplies|Medical supplies]], [[Medical#Injectors and stimulants|Stimulants]], [[Medical|Meds]])
* 4x [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]] in the overseeing cabin
* [[Boreas scientist audio tape]] in the overseeing cabin

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SA58) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The SA58 OSW (Operations Specialist Weapon), manufactured by American company DSA (or DS Arms - David Selvaggio Arms), is a legal copy of the FAL. It's made with the same Steyr-Daimler-Puch production line equipment as the StG-58. It may come with a different barrel length, an aluminum-alloy lower receiver, and improved glass-filled nylon furniture. Civilian models are semi-automatic, but military and law enforcement clients can procure select-fire models that have a fully automatic cyclic rate of 750 rounds/minute. The DSA58 can use any metric-measurement FAL magazines.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Samples]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AirFrame) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AirFrame ballistic helmet sets the standards in protection, comfort, and modularity. The unique overlapping shell design of the AirFrame creates an integrated vent that provides passive cooling and can reduce the damaging effects of explosive blast waves. Highly modular. Manufactured by Crye Precision.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Knife) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A knife of a strange shape and with strange signs, taken from the cultists. Seems like it is used as a ritual knife, but apparently it's not limited to this use. It has technological changes in the design intended for the use of toxic substances - it's better not to touch the blade.

==Notes==
* Unlike other melee weapons, the knife is lost upon death and lootable by other players, even if it's equipped in the sheath (melee) slot
* When an enemy is struck by the knife, it inflicts the [[File:Intoxication.png|46px|Unknown toxin]] effect, dealing gradual damage over time (140 HP/minute). [[Immunity]] lowers the amount of damage at 1% per level. It can be treated with [[xTG-12 antidote injector|xTG-12 injector]] or [[Perfotoran (Blue Blood) stimulant injector|Perfotoran injector]].
* The knife has 2 uses. This means that only the first two hits inflict the [[File:Intoxication.png|46px|Unknown toxin]] effect.

==Quests==
* 12 need to be obtained for the quest [[Night Sweep]]
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Broadcast - Part 5]]
* 4 need to be found for the quest [[Small Business - Part 3]]
* 3 need to be found for the quest [[Keeper's Word]]

==Location==
* [[Cultists]]

!<big>→</big>

[[Armasight Zeus-Pro 640 2-8x50 30Hz thermal scope]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Cultist) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Tarko collectible figure of a local cultist. The craftsman has very meticulously portrayed these hooded unidentified individuals. Particular attention was paid to the unusual knife. Looks like the author had familiarized himself firsthand with the sharpness of its blade.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Small Business - Part 1]]
* 1 of these, or 1 of the other Boss figurines, needs to be obtained for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 1)]]
* 2 of these, or 2 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 2)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 5)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 6)]]

* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Plastic suitcase]]

'''Cult victim audio tape #1''' (Victim 1) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An audio tape from the apartment of the cult victim. The recording mentions something called the Eye of the World.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[They Are Already Here]]
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Content==
[[File:Cult victim audio tape 1 audio.mp3|282px]]

===Transcript===
Cult Victim: Tape #1. Time is… time is 14:09. My name's Igor. I feel like some secret agent doing this. I even had to switch to analog recordings. You know, with a tape recorder. At least that way any of those freaks can't hack it.

Cult Victim: Yesterday someone slipped a book under my door. Creepy as hell, covered in those same symbols that started showing up around the city…  At first I thought it was some prank. Like, you know, that old TV show, Naked and Funny. Damn, that one sure is an oldie…

Cult Victim: Anyway, the book! I read it. Spent the whole evening on it. And it's full of… of some serious weirdness. Not nonsense, no. More like… I don't know, like someone knows things they really shouldn't know.

Cult Victim: Well, our Cobalt is connected to TerraGroup, and over the years I've learned a few things. So these… these "Gifts" mentioned in the book sound an awful lot like some of TerraGroup's projects. The secret type.

Cult Victim: I'm sure they tried to recruit me. Like, into some cult. Only these guys are way more sophisticated than your average Peoples Temple types. They think I have access to some "Eye of the World". That's why they need me. And they're not gonna stop at just sending a book.

Cult Victim: I have to run. Yes… yes, I need to disappear. Lay low, maybe even in Bruges.

Cult Victim: They've been watching me. This whole time. And I thought it was just paranoia. Even talked about it with my therapist, for fuck's sake! I should've trusted my gut. Maybe I wouldn't have to drop everything and run now. I…

[[Category:Minor TerraGroup evidence]]

'''Cult victim audio tape #2''' (Victim 2) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An audio tape found among the personal belongings of the victim in the cultists' torture chamber. It seems the owner was chosen deliberately.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[They Are Already Here]]
* This is one of the '''minor evidence''' used in [[The Ticket]]

==Content==
[[File:Cult victim audio tape 2 audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Cult Victim: The last tape ran out. I didn't think it would happen this fast. Alright, I'll make this quick.

Cult Victim: Anyway, those guys... those guys in hoods... They're watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door. You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me... The Priests called me the chosen one!

Cult Victim: I need to run. I'm recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn't matter where or how anymore!

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Ronin) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A Japan-styled tactical helmet, manufactured by DevTac. Not used by any military or special forces. Just somehow happened to be in Tarkov for some frivolous price. Features a full protection of the whole head, but the armor class is not good enough to actually be useful in combat.

==Trivia==
* The Devtac started life as an airsoft helmet design, and was made to enable significant protection. It meets the NIJ IIIA standards.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MDR) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The MDR 7.62x51 (.308) bullpup assault rifle, designed and manufactured by Desert Tech LLC. A modular multi-caliber weapon with a compact bullpup layout intended for use by police and military special operations. Barrel lengths and calibers can be changed by the end-user within minutes with a minimum amount of tools.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Bastion plate) is an [[Helmet mods#Additional armor|additional helmet armor]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Trivia==
* The Diamond Age Bastion helmet is a modular combat helmet. Despite the 6th class protection ingame, this armor is closer to a strong 4 or weak 5, as it is only intended to stop M855A1 combined with the Bastion helmet in something analogous to a combined NIJ III+.
* This along with the Diamond Age Bastion helmet appears to no longer be for sale. The company itself has rebranded to Adept Armor.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (DSPT) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A special digital radio transmitter for user status identification system.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
* This item is required to be equipped to cross the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula on [[Lighthouse]]. It deactivates the [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]] and has [[Zryachiy]] not shoot you when its in the <font color="green">encoded</font> state.
* This item is required to speak to [[Lightkeeper]].
* This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quests==
* Used in the quests [[Knock-Knock]], [[Getting Acquainted]] and [[Make Amends]] from [[Mechanic]]

==Quest rewards==
* Can be obtained as initial equipment from the quest [[Knock-Knock]]. The related questline starts with [[Network Provider - Part 1]].

==States==
{| class="wikitable"
! Status 
! Meaning
|-
| <font color="red">Decoded</font> || You harmed [[Zryachiy]], one of his followers, or a [[Lightkeeper]] acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises while having the item equipped. It requires to be encoded again at the [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center level 2]].
'''Attention:''' Unequipping the item does not prevent getting this status in '''local''' [[Game_modes#PvE_and_PvE_Co-op_game_mode|PvE game mode]] raids.
|-
| rowspan="2" | <font color="yellow">Blocked</font> || Not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter.
|-
|On any map that isn't [[Lighthouse]].
|-
| <font color="green">Encoded</font> || The DSPT is ready to use, and you may cross the bridge without being blown up by [[Map_of_Tarkov#Location_specific_features|Claymores]] or being shot at by [[Zryachiy]] and his followers. 
|}

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Screwdriver tool.png|link=Screwdriver]] x1<br/>[[Screwdriver]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Flash drive v3 tool.png|link=Secure Flash drive V3]] x1<br/>[[Secure Flash drive V3]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:DSP transmitter icon.png|Decoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter|link=Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]] x1<br/>[[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter|<font color="red">Decoded</font> Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:ElectronicComponents icon.png|link=Electronic components]] x1<br/>[[Electronic components]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center level 2]]</big><br/>2 hours<hr/>After accepting [[Mechanic]]'s task<br/>[[Getting Acquainted]]<br/><br/>[[File:Generator Portrait.png|Electricity]] required during the entire process
!<big>→</big>
![[File:DSP transmitter icon.png|Encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter|link=Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]] x1<br/>[[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter|<font color="green">Encoded</font> Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]]
|}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Ded Moroz) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Tarko collectible figure of a Ded Moroz. This time, the craftsman portrayed a collective image of one of the Scavs who changes his clothes every Christmas and New Year and gives everyone in the city gifts that he managed to loot during the year. Traditionally, PMC fighters and Scavs do not attack this oddball.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Small Business - Part 1]]
* 1 of these, or 1 of the other Boss figurines, needs to be obtained for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 1)]]
* 2 of these, or 2 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 2)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]

==Location==

* [[Plastic suitcase]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RPD) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Degtyarev hand-held machine gun chambered in 7.62x39 caliber. This machine gun was adopted by the Soviet Army and was used as a means of reinforcing infantry squads and platoons from the late forties to the early sixties. The RPD is elegantly designed, resulting in a compact, reliable and quite powerful fire support weapon. Manufactured by V.A. Degtyarev Plant.

==Notes==
* This weapon will never [[Weapon malfunctions|malfunction]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RPDN) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Degtyarev hand-held machine gun chambered in 7.62x39 caliber. This machine gun was adopted by the Soviet Army and was used as a means of reinforcing infantry squads and platoons from the late forties to the early sixties. The RPD is elegantly designed, resulting in a compact, reliable and quite powerful fire support weapon. The RPDN variant is equipped with a hinged dovetail mount for installing optics. Manufactured by V.A. Degtyarev Plant.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* This weapon will never [[Weapon malfunctions|malfunction]].

==Quests==
* [[Getting Some Air]] requires 40 kills using this gun with the [[Axion Kobra EKP-1S-03 reflex sight (Dovetail)|EKP-1S-03 sight]] on [[Shoreline]], [[Lighthouse]] or [[Reserve]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Labyrinth) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The final recording of a TerraGroup scientist who locked himself in the Labyrinth observation room.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[The Labyrinth (story chapter)|The Labyrinth]]

==Content==
[[File:Deceased scientist's audio tape audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
TerraGroup Scientist: This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…

TerraGroup Scientist: The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12. Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can't hear any of the BEARs.

TerraGroup Scientist: The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and sent it to the stock.

TerraGroup Scientist: I don't know if I'll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.

[[Category:Audio tapes]]

[[ru:Аудиокассета застрелившегося учёного]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (BEAR) and '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (USEC) are [[Loot|items]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Army dogtags serve the purpose of quickly identifying the wounded and deceased in combat.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* The value of a dogtag depends on the owner's PMC and Prestige levels. When sold to [[Therapist]], the value per level is as follows:
** No Prestige: ₽459
** Prestige 1: ₽535,5
** Prestige 2: ₽561
** Prestige 3: ₽586,5
** Prestige 4: ₽612
** Prestige 5: ₽612
** Prestige 6: ₽612
* Dogtags obtained from group members sell for only ₽1, and will not be [[Found in raid|found in raid]]. They can, however, be used for barters.

==Info==
This item tells you the owner's name, level, faction, time of death, who killed them and the weapon used to kill them.
The number displayed in the bottom-left of a dogtag icon displays the level of its owner.

==Quests==
* 5 dogtags need to be obtained for the story chapter [[Tour]]
* 10 [[USEC]] or [[BEAR]] dogtags need to be obtained for the quest [[The Punisher - Part 6]]
* 10 [[USEC]] dogtags ([[Prestige]] 1 or higher) need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Trophies]]
* 10 [[BEAR]] dogtags ([[Prestige]] 1 or higher) need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Trophies]]

====BEAR Exclusive====
* 20 [[USEC]] dogtags need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Our Own Land]]

====USEC Exclusive====
* 20 [[BEAR]] dogtags need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Counteraction]]

==Trivia== 
The default USEC version shows the following: 

BROWN.<br/>CHARLES WM.<br/>US NAVY<br/>4567822277<br/>B POS NKA

"4567822277" is the fictitious military service number, "B POS" is the blood type with rhesus factor and "NKA" stands for "No Known Allergies".

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Docs) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A leather field case for document and map storage.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 16 inventory slots in a 4x4 grid and only takes up 2 inventory slots itself. It can only store: 
*[[Currency]]
*[[Keys & Intel|Keys & Keycards]]
*[[Posters]]
*[[Maps]]
*[[Loot#Info_items|Info items]]
*[[Keycard holder case]]
*[[DesmondPilak CD]]
*[[Physical Bitcoin]]
*[[Veritas guitar pick]]
*[[:Category:BattlePass documents|BattlePass documents]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Punisher - Part 5]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Nostalgia]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[All Is Revealed]]

==Location==
===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard

</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (DFuel) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Overseer) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "Overseer" on it. Appears to be extremely fragile, one-two uses and the key will break apart.

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[Against the Conscience - Part 1]]
* This is a required location for the quests [[Between Two Fires]], [[Decisions, Decisions]] and [[Surprise Gift]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Shoreline]]===
In one of four locations at the smugglers' base. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid. 
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:DormOverseerKeySpawnMap.png|Smugglers' base and spawn locations marked on map
File:DormOverseerKeySpawn2.png|First spawn: On the desk inside the red container next to the northwestern warehouse 
File:DormOverseerKeySpawn1.png|Second spawn: On the single bed inside the northwestern warehouse 
File:DormOverseerKeySpawn4.png|Third spawn: In an ashtray on the table in the tented area next to the northern metal shack
File:DormOverseerKeySpawn3.png|Fourth spawn: In a pan on the table inside the northern metal shack
</gallery></li>

==Lock Location==
Door to the room between 209 and 211 on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on [[Customs]].
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:DormOverseerKeyMap.png|Room location marked on three-story dorms map
File:DormOverseerKeyDoor.png|Door to the room
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* Loose loot ([[GP coin]]s, [[Loot#Valuables|Valuables]], [[Provisions]], [[Weapon mods]])
* 1x [[PMC body]]
* Possible [[Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine]] (variant D-WARRIOR)
* Possible [[FN P90 5.7x28 submachine gun]] (variant DEVGRU)
* Possible modified [[TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 9x19 submachine gun]]
* Possible modified [[FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle]]
* Possible modified [[Desert Tech MDR 5.56x45 assault rifle]]
* Possible modified [[Kalashnikov AKMN 7.62x39 assault rifle]]
* Possible modified [[AS VAL 9x39 special assault rifle]]
* Possible [[MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset]]
* Possible [[Peltor ComTac II headset (OD Green)]]
* Possible [[OPSMEN Earmor M32 headset]]
* Possible [[MF-UNTAR body armor]]
* Possible [[BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR)]]
* Possible [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black)]]
* Possible [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Olive Drab)]]
* Possible [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Coyote Tan)]]
* Possible [[BNTI Gzhel-K body armor]]
* Possible [[5.11 Tactical Hexgrid plate carrier]]
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:DormOverseerKeyInside.png|Inside the room
</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ER BAYONET) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Following on from the successful FULCRUM knife, Extrema Ratio developed a bayonet version of that design. Like the original FULCRUM, this bayonet is extremely versatile and strong. The tanto-shaped blade allows for large amounts of work and wear while still keeping a sharp edge at its exceedingly sturdy tip. This feature, combined with a sharp false edge, makes the knife retain sufficient combat penetration capability to engage targets covered in heavy clothing, padding, or soft ballistic protections. Thanks to its weight and top-heavy balancing, the FULCRUM BAYONET blade is suitable for hard work on the field.

==Location==
* [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* [[Scavs]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (F-1) is a [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|fragmentation grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] 57-G-721.

==Description==
The F-1 hand grenade (GRAU Index 57-G-721) is an anti-personnel fragmentation defensive grenade, designed for neutralizing enemy personnel in defensive combat. Due to a significantly effective fragmentation radius, it should only be thrown from behind hard cover, such as a concrete wall, APC, or tank.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (EMC) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the EMERCOM medical care unit at the ULTRA shopping mall.

==Quests==
* Needed for the Quest [[Vitamins]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Customs]]===
* Ambulance near the big gas station. You have to jump inside to grab the key off the seat.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:MES Key Ambulance.png|The Ambulance
File:Key To Emercom MES Chair.png|Seat with key
</gallery></li>

==Lock Location==
Located on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on [[Interchange]]. On the north side of the center mall.
* This location has 3 different doors that can be unlocked. Opening each door will use a point of durability on the key.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Emercom Location.jpg|Location marked on map
File:Emercom outside.png|The EMERCOM medical unit
File:Emercom outside2.png|Other side
</gallery></li>

==Behind The Lock==
* 2x [[Medbag SMU06]]
* 1x [[Sports bag]]
* 1x [[Jacket]]
* Loose loot ([[Medical|Meds]], [[Loot#Medical supplies|Medical supplies]], [[Loot#Valuables|Valuables]])
* [[Portable defibrillator]] spawn
* [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]] spawn
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Emercom Inside.png|Inside the room
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (eTG-c) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A powerful stimulant for regeneration processes. It is used for rapid recovery of a soldier after injury, or during transportation of heavily wounded personnel. Allowed to be used only by medical officers and paramedics. Has strong side effects.

==Quests==
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Sanitar]] and his guards

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Fuel) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A plastic lightweight expeditionary canister for fuel

==Quests==
* 3 of these, or 3 [[Metal fuel tank]]s need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[I Need More Power]]

==Hideout==
* Cannot be refilled
* Can be used as fuel for the Generator in the [[Hideout]]
* When full (60/60), it powers the hideout for 12 hours 37 minutes and 53 seconds (25 hours 15 minutes and 47 seconds with solar power module, 67 hours 22 minutes 6 seconds with solar power module and elite hideout management skill)

==Quest Rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from completing [[Safe Corridor]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from completing [[The Huntsman Path - Justice]]

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Technical supply crate]]
* [[Jacket (204 key)]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves in the OLI store
* On top of barrels on the highway near the EMERCOM tents
* On the green and white shelf in The National store

===[[Woods]]===
* In the bunkers ZB-014 and ZB-016
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:ZB-014 fuel.png|Inside the ZB-014 bunker
</gallery></li>

===[[Customs]]===
* Loose in the warehouse east of crane yard
* Along side the train cars in the new construction zone
* On the bed in [[Dorm room 110 key|Dorm room 110]]
* In the trunk of the white van at the old gas station

===[[Reserve]]===
* On the ground around the K buildings and the garage next to White Knight
* On the ground around fuel tanks located between the king building and the dome
* On the ground inside the ground floor of the Queen building
* In the tunnel connecting the King building and the White pawn

===[[The Lab]]===
* On a table next to the three caged robot arms in the Main Working Area
* On top of crates in the tunnel directly below the hall in between G11 ([[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)|Blue Keycard]] room) and G12 ([[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)|Black Keycard]] room)

===[[Shoreline]]===
* At the gas station
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Fuel tank.png|In one of the woodshed at Downtown
File:Exped fuel.png|Inside the old house next to the Ruined House Fence extract
</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (EMotor) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A small electromechanical transducer, through which electrical energy is converted into mechanical energy. An indispensable thing in production or engineering.

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 10 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Bitcoin Farm level 3]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Generator level 2]]
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Generator level 3]]
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Shooting Range level 2]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Vents level 2]]
* 4 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Vents level 3]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Water Collector level 2]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Compass) is a [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A hand-held compass. Allows you to quickly navigate, indicating the direction of the magnetic poles of the Earth. With it, you can easily determine the azimuth.

==Notes==
* The compass is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Usage==
The compass must be placed in any inventory slot and assigned to a hotkey to be used.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Search Mission]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MMAC) is an [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Eagle Industries Multi-Mission Tactical Vest (MMAC) is a traditional profile vest offering modularity and scalability. The tactical vest is constructed of MIL-SPEC 500 denier nylon and is fully MOLLE/PALS compatible. It features padded shoulders with detachable retention loops, push-to-talk (PTT) attachment points at upper left and right chest and many other features.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MBSS) is an [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The MBSS vest is part of the Maritime Ballistic Survivor System. The vest can be used with flotation inserts to provide buoyancy as it is not equipped with a quick release system. Manufactured by Eagle Allied Industries.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Equipment (Rare)) is a [[Looting#Reward containers|Reward Loot Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
===Before Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. It contains various equipment to help you survive and kill in the harsh world of Tarkov. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

===After Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. It contains various equipment to help you survive and kill in the harsh world of Tarkov. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

==Notes==
* Can only be opened outside of a raid
** Must be un-locked at the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]] before it can be opened
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
* Only the locked version can be stashed in [[Lucky Scav Junk box]]

==Location==
* Possible reward from [[Ref]]'s daily and weekly quests for [[Arena]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Handdrill tool.png|frameless|link=Hand drill]] x1<br/>[[Hand drill]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Equipment crate Rare Icon.png|frameless|Locked Equipment crate (Rare)|link=Equipment crate (Rare)]] x1<br/>[[Equipment crate (Rare)|<font color="red">Locked</font> Equipment crate (Rare)]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]]</big><br/>1 minute
!<big>→</big>
![[File:Equipment crate Rare Icon.png|frameless|Unlocked Equipment crate (Rare)|link=Equipment crate (Rare)]] x1<br/>[[Equipment crate (Rare)|<font color="green">Unlocked</font> Equipment crate (Rare)]]
|}

==Loot Table==
The crate can contain various [[Chest rigs|chest rigs]], [[Armor vests|armor vests]], [[Headwear#Armored|helmets]], helmet attachments (like [[Weapon_mods#Flashlights|tactical flashlights]] and [[Helmet mods#Night_vision_devices|night vision devices]]), [[armor plates]], [[earpieces]], and [[Face_cover|masks]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (P90) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
FN P90, also known as the FN Project 1990, is a compact personal defense weapon (PDW) designed and manufactured by FN Herstal in Belgium. Created in response to NATO requests for a replacement for 9×19mm Parabellum firearms, the P90 was designed as a compact but powerful firearm for vehicle crews, operators of crew-served weapons, support personnel, special forces, and counter-terrorist groups.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (FN 5-7) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
FN Five-Seven, trademarked as the Five-seveN, is a semi-automatic pistol designed and manufactured by FN Herstal in Belgium. The pistol was developed in the early 1990s and features a cold hammer-forged barrel that is chrome-lined for extended service life. The polymer-framed Five-Seven offers single-action operation, low felt recoil, 20-round magazine capacity, and is equipped with an ambidextrous, forward-mounted manual safety, and an accessory rail that accepts tactical lights and lasers. Comes in black and flat dark earth.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (FLIR RS-32) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|thermal vision sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Versatile thermal imaging telescope/sight with many uses and advantages. It can be installed on weapons for use as sight, or on the helmet - via adapter - as a monocular, and as a separate observation device.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Cannot be insured.
* Cannot be put in [[secure containers]]
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* The thermal detection range is ~230 m at 0° angle, it goes up to ~250 m aiming uphill or downhill

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 11]]

==Mods==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Factory) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A somewhat fragile factory emergency exit door key.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* Used in [[Therapist]]'s quest [[Health Care Privacy - Part 6]]
* Used in [[Fence]]'s quest [[Is This a Reference?]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Customs]]===
* On a table next to the broken TV in the guard desk office located in the three-story dorms
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:FactoryKeyTVLocation.png|The office with table in the corner
File:FactoryKeyTVLocation2.png|The key spawn is right next to the TV
</gallery></li>
* In a blue locker inside warehouse #7.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:FactoryKeyBuildingMap.png|Warehouse #7 marked on map
File:FactoryKeySpawnBuilding.png|Warehouse #7
File:FactoryKeyBlueLockerSpawn.png|The blue locker with location marked
</gallery></li>

==Lock Locations==
===[[Factory]]===
Two additional extractions and a locked room next to the office:
* Med Tent Gate extraction
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:FactoryKeyDoorsMarked.jpg|Location marked on map
File:Med tent gates.png|Door to the extraction
</gallery></li>
* Cellars extraction in the underground
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:FactoryKeyDoorsMarked.jpg|Location marked on map
File:Fac Cellars.png|Door to the extraction
</gallery></li>
* Locked room on the 3rd floor of the office area
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:FactoryKeyDoorsMarked.jpg|Location marked on map
File:FactoryLockedRoom.png|Door to the room
</gallery></li>

===[[Customs]]===
* Two doors to the guard building of the crane yard next to the new gas station
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Customs-Fac-Doors.png|Location marked on map
File:ShortcutBuilding2.png|Building from outside the crane yard
File:ShortcutBuilding1.png|Building from inside the crane yard
</gallery></li>
* Door leading to the ZB-013 extraction in the basement of the Scav base
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:ZB013LocationMap.png|Building location marked on map
File:ZB-013 Building.png|The building where the extraction is located 
File:ZB013 Grate.png|Door leading to the extraction
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
===[[Factory]]===
* Med Tent Gate extraction
* Cellars extraction in the underground 
* Locked room on the 3rd floor of the office area:
** [[Portable bunkhouse key]] spawn location
** 1x [[Jacket]]

===[[Customs]]===
* ZB-013 extraction
* Crane yard guard building:
** Loose loot ([[Weapon mods]])
** [[TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key]] spawn location
** 1x [[Drawer]]
** 1x [[Wooden crate]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Beard) is a [[Face cover]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An artificial white beard. Christmas spirit? Maybe...

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: This item refers to the Santa Claus or Saint Nicholas. They are a legendary figure, originating in Western Christian culture, who is said to bring gifts to the homes of well-behaved children on Christmas Eve.
* This face cover first appeared during Escape from Tarkov's 2018 Christmas Celebration.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Redut-M) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
"Redut M" is a modified version of the Redut well-proven body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (FP-100) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The FP-100 filter absorber is designed to clean the polluted air of various industries from the chemical industry, radioactive dust and bacterial (biological) aerosols.

==Hideout==
*Used to run the [[Hideout#Modules|Air Filtering Unit]]
*Can be removed once installed to not be used if module doesn't need to be active.
*Lasts for 17 hours 38 minutes and 49 seconds (23 hours 31 minutes and 45 seconds with elite [[Hideout Management|Hideout Management skill]]).

==Locations==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Ration supply crate]]

===[[Customs]]===
* In the bathroom at the two story dorm
* In warehouse 4 between generators on side without power switch
* In warehouse 5, on the bottom shelf next to the [[Chemical - Part 4|chemical van]]
* In the back room upstairs at the [[USEC stash key|USEC stash building]]
*Next to the supply crate in the building just west of ZB-1011
*On the bricks to the left of the locked gate leading to ZB-1013 extract

===[[Reserve]]===
* Various locations in the underground area near D-2 power switch
* Inside the [[RB-AM key|RB-AM]] room
* Inside the [[RB-GN key|RB-GN]] room

===[[Factory]]===
* On the wooden shelves outside office window

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves in Adik
*Back Shelves in Oli
*Back Shelves in Idea
*Floor of Power Station

=== [[Shoreline]] ===
* On the main floor of the power station
*On the shelves in the terminal

===[[Woods]]===
* In the corner of the main area in the [[ZB-014 key|ZB-014]] bunker
*On shelves in scav bunker

=== [[Ground Zero]] ===
*In the grenade launcher room as loose loot

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Redut-M) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
"Redut-M" is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. SK Woodland version.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* [[Arena_BattlePass#Season_0|Arena BattlePass Season 0]] level 148
* 2 Weekly operational tasks in [[Arena]] in Season 0
* 10 Battle Points

==Trivia==
The chest rig is based on a real Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 plate carrier configured with numerous commercially available Ferro Concepts accessories. In addition to the [https://ferroconcepts.com/products/fcpc-v5-base FCPC V5 base], the configuration shown in-game includes:
* [https://ferroconcepts.com/products/adapt-3-assault-cummerbund Ferro Concepts ADAPT 3" Assault Cummerbund (3AC)]
** With [https://ferroconcepts.com/products/adapt-3ac-side-plate-pockets-6x6 Ferro Concepts 3AC Side Plate Pockets 6X6] on the insides
* [https://ferroconcepts.com/collections/pockets/products/roll-1-trauma-pouch Ferro Concepts Roll 1 Trauma Pouch] mounted beneath the front flap as an IFAK for medical supplies
* [https://ferroconcepts.com/products/adapt-ktar-front-flap Ferro Concepts KTAR Front Flap], a triple rifle magazine placard mounted to the front of the carrier
* [https://ferroconcepts.com/products/wingman-v2 Ferro Concepts Wingman V2] wing pouches and 3AC 6x6 Side Plate Pockets mounted to the cummerbund
* [https://ferroconcepts.com/products/fc-shoulder-pads Ferro Concepts Shoulder Pads].

The model is also depicted carrying an [[:wikipedia:AN/PRC-148|AN/PRC-148 Multiband Inter/Intra Team Radio]], [[:wikipedia:AN/PRC-152|AN/PRC-152 Multiband Handheld Radio]], a TEA U94 Gen II Push-to-Talk (PTT), and a [https://image-us.samsung.com/SamsungUS/samsungbusiness/solutions/industries/government/tactical-edition/B2B_Galaxy_S23_Tactical_Edition_Spec_Sheet_5Lc.pdf Samsung S23 Tactical Edition] mounted in a Juggernaut Case PALS Armor Mount.

Other visible accessories include a North American Rescue (NAR) CAT Tourniquet, NAR ARS Decompression Needle, ASP Tri-Fold Restraints with both the Molded Pull (black) and Key Ring Pull (rescue orange) retention variants, and utility pouches.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Redut-M) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
"Redut-M" is a modified version of the well-proven Redut body armor, which is in service of special units of the FSB. The vest is based on advanced technologies in the field of individual armor. Due to the optimized form of armor elements and the outer cover with a special damping-ventilation system, the Redut M armored vest has excellent functional qualities, which facilitates active actions, including those associated with the use of vehicles and in confined spaces. Black version.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* [[Arena_BattlePass#Season_2|Arena BattlePass Season 2]] level 24
* 10 Battle Points

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Finances) is a [[BattlePass]] document in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Financial reports from TerraGroup and its affiliated companies. There's bound to be plenty of inconsistencies and evidence hidden inside, but are you really willing to spend hours of your life reading dry financial paperwork?

Can be found on:
* Customs
* Streets of Tarkov
* Interchange

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Usage==
* Used to unlock rewards from the [[Seasons#Season 1: KORD BREACH|Season 1: KORD BREACH]] [[BattlePass]].

'''#FireKlean gun lube''' (#FireKlean) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The FireKlean gun lube is considered one of the highest quality in the world. Can also be used in some other cases!

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Collector]]

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 3]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Weapon Rack level 3]]

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Plastic suitcase]]
* [[Common fund stash]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Technical supply crate]]
* [[Jacket (204 key)]]
* [[Drawer]]

===[[Factory]]===
* On the shelf between office doors

===[[Customs]]===
* On the bed in [[Dorm room 110 key|dorm room 110]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Caged robot arms area between the server room and the weapons testing area

===[[Shoreline]]===
* On the mattress inside the Chairmans house, on the west side of the swamp

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the [["Negotiation" room key|Negotiation room]] on the bottom of the blue mattress

===[[Woods]]===
* At the train depot as loose loot (access via [[BTR Driver|BTR]])

|-

|}

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: 
** This item is a parody of the gun lubricant "FIREClean" and also a reference to the content creator and former Battlestate Games community manager [https://www.twitch.tv/klean Klean]. It likely originated from Klean making the joke "Fire Klean" around the time the Escape from Tarkov community questioned his suitability for the community manager role.
** The packaging is based on the "[https://slip2000.com/products/gun-lube Slip 2000 Gun Lube]".
** The phrase "Can also be used in some other cases!" from the description refers to a "FIREClean" controversy in which it was discovered that its chemical composition is very similar to common vegetable oil.

'''GP coins''' (GP) are a [[currency]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A strange looking golden coin. According to rumors, it was actively used as a means of payment for PMC services during the Contract Wars.

==Notes==
* Stacks to 100
* Only 10 can be brought into a raid
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* Spawns in stacks of 8-22

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Chumming]]
* 5 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop]]
* 20 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Huntsman Path - Relentless]]
* All quests from [[Ref]] provide varying amounts based on the player's [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] level

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Strandhogg) is an [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Taking its name from an Old Norse Viking term for a lightning raid, Strandhögg was one of the first formalized battle tactics to use covert infiltrators in advance of an actual raiding operation. Strandhögg was a tactical game-changer in its time, just like the technological advances First Spear is bringing forward in this line of plate carriers.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (GP-25) is a [[Weapon mods#Gear Mods|underbarrel grenade launcher]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An underbarrel grenade launcher for 40mm VOG-25 grenades, designed for installation on all full length AK automatic rifles.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* To use the GP-25, press the hotkey (e.g. 2 or 3) for the weapon it is attached to, while it is in your hands.<br/>[[File:GP25Equip.png|frameless]]
