'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (EW unit) was an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The device suppresses satellite navigation system signals within a several kilometers radius. Sometimes these "umbrellas" can be more important than good body armor.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Cannot be put in [[secure containers]].

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Ours by Right]]
* 15 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Before the Rain]]
* 1 is needed for the quest [[Provide Cover]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as initial equipment for the quest [[Provide Cover]]

==Location==
* Has a chance to spawn on [[Rogues]] on [[Lighthouse]]
* Guaranteed to spawn on [[The Goons]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Strandhogg) is an [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Taking its name from an Old Norse Viking term for a lightning raid, Strandhögg was one of the first formalized battle tactics to use covert infiltrators in advance of an actual raiding operation. Strandhögg was a tactical game-changer in its time, just like the technological advances First Spear is bringing forward in this line of plate carriers. US Air Force ABU pattern camouflage version.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* [[Arena_BattlePass#Season_1|Arena BattlePass Season 1]] level 57
* 8 Battle Points

==Trivia==
The vest is modeled after a FirstSpear Siege-R Optimized Vest equipped with the company's Modular Armor Scalable System (M.A.S.S.) accessories. The configuration shown in-game incorporates several commercially available FirstSpear components, including:
* [https://www.first-spear.com/siege-r-optimized-vest FirstSpear Siege-R Optimized Vest] base
* [https://www.first-spear.com/m-a-s-s-shoulder-straps-siege-r-optimized FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Shoulder Straps] with [https://www.first-spear.com/m.a.s.s.-shoulder-pads FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Shoulder Pads]
* [https://www.first-spear.com/m.a.s.s-biceps FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Biceps]
* [https://www.first-spear.com/m.a.s.s.-throat-guard FirstSpear M.A.S.S. Throat Guard] and [https://www.first-spear.com/collar-protector FirstSpear Collar Protector]
** Both are notably inscribed with the word "LegenD".
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:FirstSpear BD Throat Guard Collar.png
</gallery></li>
* Three [https://www.first-spear.com/ragnar-multimag-rapid-adjust-pocket FirstSpear Ragnar MultiMag Rapid Adjust Pockets], containing two double-stacked [[Glock 9x19 17-round magazine]]s and two [[AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazine]]s
* [https://www.first-spear.com/handcuff-pouch-single FirstSpear Handcuff Pouch] in Ranger Green
* [https://www.first-spear.com/groin-protector FirstSpear Groin Protector].

Mounted to the carrier are an Imminent Threat Solutions (ITS) Fatboy Trauma Pouch, [https://www.cryeprecision.com/GP-Pouch-11x6x4 Crye Precision GP Pouch 11×6×4], MPU5 networking radio in a [https://juggernautcase.com/products/radio-holster.html Juggernaut Case Radio Holster], [https://thyrm.com/products/cellvault-5m Thyrm CellVault-5M], [https://www.sandsprecision.com/v-lite.html S&S Precision V-Lite], [https://www.narescue.com/c-a-t-tq-holder.html North American Rescue (NAR) CAT TQ pouch], and a pair of [https://pig-gloves.com/ Patrol Incident Gear (PIG) FDT] gloves retained by an S-biner.

This Russian poem can be found on the groin protector:
{{quote|В пучине водной, сквозь тонкий лёд,<br/>Он, задыхаясь, шёл на дно.<br/>В предсмертной судороге безмолвной<br/>Спасал он друга всё равно.}}
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Siege-R Poem Easter Egg.png|The poem
</gallery></li>
It translates to:
{{quote|In the depths of the water, through the thin ice,<br/>He sank to the bottom, gasping for breath.<br/>In a silent death throe,<br/>He still managed to save his friend.}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Coсaoo_) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A traditional French baguette baked in full compliance with the 1993 French Bread Decree. Many TerraGroup employees were willing to take quite a detour on their way to work just to pick one up. It's easily recognized by the distinctive "Cocaoo_" stamp the baker marked on every loaf.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Collector]]

* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s
* In [[Buried barrel cache]]s
* In [[Ration supply crate]]s

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: 
** This is a reference to the content creator [https://www.twitch.tv/cocaoo_ Cocao].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Glock 18C) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Glock 18 is a selective-fire variant of the Glock 17. The firearm is typically used with an extended 33-round-capacity magazine, although other magazines from the Glock 17 can be used, with available capacities of 10, 17, or 19 rounds. It has a keyhole opening cut into the forward portion of the slide, similar to the opening on the Glock long-slide models, although the Glock 18 has a standard-length slide. The keyhole opening provides an area to allow the four, progressively larger (from back to front) compensator cuts machined into the barrel to vent the propellant gases upwards, affording more control over the rapid-firing machine pistol.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Bad Habit]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Gingy) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key ring with a four-leaf clover keychain.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 4 inventory slots in a 2x2 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. Only [[Keys & Intel|Keys]] can be stored in it.

==Quests==
*1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Collector]]

==Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard

File:Warehous3Map.png|Warehouse 3 marked on map
File:CustomsWarehouse3.png|Warehouse 3

</gallery></li>
*"Old Gas Station":
**On the desk inside
**At the "giving tree" behind it
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Glock 19X) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Glock 19X is an Austrian pistol based on the Glock 19 Modular Handgun System developed by Glock. Glock 19X is a hybrid of the Glock 17 and Glock 19 models: bolt and barrel of the 19th model, and the long handle of the very first 17th model. Also, the Glock 19X is devoid of sub-finger recesses, but has a loop for a safety cord. The gun is made in the Coyote color.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Poster) is a [[Posters|poster]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A rare poster. The concert was held overseas. Why were these posters put up all over Tarkov? No one knows to this day, but conspiracy theories are rampant.

==Notes==
* Can be installed in the [[Hideout]].

==Location==
*On walls all over Tarkov

==Trivia==
This poster is a reference to the 5th season of Escape from Tarkov ARG. Players had to find it in Germany at 49.896700, 8.519230 (49°53'48.1"N 8°31'09.2"E) and use the information from it to progress the ARG further.

The QR code leads to a [https://drive.google.com/drive/u/0/folders/1Cl8mUd2J0OhqXihunhS7qZ5V_h11bVub Google Drive named "Schiller" published by "kermen@tarkov.com"]. The text below the QR code lists the address of the same Google Drive. The Drive contains a single file "Tree stump" with the coordinates 51.4694559, 7.2249327. Those point to a park in Bochum, Germany, where players found further information for ARG.

The SOTR respirator was developed by Gentex to protect operators from hazardous airborne compounds and particles, intended for use only in ground operations. Provides reliable filtration against most harmful particles, including lead, asbestos, lubricants, and smoke from burning materials.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (GPU) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A graphics card is just as good a source of electronic components as anything else - fans, CPUs, IC, etc.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Profit Retention]]

==Hideout==
Used in the [[Hideout#Modules|Bitcoin Farm]] to produce [[Physical Bitcoin|physical Bitcoins]].

==Location==
*[[PC block]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

===[[Customs]]===
* Under the PC desk in the Green Screen room
*On the dead scav
* On the left grocery shelf in Gas Station
*On the ground in front of the counter in Gas Station
* On the 1st floor sofa in 3-story dorms
* On the table in the unlocked room in Gas Station
* On the floor in the middle of the second room inside of Big Red
* On the floor in 3-story dorm room 314 (Marked Room)
* On the floor in Big Red next to the Fire Can (rare)

===[[Interchange]]===
* On shelves of electronics stores (Texho, German, Techlight, Rasmussen)
*In the furniture store across from Texho by the PS4
* On the Tables in TTS medical store across from Emercom
* In the Idea office
* On the tech shelf in the back of Power Station

===[[Shoreline]]===
* In [[Health Resort east wing room 222 key|East wing room 222]], [[Health Resort east wing room 328 key|East wing room 328]], [[Health Resort west wing room 216 key|West wing room 216]], {{5a13ef7e86f7741290491063}}, [[Health Resort office key with a blue tape|East wing room 110]], West wing room 311 (always open), [[Health Resort west wing room 205 key|West wing room 205]] and [[Health Resort east wing office room 107 key|East wing office 107]]
* On second floor desks of Admin Building
* On the second floor of the weather station, in front of the server bay
* In the East wing storage room
*On counter top in the south most house in village  (Right in front of tank)

===[[Factory]]===
*In the "pumping station"
*In the bottom blue container outside Gate 3 (Two stacked blue containers)
*On top of one of the yellow cart by pit
*Office hallway shelf

===[[Woods]]===
*Marked circle
*As spawn next to dead scav at Dead Man`s Place camp
*On floor of buildings in Village

===[[Reserve]]===
* Can be found on server racks inside multiple buildings
* In the shelves of [[RB-AK key|RB-AK]] on second floor of the black bishop building, north of the helicopter
* In Black Knight on a desk, 3rd room on the left from main entrance
* In [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

=== [[The Lab]] ===
* Right side of orange dome, on white boxes next to a white shelf
*Right side of orange dome, on the last white table before the stairs that go up to management office.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Chemistry Closet]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Natural Exchange]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Kite) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A tin with gunpowder. An essential resource for creating cartridges. The composition of the Kite gunpowder is distinguished by the use of pyroxylin with the presence of graphite, which is necessary to reduce the electrification of the mixture.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Grizzly) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Sportsman Series Grizzly Medical kit is considered one of the best first aid kits. It contains everything necessary to provide timely medical care in extreme conditions.

==Notes==
* Healing [[File:HeavyBleeding.png|46px|heavy bleeding]] removes 130 HP from the Grizzly
* Healing [[File:Fracture.png|46px|Fracture]] removes 50 HP from the Grizzly
* Healing [[File:Bleeding.png|46px|Bloodloss]] removes 40 HP from the Grizzly

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (HK 416A5) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The HK416 A5 is a further development of the HK416 assault rifle in 5.56x45mm NATO caliber. The most striking changes compared to its previous versions as well as to market available AR platforms include an improved and tool-less gas regulator for suppressor use, a redesigned, user-friendly lower receiver, which allows complete ambidextrous operation of the weapon and ensures optimised magazine compatibility. Additionally, numerous technical improvements to maximize the safety of the operator, weapon reliability, ammunition compatibility, and durability under real operating conditions. Comes in black and green brown.

==Quests==
* 1 <font color="red">black variant</font> needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 1]]
* 15 <font color="red">black variant</font> need to be obtained for the quest [[Never Too Late To Learn]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (HEPS) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the USEC stash inside hydroelectric power station, located somewhere near the Azure Coast sanatorium.

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be be obtained as a reward for completing the quest [[Nostalgia]] from [[Jaeger]].

==Lock Location==
On the second floor of the power station on [[Shoreline]].
* This location has 2 different doors that can be unlocked. Opening each door will use a point of durability on the key.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:PowerStationMapShore.png|Power station marked on map
File:Key to HEP station storage Lock Location.png
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* 2x [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* 1x [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* 1x [[Weapon box (6x3)]]
* 1x [[Toolbox]]
* Loose loot ([[Weapon mods]])
* [[Intelligence folder]] spawn on the cabinet
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
Key to HEP station storage inside.png
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Grenades) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A large case for storing various hand grenades.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in a 8x8 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
*[[Grenades]]
*[[Ammunition#Grenade launcher cartridges|Grenade launcher cartridges]]
*[[UZRGM grenade fuze]]

==Quest rewards==

A backpack with a volume of 22 liters with an ergonomic harness for time-limited tasks. The backpack can be used for both operational tasks and urban carry. With proper packing, the inner volume of the backpack can be 25-27 liters. The minimalistic design and military functionality will be useful in urban environments. Manufactured by Gruppa 99. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Grumpy) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key that unlocks the room located at the power station next to the ULTRA mall. Belonged to one of the Arena gladiators by the name "Grumpy".

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Key Location==
* Can only be bartered from [[Ref]] LL2

==Lock Location==
Grumpy's hideout inside the power station on [[Interchange]].
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:PowerStationMap.png|Power station marked on map
File:InterchangePowerStation.png|The power station
File:GrumpysHideoutKeyDoor.png|Door to the hideout
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)|Green keycard]] spawn location
* [[RB-MP21 key]] spawn location
* Loose loot ([[Armor plates]], [[:Category:Ammo boxes|Paper ammo boxes]])
* 2x [[Jacket]]
* 1x [[Sports bag]]
* Possible [[CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle]] (variant Mace)
* Possible [[Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle]] (variant Killtube)
* Possible [[Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine]] (variant D-WARRIOR)
* Possible [[FN P90 5.7x28 submachine gun]] (variant DEVGRU)
* Possible modified [[Kalashnikov AKS-74UN 5.45x39 assault rifle]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (G28) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The HK G28 rifle was developed by Heckler & Koch specifically for the Bundeswehr as a support weapon for small infantry units. The G28 is based on the HK MR308, which, in turn, is a civilian version of the HK 417 automatic rifle. Despite several differences, the HK G28 is 75% interchangeable with the HK 417. This rifle is designed to shoot at distances inaccessible to standard 5.56mm assault rifles.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MP5) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
HK MP5 9x19 submachinegun with Navy 3 Round Burst firing mechanism version, which features three-round cutoff. Widely acclaimed model of a submachinegun, primarily known as weapon of GSG9 and similar forces of the world, and famous through frequent appearance in movies and video games.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - HK MP5]]
* [[Power of Persuasion]] requires 20 PMC kills with the "SD" variant of this gun on [[Streets of Tarkov]], [[Ground Zero]] or [[Interchange]]

* The MP5 version used in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' is the MP5-N, a model designed for use for the United States Navy, which includes a Navy trigger group (including safe, single fire, 2–3 round burst, and full automatic).

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' offers multiple purposes. 

There are vanity items, protective helmets and utility items. Each helmet offers protection for different segments of the head, which becomes an important consideration before heading into combat. 

Another important consideration to make is that different helmets will have a different impact on how much sound they muffle. Sound is an important part of the gameplay in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' also features modular helmets that have a number of different [[Helmet mods|components]] which will influence and change the amount of areas protected by the helmet.

To learn more about the effectiveness of armored headwear check the [[Ballistics]] page.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Hand drill) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A rare and old instrument, almost was out of use before the conflict. However, it's especially useful in current times.

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Stash level 2]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Weapon Rack level 1]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Toolbox]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the Goshan back-stock shelves
* On the Idea back-stock shelves
* On top of barrel next to hole in the fence.
* On top of barrel next to broken bridge hidden cache.
* In the back of a heavy truck by Railway Exfil with the cement walkway behind it

===[[Shoreline]]===
* In the gas station/grocery store near the Svetily dead end extract
* In the admin offices of health resort
* In West Wing Room 301 on the floor
* On a box at the back of a house in Svetliy Village 
* On the desk in the radar towers main room
* On a box in the construction area near the shore.

===[[Customs]]===
* On racks in the storage containers
* At the electric pylon, sitting on the wooden spools
* In repair shop, beside the green screen room
* In one of the cabins near Trailer Park Worker's Shack
* In gas station storage room

=== [[Factory]] ===
* At the forklift between the silos

===[[Woods]]===
*In the first room at Scav bunker.
*Next to the campfire in Dead Man's Place.
*On the floor of Building on road between Bus Station and UN Roadblock.
*On the shelf underground in Scav Bunker.
*On top of a crate in the northeast corner of EMERCOM Camp.
*In the ritual circle

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (FF 4-16) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|scope]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Hensoldt FF 4-16x56 telescopic sight was developed to deliver maximum performance and high adjustment ranges while maintaining a short optical system. With increased transparency in the blue spectral range and adjustable reticle light it is particularly comfortable under low-light conditions. The FF version of the scope has the reticle placed in the first image plane, thus, the reticle pattern is also magnified when the magnification is changed. This makes it possible to determine the distance using the MIL-DOT without having to calculate.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Items) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A storage case for various items.

==Notes==
* Cannot be stored in a [[Backpacks|backpack]].

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in an 8x8 grid and only takes up 16 inventory slots itself. It can store everything except:
* Item case

* [[Weapon case]]
* [[T H I C C Weapon case]]
* [[Lucky Scav Junk box]]
* [[SheefGG piggy bank]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Gen4 Assault) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Improved Outer Tactical Vest (IOTV) Gen IV is designed to permit maximum freedom of movement required to assume correct firing positions with the agility to execute and maneuver tasks. Optimal design characteristics ensure the best possible weight distribution of both the ballistic body armor system as well as additional load bearing equipment, thus providing enhanced comfort, wear duration, and mobility. Increased ergonomics assault kit.

==Trivia==
* The IOTV Gen 4 is a US issue armor vest intended to sustain significant damage. It is made using ceramic strike faces and soft armor to cover any other areas. According to testing, this armor is at least able to sustain 2 .30-06 M2 AP impacts, or 7.62x63mm AP, without failure.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mayo) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This "DevilDog's" brand mayonnaise is quite famous in Tarkov. Recommended to use with boiled potatoes.

==Location==
* In [[Sport bag]]s
* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s
* In [[Buried barrel cache]]s
* In [[Ration supply crate]]s

===[[Shoreline]]===
* Next to the grenade box located near the balcony of [[Health Resort west wing room 216 key|West wing room 216]].
* On the dinner tray beyond the broken brick wall in basement of admin at Health Resort.

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves in the [[Object 11SR keycard|#11SR Saferoom]].
* On the shelves on the north wall of Goshan.

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: 
** This is a reference to the content creator [https://www.twitch.tv/thedevildoggamer TheDevildogGamer] who welcomes his new subscribers with "Give him the white and sticky", which refers to Mayonnaise.
** The look of the mayo jar is based off of the popular brand "Hellmann's".

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Injectors) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A case for storing injectors, stimulants, and other specialized medications.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. Only [[Medical#Injectors and stimulants|injectors and stimulants]] can be stored in it.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (OTV) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Interceptor vest consists of a fabric Outer Tactical Vest (OTV) with dorsal and thoracic pockets and two protective ceramic-composite SAPI or ESAPI inserts. The Outer Tactical Vest (OTV) is a basic vest equipped with aramid fabric pouches that protect against ammunition fragments and 9mm handgun bullets.

==Trivia==
* The OTV is part of the Interceptor Body Armor series, used by the United States Armed Forces. 
* Early generations of the OTV were equipped with the SAPI, or Small Arms Protective Insert, ceramic composite armor. It was capable of defeating at least three hits of 7,62x51mm M80 FMJ in conjunction with the soft armor backer. 
** This was succeeded by the ESAPI, or Enhanced Small Arms Protective Insert, which added the armor piercing threat of 30.06 M2AP, or 7,62x63mm steel core armor piercing ammunition. 
* The ingame variant is in UCP, or Universal Camouflage Pattern.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (OTV) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Interceptor vest consists of a fabric Outer Tactical Vest (OTV) with dorsal and thoracic pockets and two protective ceramic-composite SAPI or ESAPI inserts. The Outer Tactical Vest (OTV) is a basic vest equipped with aramid fabric pouches that protect against ammunition fragments and 9mm handgun bullets. Woodland camouflage version.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* [[Arena_BattlePass#Season_1|Arena BattlePass Season 1]] level 66
* 8 Battle Points

* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Trader figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Gigachad) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Gigachad cryptoprocessor delivers record-breaking efficiency for complex mathematical computations. Due to its cost and setup complexity, it is typically used only by megacorporations such as TerraGroup at highly critical facilities.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the story chapter [[Boreas]]

==Location==
===[[Icebreaker]]===
* In the central control station room on level 0
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad Central Control Station Room Spawn 1.png
</gallery></li>
* Inside [[Compartment C-1 keycard|C-1 compartment]] on level 7
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad C1 Spawn 1.png
</gallery></li>
* Inside the lower automation room on level -3
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad Lower Automation Room Spawn 1.png
File:Gigachad Lower Automation Room Spawn 2.png
</gallery></li>
* Inside the room with the bulletin board in the engine room on level -2
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad Engine Room Spawn.png
</gallery></li>
* Inside the bridge on level 9
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad Bridge Spawn 1.png|On the floor
</gallery></li>
* Inside the conference room on level 5
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad Conference Room Spawn 1.png|On the floor
</gallery></li>
* Inside the west canteen bedroom on level 3
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gigachad West Canteen Spawn 1.png|In front of the tv
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Hot Rod) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A promotional cooler bag made by Hot Rod for the "Juice Time" campaign. The fabric honeycomb inside keeps drinks upright but makes the bag unsuitable for storing food.

==Notes==
* Only obtainable from paid Twitch Drops.
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 49 inventory slots in a 7x7 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
* [[Provisions|Drinks]]
* [[Ox bleach]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-101) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AK-101 5.56x45mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base. AK-101 is equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The rifle is chambered to fire 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition, and is designed entirely for export purposes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.

==Description==
The 1P59 "Hyperon" pancratic sight is designed to increase the effectiveness of firing from SVD in comparison with the standard PSO-1 sight by 1.3 ... 2 times (depending on the range and size of the target) due to a larger zoom, the use of a more accurate range finder, combining operations of measuring the distance to the target and entering the aiming angles, as well as placing the scale for entering the aiming angles in the sight field of view.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (KEK) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
KEKTAPE will not be able to patch up your difficult Tarkov fate, but it will be able to fix a boat. Or close up a hole in the aquarium. There are lots of things KEKTAPE can do.

==Quests==
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Textile - Part 2]]

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 3 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Lavatory level 2]]
* 5 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Water Collector level 2]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Weapon Rack level 3]]
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Hall of Fame level 3]]
* 10 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Gear Rack level 3]]

==Location==
* [[Drawer]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Toolbox]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Technical supply crate]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the OLI shelves

==Trivia==
* This item is a reference to "Flex Tape".
* "Kek" is the shortened form of "kekeke", a transliteration of an onomatopoetic Korean phrase used online to represent laughter. It's the equivalent to "hahaha".

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (VSK-94) is an [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The VSK-94 (Voyskovoy Snayperskiy Kompleks - "Military Sniper Complex") is a marksman rifle designed on the base of the 9A-91 assault rifle as a cheaper alternative to the VSS "Vintorez". The silencer, unlike the VSS, is not integrated, which allows the rifle to be used without it if needed. Manufactured by Tula KBP Instrument Design Bureau.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Rusak) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A collimator sight manufactured by Kazan Optical-Mechanical Plant in the mid-90s for use on hunting weapons. Installed on the Dovetail type rail, adjustment only possible after full disassembly. Heavy, uncomfortable, foggy sight with horrible parallax - a real product of its time. However, it's still slightly more effective than shooting with iron sights.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKS-74UN) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AKS-74UN (Avtomat Kalashnikov Sladnoy 74 Ukorochenny Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Shortened Automatic rifle 74 Night with a foldable stock") is a shortened version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed in the early 80s for combat vehicle crews and airborned troops, also became very popular with law enforcement and special forces for its compact size. The N (Nochnoy - "Night") version is equipped with a dovetail mount for the installation of night vision scopes.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (KATT) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A tactical tomahawk, multitool and breaching tool, all-in-one solution.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* Only obtainable by owning the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

==Trivia==
* This item was previously called and is inspired by the [https://www.gerbergear.com/en-us/shop/equipment/all-equipment/downrange-tomahawk-30-000715 Gerber Downrange Tomahawk].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-74N) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AK-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night") was developed in 1970 by M. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The key design difference from the standard AK-74 is a side mount for optical and night scopes.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (K-1S) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Kolpak-1S protects the head from the cold piercing-cutting weapons in a special class of protection GOST R50744-95, from fragmentation with an energy of impact up to 50 J, and also serves to reduce the dynamic loads arising from the above-mentioned means of destruction. Protective helmets Kolpak-1 are recommended by the Interdepartmental Commission for equipping units of the patrol service, traffic police, OMON and other special units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of Russia.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKM) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AKM (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny - Kalashnikovs Automatic Rifle Modernised) 7.62x39mm automatic rifle was was adopted in 1959 to replace AK as a standard service weapon of the Soviet Army. Main differences compared to AK: enhanced accuracy range, lower weight, new stock, trigger, hammer retarder, muzzle compensator and other design changes aimed at improving the efficiency of the rifle.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - AKM]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKS-74U) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AKS-74U (Avtomat Kalashnikova Skladnoy 74 Ukorochenny - "Kalashnikov's Shortened Automatic rifle 74 with a foldable stock") is a shortened version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed in the early 80s for combat vehicle crews and airborne troops, also became very popular with law enforcement and special forces for its compact size.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith - AKS-74U]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as initial equipment from [[Gunsmith - AKS-74U]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Shootout Picnic]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKMN) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AKMN (Avtomat Kalashnikova Modernizirovanny Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic Rifle Modernised Night") is a small arms system consisting of a modified AKM automatic rifle with a dovetail mount for installation of the NSP family night vision scopes - NSP-2/3/3A, NSPU, NSPU-M.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 5]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKMS) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AKMS (Avtomát Kaláshnikova Modernizírovanny Skladnóy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle Modernised with foldable stock") 7.62x39mm assault rifle (GRAU Index - 6P4) is a variant of the AKM rifle with a folding shoulder piece (stock). Folds forward-down, under the handguard. Designed specifically for airborne troops.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Key tool) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A special tool for storing all your keys in one convenient place.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 16 inventory slots in a 4x4 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. Only [[Keys & Intel|Keys]] can be stored in it.

==Location==
===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Warehous3Map.png|Warehouse 3 marked on map
File:CustomsWarehouse3.png|Warehouse 3
File:CustomsWareHouse3IndustrialShelf.png|Industrial shelf in warehouse 3
</gallery></li>
*"Old Gas Station":
**On the desk inside
**At the "giving tree" behind it
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-102) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AK-102 5.56x45mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base, more precisely a shortened version of AK-101. A short compact version equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The AK-102 is chambered to fire 5.56x45mm NATO ammunition, and is designed entirely for export purposes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 4]]

==Trivia==
* The "RPKT mod.1" variant is a near-identical copy of the "RPKT" which was one of the light machine guns available to the player in both of Escape From Tarkov's prequels and predecessors, "Hired Ops" and "Contract Wars"
**This machinegun sports a rather fictitious design, being described as as a modification on the basis of the AK-100 series of guns. Escape From Tarkov's rendition is pretty faithful to its Contract Wars appearance. The only significant difference being the RPKT in Escape From Tarkov lacks certain markings, and the barrel length seems to be shorter compared to the RPKTs found in Contract Wars and Hired Ops. Oddly, the RPKTs in Hired Ops and Contract Wars don't have 1.5mm RPK receivers, which would make them regular AKs, not RPKs.
* Description of the RPKT from "Contract Wars"
** ''"Modification of the RPK from 100th AK series to meet the demands of small task forces. It boasts its high cyclic rate of fire, a powerful round, and a large magazine allow operator to apply suppressing fire, forcing the enemy to lie substantially in the field. However, these advantages are mitigated by its weight, long reload and recoil."''
* Description of the RPKT from "Hired Ops"
** ''"The RPKT Machine gun, created on the base of the AK 100 series by RusTact Dynamics, for the needs of small tactical groups, it has a high rate of fire, powerful cartridge, and a drum magazine."''

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-105) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AK-105 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a further modernized version of AK-74M base. A short compact version equipped with a side-folding shoulder stock and a side mount for optical and night scopes. The 100-series AKs are produced by the Izhmash factories in Izhevsk, Russia.

* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - AK-105]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (АK-74M) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AK-74M (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 Modernizirovanny - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Modernized") 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a full-scale produced modernized version of the AK-74 that offers more versatility compared with its predecessor. Apart from several minor improvements, such as a lightened bolt and carrier assembly to reduce the impulse of the gas piston and bolt carrier during firing, the rifle features a new glass-filled polyamide stock that retains the shape of the original AK-74 fixed laminated wood stock, but side-folds to the left like the skeletonised AKS-74 buttstock, and also a dovetail side mount for installing various scopes. The AK-74M is a main service rifle of the Russian Federation.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKS-74N) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
AKS-74N (Avtomat Kalashnikov Sladnoy 74 Nochnoy - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 Night with a foldable stock") 5.45x39mm assault rifle equipped with a side-folding metal shoulder stock, designed primarily for use with air assault infantry. The key design difference from the standard AKS-74 is a side dovetail mount for optical and night scopes.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - AKS-74N]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKMSN) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (KIBA outer) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the outer door of the KIBA Arms International outlet at the ULTRA shopping mall.

==Notes==
* This is the first of two keys required to enter the KIBA firearms store. The second one is the [[Kiba Arms inner grate door key]].
* Requires the [[Interchange]] power station switch to be on in order to be used
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:PowerStationMap.png|Power station marked on map
File:InterchangePowerStation.png|The power station
File:Power switch.png|The power switch inside the station
File:PowerStationSwitchOn.png|A green light shows when the switch is turned on
</gallery></li>
* 3 seconds after opening the door an alarm will start ringing in the store and across other stores. It can be switched off at a designated terminal.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Key to KIBA Location.png|Alarm switch marked on map
File:Inter alarm terminal 2.png|Alarm switch in the security room on the first floor
</gallery></li>
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[Provocation]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* In the power station office, on a box in the metal shelf next to the cabinet
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Kiba spawn .12.png|The office
File:Kiba 2.png|The key on the metal shelf
</gallery></li>
*  At the campsite in the Goshan store, behind the two tents
<div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; text-align: center">
<div style="margin: 0 8px; width: 300px">{{#ev:youtube|YuXA6W4kGic|300x169}}</div>
<div style="margin: 0 8px">[[File:Escape From Tarkov 2019.10.08 - Kiba Key Short.webm|300x169px]]<br></div>

<div style="margin: 0 8px">[[File:NewKIBALocation2.png|300x169px]]<br>The campsite</div>
<div style="margin: 0 8px">[[File:NewKIBALocation3.png|300x169px]]<br>Key location</div>
</div>

==Lock Location==
Located on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on [[Interchange]], near the center of the mall.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

File:Kiba Door.png|The outer door to KIBA
</gallery></li>

A second locked grate door that requires the [[Kiba Arms inner grate door key]] to be opened. Visit the grate door key page for details of loot available in the store.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-74) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AK-74 (Avtomat Kalashnikova 74 - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74") 5.45x39mm assault rifle, developed in 1970 by M. T. Kalashnikov, became a further evolution of the AKM due to adoption of the new 5.45x39 ammunition by the military. The AK-74 was equipped with a new buttstock, handguard (which retained the AKM-type finger swells), and gas cylinder. The stock has a shoulder pad different from that on the AKM, which is rubber and serrated for improved seating against the shooter. In addition, there are lightening cuts on each side of the buttstock. The buttstock, lower handguard, and upper heatguard were first manufactured from laminated wood, this later changed to a synthetic, plum or dark brown colored fiberglass.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AKS-74) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AKS-74 (Avtomat Kalashnikov Sladnoy 74 - "Kalashnikov's Automatic rifle 74 with a foldable stock") 5.45x39mm assault rifle is a variant of AK-74 equipped with a side-folding metal shoulder stock, designed primarily for use with air assault infantry and developed alongside the basic AK-74. The AKS-74 stock is fabricated from stamped sheet metal struts, machine pressed into a "U" shape and assembled by punch fit and welding.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SR-25) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The SR-25 Precision Rifle is the latest evolution of the precision 7.62mm NATO semi-automatic rifle. An ambidextrous bolt release, selector, and magazine release offers the left-handed user the ergonomic advantages inherent to AR15 based controls, as well as giving right-handed users alternate methods of manipulation to increase efficiency of movement. The Drop-In 2-Stage Trigger serves as an aid to long range precision marksmanship. The E2 bolt and gas system provides superior reliability in function whether suppressed or unsuppressed. Comes in black and taupe.

==Quests==
* 1 <font color="red">black variant</font> needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 11]]
* [[The Tarkov Import]] requires 10 PMC kills using this gun with a [[SilencerCo Hybrid 46 multi-caliber sound suppressor|Hybrid 46 suppressor]] and the [[Schmidt & Bender PM II 1-8x24 30mm riflescope|PM II 1-8x24 30mm riflescope]]

==Trivia==
* The taupe color attachments added with patch [[Changelog#1.0.1.0.42625_(24_December_2025)|1.0.1.0.42625]] were described as addition of the "M110 SASS marksman rifle", while there was no new lower receiver or named variant added. The M110 SASS is based on the SR-25, but not exactly the same weapon and basically an SR-25 with a military-spec attachment package and small enhancements.
:[[File:SR-25 M110 SASS icon.png]]

* [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|Designated marksman rifles]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RFB) is an [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Kel-Tec RFB (Rifle, Forward-ejection, Bullpup) is a gas-operated bullpup type semi-automatic rifle, manufactured by Kel-Tec. Chambered in 7.62×51mm NATO/.308 Winchester ammunition. The RFB uses metric FAL magazines, which insert straight into the magazine well and do not need to rock into place. The weapon is fully ambidextrous, much in the style of the Belgian F2000 rifle. The RFB is delivered without iron sights. A mil-spec Picatinny rail is provided for mounting a wide range of optics and tactical accessories.

==Notes==
*Despite being classified as [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]], this weapon contributes EXP towards, and benefits from the [[DMRs|DMRs]] skill instead of the [[Assault Rifles|assault rifles]] skill

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Keycards) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A special small case for storing plastic cards, including key cards.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. It can only store: 
* [[Keys & Intel|Keycards]]
* [[Roubles]]
* [[Dollars]]
* [[Euros]]

==Location==
===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard

</gallery></li>
*"Old Gas Station":
**On the desk inside
**At the "giving tree" behind it
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

</gallery></li>

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PKM) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
PKM (Pulemyot Kalashnikova Modernizirovanny - "Kalashnikov's Machine Gun Modernized") is a modernized version of Kalashnikov PK machine gun, operating with 7.62x54R ammunition. The PKM proved to be a powerful, simple, reliable and effective weapon. It was in demand for many decades, starting from the late 60s of the last century and up to the present time. Manufactured by V.A. Degtyarev Plant.

==Notes==
* Unlike other weapons, the PKM cannot sustain automatic fire when switching between point-fire and aiming down sights.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PKP) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The 7.62 mm PKP "Pecheneg" is widely recognized for its reliability and firepower. Time-tested technical solutions, skillfully combined with advanced approaches to ergonomics, made it possible to increase not only the mobility of the shooter on the battlefield, but also the accuracy of fire at a distance of up to 1500 m, eliminating the effect of thermal mirage by equipping the machine gun with an over-barrel transport grip.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Unlike other weapons, the PKP cannot sustain automatic fire when switching between point-fire and aiming down sights.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 13]]

==Location==
* [[Kaban]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-12) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45 automatic rifle is the primary model of individual small arms for personnel of motorized and other units of the Russian Armed Forces. The AK-12 is a part of the Ratnik equipment system.

==Quests==
* [[Job for a Patriot]] requires 10 PMC kills using this gun with a [[AK-12 5.45x39 sound suppressor|AK-12 suppressor]] and the [[Valday PS-320 1/6x scope|PS-320 1/6x scope]] on [[Lighthouse]], [[Customs]] or [[Reserve]]

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Forge a Friendship]]

==Mods==

{{PAGENAME}} (Killa) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A limited edition Tarko figurine. Killa loves hardbass, three stripes and is waiting to meet you at the mall. Tarko's swaggiest figure, and whoever said otherwise, has been missing ever since. The figurine is rumored to be made of the same material as his helmet.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Small Business - Part 1]]
* 1 of these, or 1 of the other Boss figurines, needs to be obtained for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 1)]]
* 2 of these, or 2 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 2)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 5)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 6)]]

==Location==
*[[Safe]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Plastic suitcase]]
*[[Common fund stash]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Keys) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This case is the ultimate solution to the problem of hoarding various keys in the stash, helping to store them in one place.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 77 inventory slots in a 11x7 grid and only takes up 6 inventory slot itself. It can only store:
* [[Keys & Intel|Keys & Keycards]]
* [[Key tool]]
* [[Gingy keychain]]
* [[Keycard holder case]]

==Location==
===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Warehous3Map.png|Warehouse 3 marked on map
File:CustomsWarehouse3.png|Warehouse 3
File:CustomsWareHouse3IndustrialShelf.png|Industrial shelf in warehouse 3
</gallery></li>
*"Old Gas Station":
**On the desk inside
**At the "giving tree" behind it
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MultiTool) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
With this compact and versatile multitool there is no need to be worried about having no tools on you at the right time.

==Notes==
* The multitool is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Usage==
* When carried in a raid, it can be used to disarm [[Tripwire installation kit|Tripwires]] rapidly, reducing the disarm time from 11 seconds to 3 seconds.

==Quests==
* 1 is used in the quest [[Fishing Gear]] (1 is provided)

==Hideout==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Shooting Range level 3]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Gear Rack level 1]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (LEDX) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A medical device designed to accurately determine the position of the veins under the skin.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Crisis]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Health Care Privacy - Part 6]]

==Hideout==
* 1 needs to obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 3]]

*[[Medcase]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]
*[[Plastic suitcase]]
*[[Sport bag]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (GPNVG-18) is a [[Helmet mods#Night vision devices|night vision device]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The GPNVG-18 (Ground Panoramic Night Vision Goggles) panaromic night vision goggles. The cardinal difference of this NVG from the others is the presence of four separate image intensifier tubes, two for each eye. Two Central IITs are directed forward, while two more are directed outward from the center. This innovative solution allowed to expand the field of view to 97 degrees.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (L1) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A sterile disposable syringe with a dose of L1, based on norepinephrine. It is used for short-term increase of strength and endurance, as well as to reduce the pain effect. This activates the implementation of a physiological response such as "hit or run". Increases water and energy consumption.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Samples]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Tagilla]]
*[[Sanitar]] and his guards

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* Multiple Spawns in the [[Drug Trafficking|hidden drug lab]] in the north on the shelves, desks and on the ground.

==Trivia==
*[[Easter eggs and References]]:
**This is a reference to the content creator [https://www.twitch.tv/lvndmark Lvndmark].
**In the context of ''Escape From Tarkov,'' a “chad” is a high-level player, characterized by their equally high-level loadouts and preference for head-on fights. A “rat”, on the other hand, denotes a more timid and poorly-geared player that often avoids direct conflicts and resorts to scavenging and ambushes/“camping” for loot. “Factory rodents” refer to rats that primarily roam [[Factory]], perhaps in hopes of coming across more dead players due to the confined spaces of said map.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Lega) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]'' and ''[[Arena|Escape from Tarkov: Arena]]''.

==Description==
A medal with the Legendary Kill mark. An extremely rare reward for Arena gladiators, which can be earned by completing Ref's hardest challenges.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Postponed Reward]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Create a Distraction - Part 2]]

===[[Arena]]===
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Arena Business]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Professional Fitness - Part 2]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[All for the Show - Pyrotechnics]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Advertising Business - Part 4]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Superhuman]]
* Possible reward for daily and weekly operational tasks from [[Ref]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Leon) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==

* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Key Location==
* Can only be bartered from [[Ref]] LL4

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Labrys) is a [[Keys & Intel|Keycard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A keycard to one of Knossos facilities. The design references the Minotaur mythos, but it's somewhat strange there are no Minotaur theme parks in Tarkov.

==Notes==
* Will be consumed upon entering [[The Labyrinth]]. Will not be consumed in the practice and practice co-op game modes.
** When playing in a group, all players need their own.
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Only 2 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as initial equipment during the story chapter [[The Labyrinth (story chapter)|The Labyrinth]]
* 1 can be obtained as an initial equipment for [[Hypotheses Testing]]

==Key Location==
===[[Factory]]===
* On [[Tagilla]]

===[[The Labyrinth]]===
* On [[Shadow of Tagilla]]
* On [[Vengeful Killa]]

==Lock Location==
In the basement of the health resort west wing on [[Shoreline]]. [[Knossos LLC facility key]] required.

==Description==
Compact DeltaPoint Reflex Sight by Leupold knows almost no limits in the range of application. Originally designed for use on pump-action shotguns in competitions and practical shooting, it was recognized for good performance on a wide range of weapons. From shotguns and handguns to AR-based rifles, as a main or auxiliary sight, it will show excellent results.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (DVL-10) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
DVL-10 is a lightweight, compact, and silenced rifle in proprietary and current military subsonic calibers and has been developed for special service and combat missions where exceptional accuracy and range are needed. Equipped with a standard Lobaev foldable butt-stock and Lobaev Hummer Barrels stainless steel match-grade barrel.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 3]]
* 1 is needed for the quest [[Break the Deal]] (1 is provided)

== Quest Rewards ==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Punisher - Part 1]] (Urbana variant)
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Wet Job - Part 6]] (Saboteur variant)
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Special Comms]] (Urbana variant)

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Junk) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A large storage case for different items and goods that you may or may not need for later barters.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Cannot be stored in a [[Backpacks|backpack]].

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 196 inventory slots in a 14x14 grid and only takes up 16 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
* [[Loot|barter items]]
* [[Posters]]

==Hideout==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Scav Case]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[A Healthy Alternative]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M.U.L.E.) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Muscular Ultra Large Exciter. It is used to expand the body's abilities before long marches. It allows the body to carry an increased weight for a long time. It has shown effectiveness in combat operations in areas where transport is not available. Authorized for use by special forces soldiers. Developed by TerraGroup Labs, marked with the name M. U. L. E.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Samples]]
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Thirsty - Echo]]

==Location==
* [[Medbag SMU06]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Sanitar]] and his guards

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the USEC cottage top floor on the middle shelf facing west and on the tool cart in the garage
* In the [[Drug Trafficking|hidden drug lab]] on the tables
* In the broken wooden crates around building 1 in the water treatment area

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (LP) is a [[Containers|container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A very rare wallet model from the famous brand. Suitable for truly valuable items: cash and rare keycards.

==Notes==
* Only obtainable from paid Twitch Drops.
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. It can only store:
* [[Keys & Intel|Keycards]]
* [[Dollars]]
* [[Euros]]
* [[GP coin]]
* [[TarCoin]]
* [[Physical Bitcoin]]
* [[Minefield map (Lighthouse)]]
* [[Minefield map (Reserve)]]
* [[Minefield map (Woods)]]
* [[Note with code word Adaptation]]
* [[Note with code word Ark]]
* [[Note with code word Heartbeat]]
* [[Note with code word Onyx]]
* [[Note with code word Voron]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M18) is a [[Weapons#Smoke grenades|smoke grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The M18 smoke grenade made in the USA. Used in the US Army since the Second World War. The smoke is green-colored.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MP-155) is a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Russian MP-155 smoothbore multi-shot 12 gauge shotgun, manufactured by IzhMekh ("Izhevsky Mechanical Plant"). The gun weighs less than its predecessor MP-153 and features enhanced ergonomics and an easy-to-replace barrel mechanism. The new design also makes it easier to use for left-handed users.

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Silent Caliber]] (Ultima variant)

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Ultima Thermal) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|thermal vision sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A special thermal imaging camera for the "Ultima" modification for the MP-155 shotgun. The image from the camera is displayed on the front display on the back of the weapon. Manufactured by Kalashnikov Group.

==Notes==
* Cannot be insured.
* Cannot be put in [[secure containers]]
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* The sight can be used while point firing

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MPL-50) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
MPL-50 (Malaya Pekhotnaya Lopata 50 - "Small Infantry Spade 50") is a small spade invented by a Danish officer Mads Johan Buch Linnemann in 1869. While nominally an entrenching tool, MPL-50 saw a wide range of wartime applications ranging from a close quarters combat weapon to a cooking utensil.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AA-12 Gen 1) is a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AA-12 (Auto Assault-12) Gen 1 is a reliable full-auto 12-gauge shotgun. The first generation features the high-mounted built-in iron sights. This shotgun is distinguished by its recoil pulse accumulation, which makes the recoil feel smooth without sacrificing fire rate and stopping power. The AA-12 is designed for military and police units. Manufactured by Military Police Systems.

==Notes==
* This weapon will never [[Weapon malfunctions|malfunction]].

* In [[Drawer]]s

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MS2000) is a [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A strobe marker light that is used during nighttime operations. It emits signals in the IR region which are visible through NVGs. Uses a special filter when operating in IR mode. If the filter is removed, it appears as a bright flash in the visible spectrum. In the extended mode operates with a blue flash.

==Notes==
* The marker is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Hot Wheels - Let's Try Again]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Hot Wheels]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Trouble in the Big City]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Wet Job - Part 2]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Pyramid Scheme]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[A Fuel Matter]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Humanitarian Supplies]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Information Source]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Saving Private Roman]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Anesthesia]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Minibus]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Revision - Streets of Tarkov]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Rigged Game]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Scrap Metal]]
* 4 need to be obtained for the quest [[Health Care Privacy - Part 1]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Fuel Crisis]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Small Things, Big Help]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Tigr Safari]]
* 4 need to be obtained for the quest [[Ask for Directions]]
* 4 need to be obtained for the quest [[Assessment - Part 2]]
* 4 need to be obtained for the quest [[Energy Crisis]]
* 4 need to be obtained for the quest [[Revision - Lighthouse]]
* 5 need to be obtained for the quest [[Revision - Reserve]]
* 5 need to be obtained for the quest [[Steady Signal]]
* 1 is used in the quest [[Big Customer]] '''or''' [[Chemical - Part 4]] '''or''' [[Out of Curiosity]] (1 is provided)
* 1 is used in the quest [[Abandoned Cargo]] (1 is provided)
* 3 are used in the quest [[Black Swan]] (3 are provided)
* 1 is used in the quest [[Oil Run]] (1 is provided)
* 6 are used in the quest [[Route Deviation]] (6 are provided)

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: This marker is modeled after the [https://www.acrartex.com/products/ms-2000-m2-strobe/ MS-2000 (M2) Strobe Marker Light] made by ACR.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MRE) is a [[Provisions|provision]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
MRE (Meal, Ready-to-Eat) is an individual daily food ration developed for the United States Army. MRE packaging is designed for harsh operating conditions and protection from weather exposure, which allows not to worry about storage conditions. Contains a lot of different products to quench your hunger in the field of conditions.

==Quests==
* 5 need to be obtained for the quest [[Humanitarian Supplies]]

==Location==
* In [[Buried barrel cache]]s
* In [[Dead Scav]]s
* In [[Ground cache]]s
* In [[Sport bag]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Magazines) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A wheeled weapon magazine storage case.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in an 8x8 grid and only takes up 6 inventory slots itself. Only [[Weapon_mods#Gear_Mods|magazines]] can be stored in it.

==Location==
===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Warehous3Map.png|Warehouse 3 marked on map
File:CustomsWarehouse3.png|Warehouse 3
File:CustomsWareHouse3IndustrialShelf.png|Industrial shelf in warehouse 3
</gallery></li>
* "Old Gas Station":
** On the desk inside
** At the "giving tree" behind it
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Huntsman Path - Trophy]]

==Crafting==

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Desert Eagle L6) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Desert Eagle L6 is the modification of the .50 Action Express caliber sport-hunting pistol. This pistol is huge, heavy and not the most practical in operation, but at the same time it is an absolutely unique short-barreled weapon, which undoubtedly became a frequent visitor in video games for its brutal appearance and impressive size. The Desert Eagle did not win any military approval, but deservedly became one of the most famous pistols in the world. Manufactured by Magnum Research.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Forester's Duty]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Desert Eagle Mk XIX) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Desert Eagle (Mk XIX) is the third modification of the .50 Action Express caliber sport-hunting pistol. This pistol is huge, heavy and not the most practical in operation, but at the same time it is an absolutely unique short-barreled weapon, which undoubtedly became a frequent visitor in video games for its brutal appearance and impressive size. The Desert Eagle did not win any military approval, but deservedly became one of the most famous pistols in the world. Manufactured by Magnum Research.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PM (t)) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A semi-mythical Makarov pistol with an extended threaded barrel for equipping a sound suppressor. Some claim it was a limited production series manufactured in Bulgaria, whilst others insist on it being East German, or even a handcrafted upgrade. As for how it ended up in the Norvinsk region, no living soul could tell you now.

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[The Punisher - Part 5]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PM) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] 56-A-125.

==Description==
The time-proven PM pistol (Pistolét Makárova - "Makarov Pistol", GAU Index - 56-A-125). Due to the ubiquitous spread of both the pistol and its ammunition, as well as its exceptional reliability, light weight, and compact size, the PM still sees wide service in both police, military, and security forces. Although the damage makes you wish for the best.

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[The Punisher - Part 5]].

==Trivia==
* The ingame model used to actually be modelled off a blank-only firing replica of the Makarov, designated the MP-371, which is most easily identifiable by the shape of the triggerguard, as on the blank firing pistol, its completely flat in the front, where as in a real Makarov it has a more "oval" shape.
** A rework for the pistol was announced by Nikita on a podcast, saying it is not modelled accurately, the rework happened in the 0.13.5.0 patch.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Medicine) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A storage container for medical items

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Cannot be stored in a [[Backpacks|backpack]] and [[Secure containers]].

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in a 8x8 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
*[[Medical|Meds]]
*[[Loot#Medical supplies|Medical supplies]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Health Care Privacy - Part 6]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Crisis]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Beneath The Streets]]

==Location==
===[[Customs]]===
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* On a industrial shelf in warehouse 3 at the shipping yard
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Warehous3Map.png|Warehouse 3 marked on map
File:CustomsWarehouse3.png|Warehouse 3
File:CustomsWareHouse3IndustrialShelf.png|Industrial shelf in warehouse 3
</gallery></li>
*"Old Gas Station":
**On the desk inside
**At the "giving tree" behind it
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Bloodset) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Quests==
