'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SG-C10) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A two-way speaking military COFDM wireless AV+data Signal Transmitter SG-C10

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[From Hand to Hand]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Special Equipment]]
* 4 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Network Provider - Part 1]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Key to the Tower]]

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center level 3]]

==Location==
*[[Airdrop crate|Airdrops (Common)]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x5)]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the Dome building (White Queen)
** On the shelves in the [[RB-RLSA key|RB-RLSA]] room on the 2nd floor
** On the shelves in the [[RB-RS key|RB-RS]] room on the 2nd floor
** In the server room on the first floor. On the paracord extract side
* Inside room [[RB-AK key|RB-AK]] on the Shelves.
* Inside room [[RB-PKPTS key]].
* In [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]] marked room
* In [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]] marked room
* On roof of white pawn building on wooden crate
* In the D2 tunnel, on top of the wooden crates, racks, and blades on the ground (room where the White Queen and Bunker tunnels meet)

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* Inside broken wooden boxes
* On the tables on the docks
* Inside tents on roofs of Rogue Buildings
* Inside the small open wooden boxes in Rogue Towers
* Inside the [[Hillside house key|Hillside house]]
* Inside the [[Merin car trunk key|Merin car trunk]]
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Tarkov Merin (COFDM).png
</gallery></li>
* Inside the upper Chalet, on the dining table, next to the radio
* Outside the upper Chalet bottom floor, below the patio stairs, on a wooden crate
* Inside the [[Operating room key|Operating room]] of B1, on the desk, left of the body
* Inside the [[USEC cottage first safe key|USEC cottage first safe]] and [[USEC cottage second safe key|USEC cottage second safe]] located in the second floor of the USEC cottage in the furthest northern and southern bedrooms.
* Inside the small building with pizza on the table, just northwest of the USEC cottage, in the northwest corner chair
* In the red brick house near Path to Shoreline extract, upstairs in the gaming PC room
* Inside of [[Water treatment plant storage room key]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In [[Chekannaya 15 apartment key|Chekannaya 15 apartment]]
* In Chekannaya building in (unlocked) cell 3
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:COFDM-Streets-Chekannaya-cell3.png
</gallery></li>
* In [[Zmeisky 5 apartment 20 key|Zmeisky 5 apartment 20]] in the office
* In the room next to the [[Concordia apartment 63 room key]] on the table clipped inside some folders
* In the Concordia 63 bedroom, inside the blue suitcase on the bed.
* In [[Concordia apartment 64 key|Concordia apartment 64]] and its [[Concordia apartment 64 office room key|office room]]
* In [[Concordia apartment 34 room key|Concordia apartment 34 room]]
* In the Zmeisky 6 offices
* In [[Concordia apartment 8 home cinema key|Concordia apartment 8 home cinema]] on the floor in front of the projector screen
* In [[Car dealership closed section key|Car dealership closed section]] on the table at the edge of the room
* In [["Negotiation" room key]] On the table leaning against the wall on the right
* In [[Pinewood hotel room 215 key|Pinewood hotel room 215]] on the ground next to the black chair
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Pinewood Hotel Room 215 COFDM Spawn.png
</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Fuel) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A metal fuel tank for liquid flammable materials.

==Quests==
* 3 of these, or 3 [[Expeditionary fuel tank]]s need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[I Need More Power]]
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Natural Exchange]]

==Hideout==
* Cannot be refilled
* Can be used as fuel for the Generator in the [[Hideout]]
* When full (100/100), it powers the hideout for 21 hours 3 minutes and 9 seconds (42 hours 6 minutes and 18 seconds with solar power module, 112 hours 16 minutes and 50 seconds with solar power module and elite hideout management skill)

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Technical supply crate]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves in the OLI store
* On top of barrels on the highway near the EMERCOM tents
* On the green and white shelf in The National store
* On the shelves in the Goshan stockroom

===[[Woods]]===
* In the bunkers ZB-014 and ZB-016

===[[Customs]]===
* Loose in the warehouse east of crane yard
* Along side the train cars in the new construction zone
* On the bed in [[Dorm room 110 key|Dorm room 110]]
* In the trunk of the white van at the old gas station 

===[[Reserve]]===
* On the ground around the K buildings and the garage next to White Knight
* On the ground around fuel tanks located between the king building and the dome
* On the ground inside the ground floor of the Queen building
* In the tunnel connecting the King building and the White pawn
* On the ground inside of the blue container next to the Heating Pipe Scav extract

</gallery></li>

* At the gas station

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Meldonin) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A drug developed for athletes. Allows conducting more intensive training and recovering stamina faster. Temporarily increases strength, endurance, and also accelerates recovery. An undocumented property was also found: it increases the resistance of tissues to physical impact due to internal muscle tension. Because of its properties, it was later adopted by the military as a combat stimulant. Has side effects.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Samples]]
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==
* [[Medbag SMU06]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Sanitar]] and his guards

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[This Tape Sucks]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Maska-1SCh KE) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Unheard) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A radio transmitter reconfigured by unknown assailants. It's impossible to determine the modification technology, nor is it likely to figure out what kind of signal it's transmitting. When in the area of low intensity combat zone (PvE), the user of the device becomes visible in Fence's agent network. However, using this device, you have to follow his rules. Fence pays half of the money spent in the raid and coordinates the Scavs when searching for the user's lost equipment. If trusted enough by Fence, the user will not be attacked by Scavs as long as they keep their distance and show no aggression. In return, Fence requires to minimize damage to Scavs, and if the death of a Scav could not be avoided - to reduce the number of interference with his activities in the face of other PMCs in the area of the incident.

==Notes==
* If you own the "The Unheard" edition of the game you will start with this item.
*Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
*While a player is wearing the radio in the '''PvE''' and '''PvE co-op''' game modes:
**In-raid cash services (e.g. car extractions) have a 50% discount
**[[Insurance]] returns are 30% faster
**Killing [[Scavs]] without being shot first results in a -0.05 [[Scavs#Scav karma|Scav karma]] penalty - The penalty can be negated by killing a PMC
**[[Scav]] kill experience is reduced by 50%
**With 6+ [[Scavs#Scav karma|Scav karma]], [[Scavs]] don't shoot on sight if 60+ meters away, unless provoked
*This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Small Business - Part 3]]
:'''Note:''' The reward is only obtainable in the [[Game modes#PvE and PvE Co-op game mode|PvE game mode]] and not available to owners of the "The Unheard" edition of the game.

==Trivia==
[[Easter eggs and References]]: The item is modeled after the [[wikipedia:Personal_Role_Radio|"H4855 Personal Role Radio"]], although it is unusable as a radio in-game.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Maska-1SCh CE) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Maska-1 bulletproof protective helmet appeared in service in 1991 as a replacement for the "Sphere" helmet, designed for use by the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation armed forces. The Maska-1SCh ("Mask-1 Shield") modification features a bulletproof steel faceshield to ensure maximum protection of the user's face. Looks like Killa loves to celebrate Christmas and New Year.

==Location==
* [[Killa]]
* [[Vengeful Killa]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Money) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The TARBank armored money storage case.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 49 inventory slots in a 7x7 grid and only takes up 6 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
* [[Currency]]
* [[Physical Bitcoin]]
* [[Lega Medal]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (VPO-209) is an [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Molot VPO-209 carbine is based on the well-known Kalashnikov AKM and has an almost identical appearance, weight, and overall dimensions. It has a smooth bore barrel with the last 120 mm of the barrel being rifled (a so called "paradox"-bore). VPO-209 is chambered in .366 TKM, that together with the "paradox" rifling classifies the weapon as a shotgun under Russian law.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Extortionist]].
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Survivalist Path - Unprotected but Dangerous]].

* These are usually surplus AKM rifles, Smooth-bored or entirely rebarreled to .366 (or 9.55mm) by a factory (such as Molot) which can then be certified, sold and registered under a shotgun license in Russia e.g. to hunters, which is much easier to obtain.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mosin Sniper) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Mosin–Nagant M91/30 PU is a sniper variant of the famous russian rifle, which was commonly in use by russian snipers during WW2.

==Notes==
It should be noted that when reloading the weapon with a round still in the chamber, said round will be ejected onto the ground and can be recovered by being picked up. The rifle can contain a max of 5+1 rounds, but can only be loaded in the field up to 4+1. If reloaded by dragging the ammo to the rifle in your inventory while it is not currently being held, it can be reloaded back to 5.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mosin Infantry) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Mosin–Nagant is one of the most famous russian rifles, which was commonly used by Russian soldiers during WW2. Developed from 1882 to 1891, it was used by the armed forces of the Russian Empire, the Soviet Union and various other nations. It is one of the most mass-produced military bolt-action rifles in history with over 37 million units having been made since 1891. In spite of its age, it has been used in various conflicts around the world up to the present day.

==Notes==
It should be noted that when reloading the weapon with a round still in the chamber, said round will be ejected onto the ground and can be recovered by being picked up. The rifle can contain a max of 5+1 rounds, but can only be loaded in the field up to 4+1. If reloaded by dragging the ammo to the rifle in your inventory while it is not currently being held, it can be reloaded back to 5.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (VPO-101) is an [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A semi-automatic 7.62x51mm caliber hunting carbine. It was created on the platform of Kalashnikov machine gun (RPK) and has a similar appearance, weight and dimensions. Designed for professional and amateur hunting of medium and big game, as well as sporting use.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PFilter) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A military power filter used in armored vehicles.

==Quests==
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the story chapter [[Boreas]] if the [[Armored case]] was not given to [[Prapor]] in [[Falling Skies]]

==Hideout==
* 5 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Air Filtering Unit]]
* 5 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Bitcoin Farm level 2]]
* 10 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Solar Power]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Toolbox]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]

===[[Reserve]]===
*In the [[RB-ST key|RB-ST warehouse]]

===[[Woods]]===
* At the train depot as loose loot (access via [[BTR Driver|BTR]])
* Multiple loose spawns in the Bunker under the Mountain ([[Hindsight 20/20]])
* Multiple loose spawns behind crashed plane
* Multiple loose spawns in the [[Old house room key]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Dressed to Kill]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Surveillance]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Hot Wheels]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Hypotheses Testing]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M7290) is a [[Weapons#Stun grenades|stun grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Model 7290 is a standard distracting explosive device. Produces 175 dB and a powerful light flash.

==Notes==
* When looking at the explosion, [[File:Stun.png|46px|Stun]] is added for 40 seconds, causing a blinding effect that starts to fade out after 20 seconds, as well as a visual impairment which lasts 90 seconds
* Within a 10m radius around the explosion, [[File:contusion.png|46px|Concussion]] is added for 20 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio

==Location==
*[[Grenade box]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Ground cache]]

==Gallery==
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:flashbang_aftermath.png|View with the 90 second lasting visual impairment
</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MSGL) is a [[Weapons#Grenade launchers|revolver grenade launcher]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
M32A1 MSGL 40mm six-shot grenade launcher manufactured by Milkor USA. This grenade launcher uses the well-established principle of a revolver to achieve a high rate of accurate fire that can be quickly aimed at a target.

==Notes==

* Due to its revolver magazine mechanism this weapon contributes EXP towards, and benefits from the [[revolvers]] skill.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mines) is an [[Keys & Intel#Extraction_intel|extraction intel]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Someone had sketched a hand-drawn diagram of the perimeter of the Federal Reserve military base in its northwestern part. According to the notes, there is a gap in the minefield that could be used for a safe exfil.

==Notes==
* Activates the "Exit to Woods" extraction on [[Reserve]].
* Cannot be taken out of a raid

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Data) was an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An unassuming thumb drive. Contains classified military data which was not taken out of the city in time. It's best to gather as many of these as you can. Just in case.

==Quests==
* 11+ need to be obtained for the quest [[Progression Difficulties - Part 2]]

==Location==
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Common fund stash]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Drawer]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Jacket]]
* [[Plastic suitcase]]
* [[Safe]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Weapon box (5x5)]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (CS gas) is a [[Weapons#Gas grenades|gas grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A non-lethal gas grenade containing an irritant agent. Active emission lasts 20–40 seconds, while dispersion and dissipation depend on environmental conditions.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Only 12 can be held in the raid inventory at the same time, while only 3 can be brought into a raid.
* Within the gas cloud [[File:Tremor.png|46px|Hands tremor]] and the tear gas asphyxiation effect is added, preventing the use of medical items, draining stamina, causing eye irritations and coughing as well as damage to the thorax (2 HP/second).
** Wearing a [[Respirator]] or [[Gentex Ops-Core SOTR respirator]] protects against the thorax damage and coughing, while wearing a [[GP-5 gas mask]], [[GP-7 gas mask]] or [[Avon M53A1 gas mask]] protects against everything.

==Location==
* [[The Wedge]]
* [[Black Division]] on [[Icebreaker]]

==Gallery==
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Gas grenade view.png|View with the eye irritations
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Holodilnick) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Special thermal-electric bag for food storage. The Mr. Holodilnick bag chills anything, even the most unchillable.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 64 inventory slots in a 8x8 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
*[[Provisions]]
*[[Can of Majaica coffee beans]]
*[[Can of Dr. Lupo's coffee beans]]
*[[42 Signature Blend English Tea]]
*[[Pack of Arseniy buckwheat]]

==Trading==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Hor Rod icon.png|frameless|link=Can of Hot Rod energy drink]] x10<br/>[[Can of Hot Rod energy drink]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Tar Cola icon.png|frameless|link=Can of TarCola soda]] x5<br/>[[Can of TarCola soda]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Herring icon.png|frameless|link=Can of herring]] x5<br/>[[Can of herring]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Squash Spread icon.png|frameless|link=Can of squash spread]] x5<br/>[[Can of squash spread]]

[[Mr. Holodilnick thermal bag]]
|}

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]:
** It refers to the content creator "Mr. Holodilnick"
** Holodilnick (Холодильник) can be translated from Russian to "Refrigerator"
** The Mr. Holodilnick thermal bag is modeled after the [https://www.mobicool.com/en-ca/ca/products/cool-bags/outdoor-cool-bags/mobicool-s32-_-180114 Mobicool S32]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (THOR CRV) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The THOR Concealable Reinforced Vest enables the overt or covert carrying of soft ballistic panels providing 360 degrees protection against high-speed fragments and handgun ammunition. Adding hard ballistic plates enables protection against rifle ammunition for the vital organs. The ergonomic shape of the soft ballistic panels and the position of the back plate combined with the integrated lumbar support belt provides comfort and stability close to the body’s center of mass. Manufactured by NFM.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (COMM 3) is a [[Backpacks|backpack]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The NICE Frame special system for carrying oversized or heavy loads with an installed COMM 3 backpack for carrying radio systems. The COMM 3 main bay is designed for PRC117F or G, PRC119F, 152, or ASIP radios. The Hitchhiker and Daypack lid allows you to carry separate gear if needed. The modular NICE COMM 3 system is ready to adapt to changing tasks. An extremely rare thing, for which a real hunt is conducted in Tarkov.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Bagariy) is an [[Chest rigs#Armored|armored chest rig]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
In the second millennium, the equipment of a soldier received serious changes in view of new threats and tasks. A better level of protection was required, so the Russian army needed a reliable and functional body armor. In the mid-2000s, the MVD, which was later reorganized into the Russian Guard, received Bagariy bulletproof vests. Bagariy was used both by ordinary soldiers of the internal troops, and in special forces. Actively was used by PMC BEAR as the main heavy body armor.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Chek. 13) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A mysterious key from an unknown door located at house 13 Chekannaya Street. There is a strange symbol scratched on the key.

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[Broadcast - Part 5]]
* Used in the story chapter [[Blue Fire]] when you don't have a [[Car dealership closed section key]]
* Used in the story chapter [[The Ticket]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Drawer]]s
* In [[Jacket]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Location==
Marked room on the first floor of the Chekannaya 13 apartment building at [[Streets of Tarkov]].
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Mysterious marked key onmap.png|Room marked on map
File:Mysterious key building entrance.png|Entrance to the building through a window from the courtyard
File:Mysterious key path1.png|Once inside, get in the corridor and move to the second room on the left
File:Mysterious key path2.png|In the bedroom, go through the hole in the wall
File:Mysterious key path3.png|After going through the hole, get downstairs and open the door to the left
File:Mysterious key room door.png|You get in front of the door to unlock

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Finka) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A replica of the Soviet combat knife crafted by Norvinsk masters, based on Finnish and Swedish designs. Originally used as a utility tool and, when necessary, in combat, the Finka earned a reputation for simplicity and reliability. Its design provides a comfortable, secure grip. Today, it serves more as a collectible piece than a practical weapon.

==Requirements==
* Only obtainable by reaching [[Prestige]] level 5 in the PvP game mode.

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:NKVD_Finka_knife_tool.png|link=NKVD Finka knife]] x1<br/>[[NKVD Finka knife]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Bitcoin icon.png|link=Physical Bitcoin]] x1<br/>[[Physical Bitcoin]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]]</big><br/>10 minutes
!<big>→</big>

|}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (NICE Load Sling) is a [[Backpacks|backpack]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Load Sling by Mystery Ranch allows to carry heavy, irregularly shaped cargo. Its strap system secures items safely and reliably, while the external MOLLE straps provide versatile attachment points for smaller gear. This particular model is equipped with a spacious case offering extra protection.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Location==
* [[Black Division]] (Not on [[Icebreaker]])

==Trading==

!<big>→</big>

==Trivia==
* The backpack is modeled after the [https://www.mysteryranch.com/nice-frame-bvs-pack Mystery Ranch NICE Frame] fitted with the company's [https://www.mysteryranch.com/load-sling Load Sling] system, carrying a [https://www.pelican.com/us/en/product/cases/1510?sku=1510PB-000-110 Pelican 1510 Protector Carry-On Case] in OD Green.
* The webbing attached to the load sling is outfitted with several commercially available accessories, including:
** Three [https://thyrm.com/collections/cellvault/products/cell-vault-battery-storage THYRM CellVault Battery Storage] containers in orange.
** Three [https://www.milspecplastics.com/cobra-cuffs/ CobraCuffs Foldable Cobra Cuffs] in black.
** One CobraCuffs Foldable Cobra Cuff in tan.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (2 Day Assault) is a [[Backpacks|backpack]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This Mystery Ranch backpack is designed for short missions of up to two days. Its compact size is offset by excellent ergonomics. External straps provide convenient attachment points for tools and gear you might need on the go.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Location==
* [[Black Division]] (Not on [[Icebreaker]])

Multiple accessories from various manufacturers are attached to the bag, including:
* Two [https://thyrm.com/collections/all/products/cell-vault-battery-storage Thyrm CellVault CR123 & AAA] in the "Rescue" color variant
* A [https://www.hydroflask.com/32-oz-wide-mouth HydroFlask Wide Mouth 32oz Bottle] in Tonal Black
* A [https://www.carinthia.eu/en/expedition-cover-gore-p1502/ Caranthia Expedition Cover Gore] in Olive
* An Imminent Threat Solutions (ITS) Tallboy Trauma Pouch in Black
* Trauma Shears.

A patch at the top says "Mystery Brunch" rather than the Mystery Ranch brand

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mys. tape) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An audio tape that somehow ended up in the safe at station 14-4 KORD. Either someone slipped it in unnoticed when the server room’s cooling system was activated, or ''they'' already knew what would happen.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[They Are Already Here]]

==Content==
[[File:Mysterious audio tape audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Priest: The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.

Priest: Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.

Priest: I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.

Priest: Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…

[[Category:Audio tapes]]

[[ru:Таинственная аудиокассета]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Kora-Kulon EMR) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Kora-Kulon bulletproof vest is a means of individual armor protection of long-term wear, allowing to perform all types of professional activities of the personnel of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Ministry of Defense units. The design of the bulletproof vest allows its use in concealed operation under outer clothing. Designed to protect the wearer from firearms and sharp weapons. EMR (Digital Flora) camouflage version.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Kora-Kulon) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Kora-Kulon bulletproof vest is a means of individual armor protection of long-term wear, allowing to perform all types of professional activities of the personnel of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Ministry of Defense units. The design of the bulletproof vest allows its use in concealed operation under outer clothing. Designed to protect the wearer from firearms and sharp weapons. Black version.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Nailhead) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A limited edition Tarko figurine. What's more strange: the pale skin or the nails stuck in his head? It looks like this poor guy has experienced the full spectrum of human pain.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Location==
===[[The Labyrinth]]===
* On [[Shadow of Tagilla]]
* In different locations in spawn chamber 2.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

File:Nailhead figurine spawn 3.png|On the 2nd floor ontop the stacked metal shelves
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Nooby) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
In small doses, potassium iodide is used to treat thyroid disorders and is widely available. Larger doses of 65 mg and above are rare, typically reserved for nuclear accident response operations. Usually stored at nuclear facilities or held by military and emergency services.

==Quests==
* 10 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[War Never Changes]]

==Location==
===[[Icebreaker]]===
* On the desk next to the computer screen in the examination room on level 1

</gallery></li>

</gallery></li>

* On shelves inside the [[Compartment C-3 keycard|Laboratory]] office
* Under a desk at the staircase on level 4
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Nooby Level 4 Desk Spawn.png
</gallery></li>
* On the bed inside room 32 on level 6
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Nooby Room No32 Spawn.png
</gallery></li>
* On the desk inside room 16 on level 3
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Nooby Room No16 Spawn.png
</gallery></li>
* On top of boxes inside the room 01 on level 1
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (QBZ-191) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A Chinese 5.8x42 assault rifle developed by Norinco as the successor to the QBZ-95. Featuring a conventional layout, fully ambidextrous controls, and a full-length optics rail, it was designed to improve ergonomics, modularity, and overall combat effectiveness.

==Notes==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (OKP-7) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The original design of OKP sights allows firing from unstable positions in rapidly changing conditions, reduces the operator fatigue, and, if necessary, allows unhindered use of base mechanical sights. The key feature of this sight is a rimless reflector attachment that doesn't block any field of fire sections; instead, reflector is protected by thin and durable visor that is almost un-noticeable when firing.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (OKP-7 DT) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The original design of OKP sights allows firing from unstable positions in rapidly changing conditions, reduces the operator fatigue, and, if necessary, allows unhindered use of base mechanical sights. The key feature of this sight is a rimless reflector attachment that doesn't block any field of fire sections; instead, reflector is protected by thin and durable visor that is almost un-noticeable when firing. This variant is installed on the dovetail type mount.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (T-5000M) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
ORSIS T-5000M is a Russian bolt-action sniper rifle. It was the first product developed by ORSIS, and is produced in their Moscow factory. The rifle was introduced in 2011 at the international exhibition of Russian weapons in Nizhny Tagil, and is entirely original, using no third-party components. The rifle ensures maximum comfort of the user while aiming and shooting, featuring a quick sighting line recovery, high reliability and ergonomics. The stainless steel barrel has a thread for installing a muzzle brake-compensator or a sound suppressor. The equipped muzzle brake-compensator effectively reduces impulse and allows the most comfortable recoil handling.

==Quests== 
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 12]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Dolbos 2) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A syringe with a homemade drug, developed by Sanitar. A new version of the old classic. Looks like TerraGroup Labs' experiments did not end with the closure of TerraGroup Labs itself.

==Quests==
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==
===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* TerraGroup office in the alley behind the Klimov shopping mall, on the desks in the cubicles

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Code) is an [[Keys & Intel#Extraction_intel|extraction intel]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
It seems that "Voron" is some kind of cipher or code. If someone has manipulated the exfils from Customs, they must have left access only for their own. The question is, where are these exits?

==Notes==
* Activates the "Smugglers' Boat" and "Smugglers' Bunker (ZB-1012)" extractions on [[Customs]].
* Cannot be taken out of a raid

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Mastichin figurine icon.png|link=Mastichin figurine]] x1<br/>[[Mastichin figurine]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Cultist Circle]]</big><br/>[[Hideout#Unique_Sacrifices|Unique Sacrifice]]<br/>1 h 6 min
!<big>→</big>
![[File:Voron Icon.png|link=Voron's hideout key]] x1<br/>[[Voron's hideout key]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Note with code word Voron icon.png|link=Note with code word Voron]] x1<br/>[[Note with code word Voron]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Raven figurine icon.png|link=Raven figurine]] x1<br/>[[Raven figurine]]
|}

==Trivia==
* The word "voron" stands for "raven" in Russian, which is possibly a codename for a smuggler.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Nuts&Bolts) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Despite everything, an empty coffee can remains one of the best containers for storing various small construction hardware.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 9 inventory slots in a 3x3 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself.It can only store:
* [[Screw nuts]]
* [[Bolts]]
* [[Pack of nails]]
* [[Pack of screws]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (OScope) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A medical device for diagnostic eye examination.

==Quests==
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Crisis]]

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Medstation level 3]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Medcase]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]

=== [[Woods]] ===
*At the back of the white container with corpses in the Emercom camp
*On the shelves in Emercom camp towards Lumber Mill
*Under the Bloody stretcher in the USEC camp

===[[The Lab]]===
*In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)|laboratory block]] on the second floor
*In the [[TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key|Arsenal storage room]]
*In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow)]]
*In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Violet)]]
*In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Red)]]
*In [[Keycard with a blue marking|Sanitar's]] room
*In the medical hut (on the left of the orange dome)

===[[Shoreline]]===
*In any medical loot spawn room such as [[Health Resort west wing room 301 key|West wing 301]] and [[Health Resort east wing room 226 key|East wing 226]]

===[[Reserve]]===
*In [[RB-SMP key|RB-SMP]] on the shelves

===[[Interchange]]===
*In Mantis
*In [[ULTRA medical storage key|ULTRA medical storage]]
*In [[NecrusPharm pharmacy key|NecrusPharm pharmacy]]
*In [[EMERCOM medical unit key|Emercom Medical]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Firesteel) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A strange thing classified as a firesteel is an ancient device for making fire. Another antique item.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Toolbox]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Technical supply crate]]

===[[Customs]]===
* In [[Dorm room 314 marked key|Marked room]].
* In [[Gas station office key|Gas station manager's office]].
* In Storage building on the shelves.

===[[Woods]]===
* Marked circle
* On the blue shelves inside main/grey warehouse in sawmill.
* On the stack of green crates in the old sawmill two story barn's first floor.
* On the tool chest behind the UN Tigr truck inside the Emercom Camp.

===[[Shoreline]]===
* In locked [[Health Resort west wing room 301 key|West wing room 301]].
* On the shelves inside the shop closest to swamps in the village next to tunnel extraction.
* On the desk next to the safe in the weather station.
* On the mattress or shelf inside the Chairmans house, on the west side of the swamp.
* On the shelves near the hole in Admin, 2nd floor.

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves lining the shipment loading areas of all 3 anchor stores.
* Possible spawn on the oil barrels at the Hole in Fence extraction.

===[[The Lab]]===
* Caged robot arms area between the server room and the weapons testing area.

===[[Reserve]]===
* In locked rooms [[RB-AM key|RB-AM]] and [[RB-GN key|RB-GN]].

The '''Object #21WS keycard''' (#21WS) is a [[Keys & Intel|Keycard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An electronic limited-use access keycard that, according to the logo on the front, belongs to TerraGroup.

==Notes==
* Requires the [[Interchange]] power station switch to be on in order to be used
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:PowerStationMap.png|Power station marked on map
File:InterchangePowerStation.png|The power station
File:Power switch.png|The power switch inside the station
File:PowerStationSwitchOn.png|A green light shows when the switch is turned on
</gallery></li>
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[Provocation]]
* This is a required location for the quest [[Irresistible]]

==Key Location==
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]
* On [[Cultists]]
* On [[The Goons]]
* In [[Valuables crate (Rare)|Rare valuables crates]]

===[[Factory]]===
* On [[Tagilla]]

===[[Customs]]===
* On [[Partisan]]
* At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
* At the "giving tree" behind the "Old Gas Station":
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Woods]]===
* On [[Partisan]]
* On [[Shturman]]

===[[Shoreline]]===
* On [[Partisan]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On [[Killa]]
* On [[Tagilla]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* On [[Glukhar]]
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* On [[Kaban]]
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* On [[Partisan]]
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

===[[The Lab]]===
* In [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)|Kruglov's office (R22)]] and the safe inside of it

==Lock Location==
Located south west of the mall in a container lot on [[Interchange]]. On the red TerraGroup container that is stacked on top of other containers.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:21WSMap.png|Container location marked on map
File:21ws outside.jpg|The red container
</gallery></li>

==Behind The Lock==
* Loose loot ([[Weapon mods]], [[Loot#Valuables|Valuables]])
* 1x [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* 1x [[Weapon box (6x3)]]
* 1x [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* 1x [[SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun]] spawn
* 1x [[HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam)]] spawn
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:21 ws inside.jpg|Inside the container
File:Trooper spawn 21WS.png|Trooper spawn on the table
</gallery></li>

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Vpx tool.png|frameless|link=VPX Flash Storage Module]] x1<br/>[[VPX Flash Storage Module]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Rfid tool.png|frameless|link=UHF RFID Reader]] x1<br/>[[UHF RFID Reader]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Secure Flash drive Icon.png|frameless|link=Secure Flash drive]] x5<br/>[[Secure Flash drive]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:21ws icon.png|frameless|link=Object 21WS keycard]] x1<br/>[[Object 21WS keycard]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:SMT Icon.png|frameless|link=Secure magnetic tape cassette]] x1<br/>[[Secure magnetic tape cassette]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center level 2]]</big><br/>65 h 33 min 20 sec
!<big>→</big>
![[File:11sr icon.png|frameless|link=Object 11SR keycard]] x1<br/>[[Object 11SR keycard]]
|}

==Trivia==
* The serial code on the front side of the keycard is "000496855 076 5346" and the inscription at the back side is "Area code 14-4-KORD TGSWCAT-3". 
* The "WS" in 21WS stands for Weapon Stash.

* On [[Kaban]]
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* On [[Partisan]]
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory

===[[The Lab]]===
* In [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)|Kruglov's office (R22)]] and the safe inside of it

==Lock Location==
Behind a urinal that is located in the men's toilet at the "Burger spot" restaurant on the second floor of the mall on [[Interchange]]. The keypad is revealed upon flushing the urinal.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
11SRBurgerMap.png|Toilet location marked on map
BurgerSpotToilets.png|The men's toilet
UrinalFlush.png|The urinal that needs to be flushed
KeycardPanel.png|The keycard panel
KeycardPanelActivated.png|A green light shows when the panel is activated
</gallery></li>

==Behind The Lock==
Unlocks the door to the Saferoom Exfil extraction on [[Interchange]] that is located in the parking lot section C. 
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:SafeRoomMap.png|Saferoom Exfil extraction marked on map
File:IC-Saferoom EXFIL.png|The door to Saferoom Exfil extraction
File:Saferoom inside.jpg|Inside the Saferoom Exfil extraction
</gallery></li>

On the inside can be found:
* Multiple [[Weapon mods]] spawns
* 1x [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* 1x [[Weapon box (6x3)]]
* 1x [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* Modded [[M4A1]]'s
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:M4A1 weapon spawn.png
File:M4a1 spawn 11sr.png
</gallery></li>
* Rare item spawns
* A switch to open the green TerraGroup Object 14 Container that can also contain [[Weapons]] and [[Weapon mods]]
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Object14Map.png|Object 14 marked on map
File:Object_14_Container_Location_-_Interchange.png|The group of containers that encloses the Object 14 Container
File:Object 14.png|In front of the Object 14 Container
File:Object 14 inside.jpg|Inside Object 14
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (P22) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A combat stimulant. Developed by TerraGroup Labs, marked as P22. It allows the tissues of the body to receive less damage when physically exposed due to passive inclusion in the work of internal muscles. It is used to expand the bodys abilities before a fight. Authorized for use by special forces soldiers. Has side effects.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Samples]]

*[[Sanitar]] and his guards

* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Depot) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to one of the rooms in an old house somewhere on the edge of the Priozersk forest. It is said that a person nicknamed Ogryzok used to trade in these parts. He used to sell rare goods including even a steady supply of tank batteries. Yet nothing had long been heard of Ogryzok, and no one knows where he had disappeared to.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PB) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The PB silenced pistol (Pistolét Besshúmnyy - "Silenced Pistol", GRAU Index 6П9) was designed with a two-part suppressor, the main suppressor and a section built into the barrel, which allows the weapon to be operated without problems even without the main suppressor attached, but operating the weapon this way will not mitigate the sound or muzzle flash. It was intended for army reconnaissance groups and USSR KGB personnel and introduced into service in 1967. Still operated nowadays by FSB special forces and internal troops of Ministry of Internal Affairs.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PACA) is an [[Armor vests|armor vest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A light but durable and reliable body armor protecting only the vital areas.

==Quests==
* Can be used for [[Prapor]]'s quest [[The Punisher - Part 5]]
* Can be used for [[Ref]]'s quest [[Balancing - Part 2]]

==Location==
* On [[Dead Scav|Dead Scavs]]
*On [[Scavs]]
* On [[Scav Raiders]]
*In [[Weapon box (4x4)|Weapon Boxes (4x4)]]

=== [[Customs]] ===
* On the chair closest to the window in the first room in the [[Tarcone Director's office key|red paradigm warehouse office]]
* On [[Reshala|Reshala's]] Followers

=== [[Reserve]] ===
* On [[Glukhar]] and his followers

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PNB) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A combat stimulant. Developed by TerraGroup Labs, labeled PNB. Allows a short-term activation of the inner muscles, bringing them into a state of hypertonicity, which in turn reduces the received damage. At the same time there is an active synthesis of proteins for accelerated tissue regeneration. Used for the expansion of the organism abilities at the key moment of the combat. Allowed for use by Special Forces. Has some side effects.

==Location==
===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PP-9 Klin) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The PP-9 Klin is a further evolution of the Kedr submachine gun. It has a higher rate of fire and its chamber is designed to use the 9x18 PMM cartridge. It was produced from 1996 to 2002 by order of the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

==Notes==
* The {{PAGENAME}} can fire [[9x18mm PMM PstM gzh]] ammunition while the [[PP-91 Kedr]] and [[PP-91-01 Kedr-B]] can not.
* Folding the stock will not affect the recoil of this weapon.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PP-91 Kedr) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The PP-91 Kedr is a submachine gun chambered in 9x18 PM, designed by Yevgeny Dragunov in the early 90s by order of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and produced at ZMZ (Zlatoústovskiy Mashinostroíteinyy Zavód - "Zlatoust Machine-Building Plant"). This submachine gun has a simple but effective design. Its light weight makes it more comfortable to cary without affecting its performance, and it provides a high rate of fire without affecting its recoil. Thanks to these characteristics, it's still used as a service weapon in almost all Russian law enforcement agencies.

==Notes==
* While the {{PAGENAME}} can hold [[9x18mm PMM PstM gzh]] ammunition in its magazine, it can not fire it.
* Folding the stock will not affect the recoil of this weapon.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Sodium) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An acidic salt of carbonic acid and sodium. It is usually a fine-grained white powder. Used in the food industry, in cooking, in medicine as a neutralizer of skin burns and mucous membranes of human acids and reducing the acidity of gastric juice.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PR-Taran) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The PR-Taran baton with side handle is used by law enforcement agencies for protection and crowd control.

==Notes==
*While [[Kollontay]] has this weapon equipped, currently held weapons of players in his proximity forcefully jam due to the [[File:Panic attack.png|46px|Panic attack]] effect. 

==Quests==
*1 needs to be [[Found in raid|found <font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[The Huntsman Path - Crooked Cop]]

==Location==
* [[Kollontay]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SAG MK1) is a [[Weapon mods#Vital parts|gas block]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A combined kit consisting of a handguard and a milled gas tube designed to improve the performance of the PP-19-01 Vityaz and the Saiga-9 civilian carbine. The handguard is equipped with an M-LOK interface for installing additional equipment, and the gas tube has a picatinny rail for mounting sights and tactical units. Manufactured by Sureshot Armament Group.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PSU) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
PC power supply unit can be easily converted from powering PCs to a universal charger for all kinds of low-voltage rechargeable batteries and devices.

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 10 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Bitcoin Farm|Bitcoin Farm level 1]]
* 10 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Bitcoin Farm|Bitcoin Farm level 2]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Generator|Generator level 3]]

==Location==
*[[PC block]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

==Quest rewards==
* 4 can be obtained as a reward for completing [[Peacekeeper]]'s quest [[Gifts from Tarkov]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Pistols) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A small case for pistol and ammunition storage.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 12 inventory slots in a 4x3 grid and only takes up 4 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
*[[Weapons#Pistols|Pistols]]
*[[Weapons#Revolvers|Revolvers]]
*[[Weapons#Signal pistols|Signal pistols]]
*[[Weapon_mods#Gear_Mods|Magazines]]
*[[Ammunition]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (0.2BTC) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A physical equivalent of the Bitcoin cryptocurrency (0.2 BTC value).

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* Can be produced in the [[Hideout#Modules|Bitcoin farm]] every 83 hours 20 minutes, when having one [[Graphics card]] installed. 
* The value of this item is linked to the real world Bitcoin price. This has been confirmed by Nikita, the COO of Battlestate Games on [https://www.reddit.com/r/EscapefromTarkov/comments/7zo50v/bitcoin_worth_in_tarkov_is_tied_to_real_world/dur4dwy/ Reddit].
** The value is refreshed each day at midnight GMT+4.

==Quests==
* 15 need to be obtained for the quest [[Old Patterns]] (Quest unavailable for "The Unheard" game edition owners)
* 15 need to be obtained for the quest [[Profit Retention]]
* 40 need to be obtained for the story chapter [[The Ticket]] if the player did not refuse to work with Mr. Kerman

==Location==
* [[Safe]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Plastic suitcase]]
* [[Common fund stash]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Jacket]]

===[[Customs]]===
* In the Customs [[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]] in the 3 story dorms
* In the right side of the depot building northwest of zb-1011
* On the bed next to the duffle bag in [[Dorm room 218 key|room 218]] in the 2 story dorms
* In the north east side of the basement in warehouse 4

===[[Factory]]===
* On the back of the pick-up truck near the middle of the map

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the couch and shelf of [[11SR|Saferoom Exfil (#11SR)]]
* In the lockers in the front end of Goshan
* On a plastic chair in OLI. (In the middle of the store surrounded by sandbags)
* On the yellow couch inside the closed off section next to [[Interchange underground utility plan]] exfil

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the south chalet, on the table to the right of the entrance, and on the seats
* On the tool chest near the first BRDM marked for [[Revision - Lighthouse]]
* Inside of the [[Water treatment plant storage room key|Water treatment plant storage room]]
* Inside of the [[Operating room key|Operating room]]
* Inside of the [[Rogue USEC barrack key|Rogue USEC barrack room]]
* In the [[Merin car trunk key|Merin car trunk]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* On a chair in the last room on the top floor of the white knight building
* In marked rooms [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]], and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Shoreline]]===
* In cardboard box in bathroom of [[Health Resort east wing room 222 key|Health Resort east wing room 222]]
* On desks in [[Health Resort east wing room 310 key|Health Resort east wing room 310]]
* To the right of the laptop on the mattress in [[Health Resort east wing room 306 key|Health Resort east wing room 306]]
* Next to the [[Weapon box (6x3)|weapon box]] in [[Health Resort east wing room 226 key|Health Resort east wing room 226]]
* On the blue tray of the cart near the admin basement
* On the tables inside of the metal containers in Smugglers Base

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* On the floor of the [[Beluga restaurant director key|director's office]] in the Beluga restaurant
* On the chairs inside of the [[Relaxation room key|Relaxation room]] as well as in front of the mannequin
* On the couch inside of the Beluga restaurant's 2nd floor behind the door
* Inside of the [[Abandoned factory marked key]] 
* Inside of [[Mysterious room marked key|Chek. 13]]
* Inside of [[Chekannaya 15 apartment key]] in multiple locations
* Inside of [[MVD academy entrance hall guard room key]] in multiple locations; notably next to the water cooler, on the photocopier and next to the green chair
* Next to the trophies in the trophy cabinet in [[PE teacher's office key|PE teacher's office]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Inside of the [[TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key|laboratory security arsenal (R23)]] on the shelves
* Inside of the blue office, on the floor and table
* Inside of the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Red)|Red card room]], on the shelf to the left of the gated room
* In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Violet)|Violet card room]] on the floor
* In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow)|Yellow card room]] in multiple locations on both the floor as well as the couch chairs
* In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)|Kruglov's office (R22)]] both in the safe located in the far back of the office as well as in multiple locations in the office itself: Under the binders on the floor, on the coffee table, on the couch, in front of the laptop on the desk, in front of the computer on the floor
* In the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)|Green card room]] In the room to the left after entering on the floor between the table on the left and the shelve as well as on the chair to the right and on the floor next to it 
* In the [[TerraGroup Labs residential unit keycard|Res Unit card room]] on the bean bag chair

===[[Woods]]===
* Sniper Scav Bunker near the sealed door
* Underneath a bed inside the eastern-most house of the eastern village
* Inside the steeple of the church in Sunken Village
* Inside the crashed plane before the cockpit entrance on the ground
* In the door frame of the stash house in Sunken Village
* On the beds at the train depot
* On a bed in the bathroom inside the bunker under the mountain 
* On the grave site for lost Bear unit

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Import]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Fertilizers]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Small Business - Part 2]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[New Beginning (Prestige 5)]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[New Beginning (Prestige 6)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Paracord) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A lightweight polymeric cord made of nylon, originally used in parachute slings. Paracord can be used for many other purposes, both military and civilian.

==Notes==
* Required for the "Cliff Descent" extraction on [[Reserve]] along with a [[Red Rebel ice pick]].
* Required for the "Mountain Pass" extraction on [[Lighthouse]] along with a [[Red Rebel ice pick]].
* Required for the "Climber's Trail" extraction on [[Shoreline]] along with a [[Red Rebel ice pick]].
* The item is not consumed upon extraction.
* The item is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quests==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Defib) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Sudden cardiac arrest (SCA) can happen to anyone, anytime, anywhere. Phipils uses SMART Biphasic technology in its HeartStart Defibrillators to deliver an effective, high current defibrillation shock at a lower energy dose to minimize side effects.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Crisis]]

===[[Interchange]]===
*In the [[EMERCOM medical unit key|EMERCOM medical unit]]
*In the Mantis Store
*In the [[ULTRA medical storage key|ULTRA medical storage room]]
*In multiple locations inside of the medical tents in the Scav camp infront of the mall
*In the medical tent in the Gnezdo Outpost on the ground under the metal shelves

===[[Shoreline]]===
*In [[Health_Resort_east_wing_room_209_key|East wing room 209]] on the table with the monitor
*In Sanitar's Office, [[Health Resort office key with a blue tape|East wing room 110]] in the shower on top of the decontamination suit
*In [[Health Resort west wing room 301 key|West wing room 304]] on a chair next to a table

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AESA) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
High-tech part of the phased array antenna used in radiolocation systems and radio-electronic warfare systems.

==Hideout==
* 6 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Solar Power]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the air-raid/bomb shelters' table 
* West side near APC inside fridge and on tables around tanks
* West side on the APC closer to the RB-ST room
* White Knight/west motor pool building 3rd floor on chair at end of hallway after stairs
* In Black Knight/east motor pool building on first floor, 3rd room on the left from main entrance
* Behind the [[RB-AK key|RB-AK]] key on the shelves
* White King/HQ building, first floor electronics room with ladder
* In the [[RB-ST key|RB-ST]] room on a stack of green crates in [[Reserve]]
* In the marked rooms ([[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]])
* In the underground room outside D-2 on the server racks
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Reserve Map Phased Array Elements2.png|Location
File:Location of phase array.png|The location of a Phased array element on a stack of green boxes in an air-raid shelter on Reserve
File:Phased array element spawn.png|Location of a Phased array element in the [[RB-ST key|RB-ST]] room on [[Reserve]]
File:Array Element Fridge.png|West side of the base near APC inside fridge
File:Array Element Table.png|In the west air-raid shelters' table
</gallery></li>

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the USEC Villa, rightside room with washer and dryer.
* In the USEC Villa, in the garge.
* In the USEC VIlla, in the basement pool.
* In the 3rd WTP-Building inside a broken box next to the upper office. 
* In the operating room, west building of water treatment plant, as loose loot on the table with the laptop immediately on the left after entering the room, requires [[Operating room key]].
* In the water treatment plant as loose loot: lower left side of the plant near the gun emplacement there's a tent with an APC, beside it there's a table with a white battery charger, the array can spawn beside it.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Lighthouse phased array element USEC house.png|In the USEC Villa, found in the washroom next to the garage, at the bottom of the large shelf.
File:Phased Array Element Lighthouse USEC Villa Garage Workbench.png|In the USEC Villa, found in the garage, sitting on the workbench.
File:Phased Array Element Lighthouse USEC Villa Basement Pool.png|In the USEC Villa, found in the basement, floating in the pool.
</gallery></li>

==Quest Rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Make an Impression]].
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Hunting Trip]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ComTac 4) is a [[Earpieces|earpiece]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The ComTac IV Hybrid Communication Headset is designed to help reduce exposure to hazardous levels of noise, improve situational awareness and at the same time enable two-way radio communication in noisy environments. The headset's electronics are contained completely inside the headset housing, eliminating the need for a large, heavy external radio control box. The headband mechanically stabilizes the headset to help relieve issues of earplugs dislodging from cable snags and body movement. Designed for comfortable use with a ballistic helmet.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Perfotoran) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A blood substitute with the function of oxygen transfer, used as a powerful antidote capable of relieving toxins, poisons, and radiation damage. It was developed by Soviet scientists in the 1980s. It is a submicron emulsion based on PFO compounds. Once in the blood, it temporarily speeds up the metabolism and regenerates tissues. Negatively affects health in case of overdose or rejection.

==Notes==
* Can be used in-raid to remove the effects of the [[Unknown toxin]] inflicted by the [[Cultists]] and barbed wire in [[The Labyrinth]]

==Location==
===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

===[[Reserve]]===
*White Bishop in locked room 2nd floor, key [[RB-SMP key|RB-SMP]]

==Description==
A sturdy case containing all the necessary equipment to start a raid.

==Notes==
* Can only be opened outside of a raid
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")

==Location==
Sent by [[Prapor]] via in-game mail to PMCs who are short on cash.

Each crate contains a [[weapon]] with fitting [[weapon mods]] and [[ammunition]] as well as [[grenades]], [[Medical|medical items]], a [[Headwear#Armor|helmet]], an [[armor vest]], two [[chest rig]]s and a [[backpack]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Propane) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Propane is an extremely explosive gas that is used for welding and for gas stoves in house or places where there is no central gas supply.

==Quests==
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Thirsty - Breadwinner]]
* 2 are used in the quest [[Thirsty - Delivery]] (2 are provided)

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]
*[[Jacket (204 key)]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelving in the Oli store
*In the back warehouse area of Goshan, on the shelves
*In the power station
*At the loose loot spawns inside [[Object 21WS keycard|object 21WS Container]]
*At the loose loot spawns inside [[Object 11SR keycard|Object 11SR Room]]
*On barrels next to Hole in fence extract

===[[Woods]]===
* At the camp in Dead Man's Place
* At the back of the crashed airplane
* At the train depot

===[[Shoreline]]===
* At the desks and stoves of the Old House closest to the Ruined House Fence extract (chairman house)

===[[Factory]]===

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Propital) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A military-issue stimulant permitted to only be used by medical officers and paramedics.
It stimulates regeneration processes by increasing the biosynthesis of purine and pyrimidine bases, RNA, functional, and enzymatic cell elements. Increases metabolism, health, and vitality.
Has continuous side effects.

==Quests==
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==
* [[Medbag SMU06]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Medical supply crate]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Drug Trafficking]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Abandoned Cargo]]
* 5 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Quality Standard]] ("Edge of Darkness" game edition buyers only)

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RB-BK) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A Federal State Reserve Agency base eastern barracks metalsmiths' room key with multiple strange symbols scratched onto it where the room label would usually be. The key is stained by blood and appears to have been misused a lot, making it fragile.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* Used in the story chapter [[They Are Already Here]] when you don't have any of the other marked keys
* Used in the story chapter [[The Ticket]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Location==
Door to the marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building on [[Reserve]].
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:RB-BK lock location.png|Room location marked on map
File:2019-10-28.png|The black pawn barrack building
File:2019-10-28marked.png|The door
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* Loose loot (multiple very rare [[Loot#Valuables|Valuables]], [[Weapons]], [[Containers]], [[Currency]], [[Keycards]])
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:RB-BK1.png|Inside the room
</gallery></li>

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (PGauge) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A device for measuring pressure in pipes, tanks and other isolated systems.

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Hideout==
{{Seasonal hideout changes}}
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Booze Generator]]
* 10 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Bitcoin Farm level 3]]
* 2 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the [[Hideout#Modules|Lavatory level 3]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Toolbox]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]

* In the OLI, close to the storage area
*In Goshan, close to the storage area

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Skybridge) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A key to the skybridge linking Primorsky 46-48, leads to the apartment of the ballet master.

* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Copy) was an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A perfect duplicate of the programmer's diary. How Mechanic achieved such resemblance and why is a mystery. The first page has a table of contents:<br/>• Update<br/>• Notes <br/>• Highlights<br/>• Encrypt<br/>• Agenda <br/>• Ruminates<br/>• Drafts

==Notes== 
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[Friend from Norvinsk - Part 5]]
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[External Interest]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as initial equipment from the quest [[Friend from Norvinsk - Part 5]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Project) is a [[BattlePass]] document in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Documentation from Tarkov Infraline. The company officially specialized in road construction, but these blueprints clearly have nothing to do with transportation infrastructure.

Can be found on:
* Factory
* Reserve
* Customs

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Usage==
* Used to unlock rewards from the [[Seasons#Season 1: KORD BREACH|Season 1: KORD BREACH]] [[BattlePass]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RGD-5) is a [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|fragmentation grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] 57-G-717.

==Description==
RGD-5 (GAU index - 57-G-717) is an antipersonnel fragmentation time-delayed offensive hand grenade. The grenade's UZRGM fuze insures a time delay of 3.2-4.2 seconds. Due to offensive type of the grenade, fragments are relatively light and have a smaller radius of dispersion.

==Location==
*[[Grenade box]]
*[[Wooden crate]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Common fund stash]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RDG-2B) is a [[Weapons#Smoke grenades|smoke grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A Soviet-made smoke hand grenade, designed to create smoke zones with covering or target designation purposes. Cheap and pretty common in post-soviet countries.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RPK-16) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
RPK-16 (Ruchnoy Pulemyot Kalashnikova 16 - "Kalashnikov's Hand-held machine gun 16) is the newest Russian light machine gun chambered in 5.45x39mm rounds. Some key features of this new weapon are the quickly detachable barrels, enhanced ergonomics, and weaver rails on the handguard and dust cover.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Ice Cream Cones]].

A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base military equipment care and attention service and repair centre.

==Quests==
* Used in the Quest [[Surplus Goods]]
* Used in the Quest [[Revision - Reserve]]
* Used in the Quest [[Snatch]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* In different locations in the dining room on the third floor of the repair building marked with black knight.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Hot Zone Reserve Map.png|Black knight repair building marked on map
File:RBSTReserveBlackKnight1.png|First spawn: On the armrest of the sofa
File:RBSTReserveBlackKnight2.png|Second spawn: On the kitchen worktop
File:RBSTReserveBlackKnight3.png|Third spawn: On the wooden desk
</gallery></li>

==Lock Location==
<li style="display: inline-block;">In the Repair Warehouses of the Repair Point Buildings on [[Reserve]].<gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:RB-ST lock location.png|Location highlighted in green on the map
File:RB-ST door.png|Garages in the south-west part of the map
File:RB-ST door close.png|The door from outside the garages
File:RB-ST garagedoor.png|The door from inside the garages
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* One [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* One [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* One [[Weapon box (6x3)]]
* Two [[Grenade box]]es
* Loose loot ([[Ammunition]], [[Weapon mods]] and [[Loot#Electronics|Electronics]])
* Two [[6-STEN-140-M military battery]] spawns
* Three [[OFZ 30x165mm shell]] spawns
* Two [[Phased array element]] spawns
* One [[Military gyrotachometer]] spawn
* One [[Military cable]] spawn
* One [[TP-200 TNT brick]] spawn
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:RB-ST inside.png|Inside the RB-ST room
File:RB-ST inside 2.png|Loose loot inside the room
File:6-STEN military battery spawn in RB-ST room on reserve.png|6-STEN military battery spawn
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Flare) is a [[Weapons#Handheld flares|handheld flare]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
ROP-30 is a reactive flare cartridge for lighting up low-visibility areas during night time.

==Notes==
* Unlike the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)|Red Signal Cartridge]], this one does not call in an [[airdrop]].
* Firing this flare will illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition.
** The white flare is notably brighter than the other colors.
:[[File:bigflare white.png|400px]]
* The flare is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Location==

*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Weapon box (4x4)]]

*[[Weapon box (6x3)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RFID L.) is a [[Keys & Intel|Keycard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A personalized RFID card with a strict design. An exact copy of Kruglov's keycard, but the owner's name has been deliberately scrubbed off. Grants access to the TerraGroup evacuation point reserved for trusted personnel.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
* This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quests==
* Used in the story chapter [[The Ticket]] if the player sided with [[Lightkeeper]].

==Lock Location==
Port garrison intercom on [[Shoreline]].
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">

File:ShorelineIMIntercomButton.png|The intercom
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RBattery) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A chemical source of electric current, reusable source of voltage, characterized by the reversibility of internal chemical processes that ensures its repeated cyclic use (via charge-discharge) for energy accumulation and autonomous power supply of various electrical devices and equipment, as well as providing backup power sources in medicine, manufacturing and other areas.

==Quests==
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the story chapter [[Falling Skies]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Rat Hunting]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Camera, Action!]] ("Edge of Darkness" game edition buyers only)

==Location==
*[[Drawer]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Plastic suitcase]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RSASS) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Remington Semi Automatic Sniper System is the culmination of a joint effort between Remington Arms and JP Enterprises to develop a highly accurate and superbly built rapid firing sniper rifle. This weapon delivers sub-MOA accuracy out to 800 meters and beyond while providing the tactical advantage of a semi-automatic platform.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M700) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Remington Model 700 is a series of bolt-action centerfire rifles manufactured by Remington Arms since 1962.

==Notes==
* If you have a magazine in the gun, you can reload bullets straight into the gun without removing the magazine.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 8]]
* [[Hunting Trip]] requires killing [[Shturman]] with a headshot using this gun with the [[Burris FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope|FullField TAC30 1-4x24 30mm riflescope]]

* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Fishing Place]] (variant AAC SD)

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RedRebel) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A perfectly balanced ice axe, the tip is made of a single piece of hardened metal.

==Notes==
* Required for the "Cliff Descent" extraction on [[Reserve]] along with [[Paracord]].
* Required for the "Mountain Pass" extraction on [[Lighthouse]] along with [[Paracord]].
* Required for the "Climber's Trail" extraction on [[Shoreline]] along with [[Paracord]].

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Special Order]]

==Location==
