'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Green) is a [[Weapons#Handheld flares|handheld flare]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
RSP-30 is a reactive signal cartridge for commanding and maintaining squad interaction. Multi-star rocket cartridges are used as flares.

==Notes==
* Unlike the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)|Red Signal Cartridge]], this one does not call in an [[airdrop]].
* Required for the "Klimov Street" extraction on [[Streets of Tarkov]].
* Required for the "Mira Ave" extraction on [[Ground Zero]].
* Required for the "Power Line Passage" extraction on [[Woods]].
* Required for the "Railroad Passage" extraction on [[Customs]].
* Required for the "Path to River" extraction on [[Interchange]].
* Required for the "Helicopter" extraction on [[Icebreaker]].
* Firing this flare will illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition
:[[File:bigflare green.png|400px]]
* The flare is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Usage==
To open a flare extraction, shoot the flare into the sky while being inside the respective signal flare area. Make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. Only one person amongst a lobby-made group needs to shoot a flare to open the extraction for all members of the group.

Upon entering a signal flare area, a notification pops up in the bottom right corner of the screen: [[File:KlimovStreetSignalAreaNote.png]].

If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up: [[File:FlareSuccessNote.png]].

==Location==
* [[Buried barrel cache]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* [[Weapon box (6x3)]]

===[[Ground Zero]]===
* On a [[Scav Body|dead Scav]] leaned against the yellow bus at the "Mira Ave" extraction. A single flare is guaranteed to spawn every raid. 

===[[Icebreaker]]===
* At the beginning of the location, in a small deck superstructure, there is always one of these flare.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RSh-12)  is a [[Weapons#Revolvers|revolver]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The powerful RSh-12 (Revolver Shturmovoy 12 - "Assault Revolver 12") revolver, manufactured by KBP Instrument Design Bureau, designed for use by special forces. Despite the powerful 12.7x55 mm caliber, RSh-12 has less recoil than many other large-caliber revolvers and pistols, since the shot is fired from the bottom chamber of the cylinder.

==Notes==
* This weapon will never [[Weapon malfunctions|malfunction]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Relax) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the relaxation room inside one of the city offices.

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[The Secret to Productivity]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
In different locations inside the Zmeisky 6 building at [[Streets of Tarkov]]. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" perrow=4>
File:Developer's Secrets - Part 1 Map.png|Building marked on map
File:Developer's Secrets - Part 1 Building.png|The building
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn1.png|On the metal table in the [["Negotiation" room key|negotiation room]]
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn2.png|On the hookah in the bathroom
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn3.png|On the shelf next to the bathroom in the music room
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn4.png|In the weapon locker in the music room
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn5.png|On the chalk holder in the meeting room
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn6.png|Tucked into a purple magazine on the first desk to the left in the southern office
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn7.png|On the coat rack in the southern office
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn8.png|In the crotch of a human figurine on the center back desk in the middle office
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn9.png|Between the teeth of a skull on the back right desk in the middle office
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn10.png|On the desk with the umbrella to the right in the northern office
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn11.png|On the washing machine in the kitchen
File:Relaxationroomkeyspawn12.png|Tucked under the pizza box on the desk in the kitchen
</gallery></li>

==Lock Location==
Door to the "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha street no. 5 building at [[Streets of Tarkov]]
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:The Hive Map.png|Hive hookah lounge location marked on map
File:The Hive Door.png|Door to the hookah lounge
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* Loose loot ([[Loot#Valuables|Valuables]], [[Provisions|Drinks]])
* Multiple [[Sports bag]]s
* Possible [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Black)]] on the mannequin
* Possible [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Olive Drab)]] on the mannequin
* Possible [[LBT-6094A Slick Plate Carrier (Coyote Tan)]] on the mannequin
* Possible [[HighCom Trooper TFO body armor (MultiCam)]] on the mannequin
* Possible [[BNTI Zhuk body armor (EMR)]] on the mannequin
* Possible [[Interceptor OTV body armor (UCP)]] on the mannequin

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Blue) is a [[Weapons#Handheld flares|handheld flare]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A reactive signal cartridge for commanding and maintaining squad interaction. Some Scavs use this flare color to send some kinds of signals. The question is, what do these signals mean?

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Only 1 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* Unlike the [[RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)|Red Signal Cartridge]], this one does not call in an [[airdrop]].
* Firing this flare '''into the sky''' will call in a mortar fire barrage on all [[locations]] aside from [[Factory]], [[The Lab]], [[The Labyrinth]], [[Terminal]] and [[Icebreaker]], as well as illuminate the surrounding area for 20 seconds after ignition
:[[File:BigFlareBlue.png|400px]]
* The flare is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quest rewards==

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RShG-2) is a [[Weapons#Rocket launchers|rocket launcher]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A single-use 72.5mm rocket-propelled grenade launcher, designed to engage enemy personnel in open terrain, field shelters, and various types of structures. Manufactured by NPO Bazalt.

==Notes==
* Cannot be insured.
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
:(Empty ones can currently be listed, recognizable by a weight of 3.77 kg)
* Only 2 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time.
* The hot gases from the backblast cause damage to players when fired close to a wall, the ground or players.
* Cannot be used in the [[Hideout]] shooting range.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Art of Explosion]]

==Description==
A key that opens one of the Rogues' makeshift barracks.

==Quests==
* This is a possible location for the quest [[Getting Acquainted]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Location==
On the first floor of office building #3, which is located at the water treatment plant area in the north of [[Lighthouse]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Rusted) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A rusted bloody key, inscribed on it is: "He who holds this key shall wander for eternity".

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Cannot be put inside [[secure containers]]

==Quests==
* This is a required location for the quest [[The Door]]

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
Inside the Klimov shopping mall, on the first floor on a pegboard underneath the escalators. It can appear at both spawn locations in the same raid.

{{PAGENAME}} (Ryzhy) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Tarko collectible figure of a Scav called Ryzhy. Having heard of the adventures of the well-known in certain circles Ryzhy, the unknown craftsman created this figurine.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Small Business - Part 1]]
* 1 of these, or 1 of the other Scav figurines, needs to be obtained for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 1)]]
* 2 of these, or 2 of the other Scav figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 2)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Scav figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Scav figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 5)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 6)]]

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Plastic suitcase]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Post 1) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the first call from May 11.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Blue Fire]]

==Content==
[[File:Rus Post audio tape 11.05 001 audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909. I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I'm going to be delayed.

[[Category:Audio tapes]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Post 2) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the second call from May 11.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Blue Fire]]

==Content==
[[File:Rus Post audio tape 11.05 002 audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909. Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I'll make it out of Tarkov today. Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Post 3) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
One of the audio tapes used by Rus Post to record work calls from its couriers. This tape contains the third call from May 11.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Blue Fire]]

==Content==
[[File:Rus Post audio tape 11.05 003 audio.wav|282px]]

===Transcript===
Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.

Courier: This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long. The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?! A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died!

Courier: You know what, I don't get paid for this. I'm getting outta here on foot to my family. I'm leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life's more important. If you send someone — the key… the key is under the wheel.

[[Category:Audio tapes]]

[[ru:Аудиокассета Почта Руси 11.05 / 003]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MPX) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The SIG Sauer MPX submachine gun boasts an unprecedented operation speed in the familiar form factor of the AR platform. Short-stroke gas piston allows SIG MPX to use the full range of 9 mm ammunition without any adjustments to the gas valve. The full-sized mount provides the means of installing a wide range of scopes and sighting devices.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - MPX]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ROMEO4) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|compact reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
SIG Sauer ROMEO4 is the ultimate red-dot sight when fast, accurate target acquisition is a must. Whether it’s a moving target, dangerous game at full charge, or a fast breaking tactical situation at close quarters. When things are moving fast and you need to get on target in a hurry, your sight has to work faster. No matter the lighting conditions, weather conditions, or terrain, the ROMEO4 red-dot sight has you covered - when it counts.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MCX) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The .300 Blackout MCX line, designed and manufactured by SIG Sauer, is available in both semi-automatic and automatic versions and features a short-stroke gas piston system, which is inherited from the earlier SIG MPX submachine gun. The .300 Blackout ammo and the MCX are compatible with all AR-15 magazines.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ECHO1) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|thermal vision sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The ECHO1 thermal reflex scope with many uses and advantages. Manufactured by SIG Sauer.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Cannot be insured.
* Cannot be put in [[secure containers]]
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* The thermal detection range is ~230 m at 0° angle, it goes up to ~250 m aiming uphill or downhill

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TANGO6T) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|scope]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The TANGO6T is a rugged and well-built low power variable optic. This model features a 1x to 6x magnification and a first focal plane reticle. This rifle scope is ideal for short and medium distances, as well as for backcountry hunting. Manufactured by SIG Sauer.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SPEAR 6.8) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The MCX SPEAR is a multi-caliber assault rifle designed and manufactured by SIG Sauer based on the MCX assault rifle. Primarily chambered in the new 6.8x51mm (.277 FURY) ammunition. Designed specifically for the US Military to replace the M4 carbine.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Killer Argument]]

==Location==
* On [[Rogues]]
* On the gun walls inside the [[Kiba Arms inner grate door key|KIBA Arms store]] in the ULTRA shopping mall on [[Interchange]]
* On the gun rack inside the security room (labeled 1) within the containment block in [[The Lab]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SJ6) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A combat stimulant. It is used to increase the body abilities before combat. Stimulant is allowed to use by the special forces units. Developed by TerraGroup Labs, marked as SJ6. Has side effects.

==Quests==
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Assessment - Part 3]]
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==

*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SJ9) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Designed for special forces personnel. It makes it possible to reduce the human body temperature for a short time, significantly slowing down the metabolism. The use of SJ9 leads to a significant reduction in the amount of heat released into the environment, while maintaining a safe level of metabolism inside. It is used during night operations, allowing to be hardly visible for thermal imaging devices.

==Notes==
Using this stimulant will lower the body Temperature by 7 °C, making the user harder to be seen by [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|thermal scopes]] and the [[T-7 Thermal Goggles with a Night Vision mount|T-7 thermal goggles]].

[[File:SJ9Effect.mp4|420px]]

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Assessment - Part 3]]
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==
* On [[Cultists]]
* In [[Airdrops]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* Laboratory block (G22) on the second level in The Lab. (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* On the shelf in front of the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11)
* In the rooms above Laboratory quarantine zone (G11)
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SJ12) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Developed for the operatives of special units. Slows down some functions of the body and they temporarily start working with energy regeneration. The drug forces the release of vasopressin in the hypothalamus, which leads to a change in the work of the adrenal glands, lowers body temperature and increases perception. After the end of the action, there is usually a jump in temperature to 40-42 degrees as a compensation for the incorrect functioning of the body systems.

==Notes==
Using this stimulant will lower the body Temperature by 4 °C, making the user harder to be seen by [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|thermal scopes]] and the [[T-7 Thermal Goggles with a Night Vision mount|T-7 thermal goggles]].

[[File:SJ9Effect.mp4|420px]]

==Quests==
* 30 need to be obtained for the quest [[Get a Foothold]]

==Location==
===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

==Quest rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[This Tape Sucks]]

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: The QR code on the label reads "средство для разогрева ягодиц 3000", which translates to "buttocks warming agent 3000".

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Hawk) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
SOG has combined its three best features: an extended cutting head, compact glass-reinforced nylon handle, and a metal butt cap on the end.

==Location==
* [[The Wedge]]

==Trading==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:SP-8 Survival Machete icon.png|frameless|link=SP-8 Survival Machete]] x1<br/>[[SP-8 Survival Machete]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:6h5bayoneticon.png|frameless|link=6Kh5 Bayonet]] x1<br/>[[6Kh5 Bayonet]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:CrashAxeIcon.png|frameless|link=Crash Axe]] x1<br/>[[Crash Axe]]
!<big>→</big>
![[File:Jaeger 2 icon.png|link=Jaeger]]<br/>[[Jaeger|Jaeger LL2]]<br/>After completing his task<br/>[[Slaughterhouse]]
!<big>→</big>
![[File:Voodoo hawk icon.png|frameless|link=SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk]]
[[SOG Voodoo Hawk tactical tomahawk]]
|}

==Trivia==
[[Easter eggs and References]]: This is the very same tomahawk used in the games Medal of Honor (2010) and Medal of Honor: Warfighter. SOG released this product after the popular video games, which was a reference to the character "Voodoo" from the series.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SR-2M) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
SR-2M "Veresk" is a compact submachine gun designed for a powerful 9x21mm armor-piercing cartridge by order of the FSB and the FSO of the Russian Federation. This submachine gun is part of a high-performance rifle complex designed for special forces. Equipped with a folding foregrip. Developed by TsNIItochmash.

==Quests==
* [[Easy-Breezy]] requires 30 kills using this gun with a [[SR-2M 9x21 SV-1381 sound suppressor|suppressor]] and the [[SR-2M KP-SR2 reflex sight|KP-SR2 sight]] on [[Reserve]] or [[Lighthouse]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SR-3M) is an [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The SR-3M is a powerful assault rifle, featuring a very compact size comparable to submachine guns, but noticeably superior in terms of firepower due to the use of special armor-piercing ammunition. The main purpose of the SR-3M is to be used as a concealed carry weapon for Russian special forces units. Developed at TsNIITochMash and based on the AS VAL assault rifle.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SV-98) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ([[GRAU Index]]: 6V10)

==Description==
The SV-98 is a Russian sniper rifle developed in 1998-2000 by a group of weapon engineers led by V.Stronskly and Serially produced by IzhMash group. It is a magazine-fed bolt-action rifle, designed to engage military personnel at the distances of up to 1000m.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Back Door]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SVDS) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|Designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The SVDS (Snáyperskaya Vintóvka Dragunóva Skladnáya - "Dragunov's Sniper Rifle with a foldable stock") sniper rifle was specially designed for Russian paratroopers and special forces units. Features a tubular metal stock that folds to the right side of the receiver (equipped with a synthetic shoulder pad and a fixed cheek riser) and a synthetic pistol grip. The barrel was also given a heavier profile, the receiver housing was strengthened, the gas cylinder block was improved and a ported, shorter conical flash suppressor was adopted. Chambered in 7.62x54R ammo.

==Quests==
* Required for [[Prapor|Prapor's]] quest [[The Punisher - Part 6]]
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 6]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Salewa) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A first aid kit containing bivibag, various types of bandages, and dressing tools.

==Notes==
* Healing [[File:Bleeding.png|46px|Light bleeding]] removes 45 HP from the Salewa
* Healing [[File:HeavyBleeding.png|46px|Heavy bleeding]] removes 175 HP from the Salewa

==Quests==
* 3 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Shortage]]

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Jacket (114 key)]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Wooden crate]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]

===[[Customs]]===
* In the north-western part of the storage area, there is a car trunk that spawns medical items.
* The ambulance in front of the gas station can spawn medical items (and the [[EMERCOM medical unit key]] as a bonus).
* Behind the Old Gas Station, there is a concrete circle object with a [[Medbag SMU06|Medbag]] inside of it.
* Inside the Scavenger hideout within the Stronghold.

===[[Interchange]]===
* Mantis has several containers and loose spawns (shelves, tables and beds) that can spawn Salewas. Keep in mind that Mantis is one of the hottest areas on the whole map.
* Emercom contains several spawns, but requires the [[EMERCOM medical unit key]] to unlock.
* The upstairs pharmacy on the opposite side of Techlight as well as the locked storage room (requires power + [[ULTRA medical storage key]]). Same as Mantis: Danger zone!
* There are four ambulances along the western side of the map, which can spawn Salewas in the back.
*Salewas can spawn on some boxes in the underground car park.

===[[Reserve]]===
* The White Bishop building contains a medical room on the ground floor towards the train tracks.
* The second floor of the Black Pawn building has a medical section with a [[Medbag SMU06|Medbag]] and loose spawns.
* The forklift near the helicopter in the courtyard has loaded a [[Medical supply crate]]. There is also a supply crate in the bunker in the map room.
* In [[RB-PSV1 key|RB-PSV1]] and [[RB-PSV2 key|RB-PSV2]]

===[[Shoreline]]===
* The health resort, while being a high traffic area, contains a large amount of [[Medbag SMU06|Medbags]] and [[Medcase]]s.
* There are two ambulances near the tunnel exfil and one directly outside of the resort.
* The scav/treasure island (near tunnel exfil, past a beached barge) has a wooden shed that contains two [[Medbag SMU06|Medbags]].
* There is a Medbag in the ground floor of the main building weather station.

=== [[Woods]] ===
* The medical encampment on the RUAF Roadblock side of the logger's camp has numerous medbags, duffles and loose medical loot.
* Various military resource boxes and duffles around the map.

==Quest rewards==
* 4 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Health Care Privacy - Part 2]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (ScavBP) is a [[Backpacks|backpack]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

A cheap replica of some 3-day assault pack with a MOLLE attachment system, adapted and enhanced by owner as much as their creativity allowed. Does not offer much comfort, and volume is far lower than that of a proper 3-day pack, but it's still a backpack alright.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Hat) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Santa's hat. Often gets confused with the [[Ded Moroz hat]]. Ded Moroz is cooler, by the way. Really, guys, really. Just listen - "Grandfather Frost". The one and only! Anyway, thank you all, and happy New Year!

==Trivia==
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: This item refers to the Santa Claus or Saint Nicholas. Originating in Western Christian culture, this is a legendary figure who is said to bring gifts to the homes of well-behaved children on Christmas Eve.
* This hat first appeared during Escape from Tarkov's 2017 Christmas Celebration.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (S I C C) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A small soft organizational pouch for storing various small items such as paper money, coins, metal keys, as well as keycards and dogtags.

==Notes==
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 25 inventory slots in a 5x5 grid and only takes up 2 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
* [[Currency]]
* [[Keys & Intel|Keys & Keycards]]
* [[Posters]]
* [[Dogtags]]
* [[Physical Bitcoin]]
* [[Veritas guitar pick]]
* [[Secure Flash drive]]
* [[Chain with Prokill medallion]]
* [[Gold skull ring]]
* [[:Category:BattlePass documents|BattlePass documents]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Stray Dogs]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Keeper's Word]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mk-18 Mjölnir) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Mk-18 Mod 1 Extreme Distance Capable Semi-Automatic Rifle was designed to take advantage of the ballistic capabilities of the .338 Lapua Magnum, .338 Norma Magnum, and .300 Norma Magnum cartridges. The system provides extreme distance capability in a lightweight and mobile semi-auto platform. Utilizing SWORD’s proprietary short-stroke piston system the rifle is precise, reliable, and durable. Featuring ambidextrous controls, ergonomic features, and built-in modularity, the Mk-18 is a great choice for the avid hunter, long-range enthusiast, and competition shooter.

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Tarkov Shooter - Part 7]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Scav) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Tarko collectible figure of a Scav. The unknown craftsman decided to portray a regular representative of the Scavs on Streets of Tarkov. It is unclear what impressed the author more: the memorable hat or how diligently the Scav tried to aim.

* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Scav figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Scav figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Amulet) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A mysterious amulet given to you by Lightkeeper. Serves as a reminder of the wearer's important role in Tarkov's history. Very fragile.

==Notes==
*Only 1 can be in your possession at one time. Buying a new one will destroy the previous.
*Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market, be sold to traders or destroyed.
*While a player is wearing the amulet, [[Cultists]] do not attack the player unless provoked. Getting very close to them is considered a provocation.
**Killing a Cultist while wearing the amulet will destroy it and they become hostile towards the player again.
**[[Zryachiy]]'s guards are not affected by it.
*The amulet can also be used to increase the value of sacrificed items in the [[Hideout#Modules|Hideout Cultist Circle]].
*The amulet can be used for 7 raids or sacrifices before it gets destroyed. It can be unequipped to retain uses.
*This item is not lootable from players and can only be placed in a special item slot. Therefore, a free special slot is required to buy it.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Keeper's Word]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TRG M10) is a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The TRG M10 is a precision bolt-action sniper rifle chambered for the .338 Lapua Magnum cartridge. The TRG M10 is an extremely versatile platform: it easily converts from a proper long-range rifle to a more compact weapon. The rifle is designed to be used by army, police and various special forces of several countries. Manufactured by Sako, which is part of Beretta Defense Technologies holding company.

==Notes==

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Saiga-12K FA) is a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==

==Trivia==
* This Saiga-12K FA is based upon the custom modification previously featured and available to players in both of Escape From Tarkov's prequels and predecessors, Hired Ops and Contract Wars.
* The particular configuration featured in Escape From Tarkov is based upon the specific "Saiga ZHunter" variant which came with an [[Aimpoint CompM4 reflex sight]] equipped by default, and could be obtained by completing the Saiga FA's Weapon Task, which was attaining 50 Rage Kills (5 elimination Killstreak) with the weapon. Hired Ops also featured this specific configuration, albeit in the form of a consumable in-match purchase as a special weapon.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SZ-1) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A demolition charge equipped with an improvised countdown timer, ready for use.

==Notes==
* The charge is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Usage==
Used to open the damaged door on level 3 of [[Icebreaker]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Saiga-12K FA RL) is a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A modified Saiga-12K smoothbore shotgun specially customized for the Arena champion known by the name JP. The custom build reduces barrel overheating during sustained fire and improves overall weapon reliability.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Requirements==
* [[Arena_BattlePass#Season_2|Arena BattlePass Season 2]] level 100
* 21 Battle Points

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SPlug) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Spark plugs are used for gasoline internal combustion engines. Ignition of the fuel-air mixture is produced by electric discharge with a voltage of several thousand or tens of thousands of volts, emerging between the electrodes. The plug fires on each round, at one point of the engine operating cycle.

==Quests==
* 8 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Car Repair]]

==Hideout==

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (APS) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The APS (Avtomatícheskiy Pistolét Stéchkina - "Stechkin Automatic Pistol", [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] - 56-A-126) is a Soviet machine pistol chambered in 9x18 PM, developed in the late 1940 by Igor Stechkin. APS is intended for arming officers who are directly involved in combat operations, as well as for soldiers and sergeants of some special units.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M1A) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
M1A is a civilian version of the M14 rifle designed and manufactured by Springfield Armory, Inc. For the most part, it is identical to the M14. The most notable difference is the removal of the M14's fire selector switch, rendering the rifle permanently semi-automatic. The bayonet lug was also removed from the weapon.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Mask) is a [[Face cover]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A non-combat facemask for intimidation effect. Would've probably actually intimidated someone back in 2012.

==Trivia==
* This mask was added as part of Escape from Tarkov's 2018 Halloween Celebration.
* [[Easter eggs and References]]: Based on the infamous "Slenderman" mask from the iconic horror movie "Slender Man". Its origin is the creepypasta "The Slenderman".

A simple and fairly practical tactical rig from 2002. It is still actively used by security and law enforcement agencies and civilian shooters in Russia. Smog camouflage version.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Smoke) is a [[Face cover]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (STM-9) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A PCC carbine with excellent performance already "out of the box", manufactured by Soyuz-TM Arms. Designed with the participation of world bronze medalist in Semi-Auto Rifle Vadim Mikhailov. Accuracy, speed, comfort of recoil. Compatible with Glock 9x19 magazines.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AUG A1) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Steyr AUG A1 is a 5.56x45 bullpup assault rifle, developed by the Austrian company Steyr-Daimler-Puch. AUG is known for good ergonomics, decent accuracy, low recoil and sufficient reliability. The rifle also stands out for its futuristic design.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AUG A3) is an [[Weapons#Assault rifles|assault rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Steyr AUG A3 is a 5.56x45 bullpup assault rifle, developed by the Austrian company Steyr-Daimler-Puch. AUG is known for good ergonomics, decent accuracy, low recoil and sufficient reliability. The rifle also stands out for its futuristic design. The A3 version features a bolt-catch button. Comes in black and flat dark earth.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Stairs) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the one of the stair landings of the Chekannaya Street 15 building.

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Location ==
Door to the eastern staircase on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building at [[Streets of Tarkov]]. Only accessible via the western staircase from the third floor through a hole in the floor of cell #5. The debris in the second floor hallway can only be passed by proning.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Chekannaya15Map.png|Apartment building marked on map
File:Chekannaya15ApartmentBuilding.png|The apartment building with entrance in the wall marked
File:WesternStaircaseMap.png|Way to the western staircase marked on building map
File:WesternStaircaseWay1.png|Way to the western staircase 1
File:WesternStaircaseWay2.png|Way to the western staircase 2
File:WesternStaircaseWay3.png|Way to the western staircase 3
File:Chekannaya15ApartmentBuildingWesternStairs.png|The western staircase
File:Chek15TFHallway.png|Third floor hallway with hole in cell #5 floor marked
File:Chek15SFHallway.png|Second floor hallway with debris passage marked
File:StairLandingDoor.png|The door
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
No loot, but the ability to jump onto the stair landing that connects the second with the first floor, or straight down to the first floor.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:StairLandingStaircase.png|Eastern staircase with stair landing
</gallery></li>

* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Trader figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Trader figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]

==Trivia==
The chest rig is modeled after a [https://www.spiritussystems.com/lv-119-front-overt-plate-bag Spiritus Systems LV-119 Overt] configured with a variety of commercially available accessories for breaching and sustainment. The loadout combines equipment from several manufacturers, including:
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/lv-119-front-overt-plate-bag Spiritus Systems LV-119 Overt Plate Bags] with Spiritus Systems Shoulder Covers and a [https://www.spiritussystems.com/molle-hlt-cummerbund Spiritus Systems HLT Cummerbund]
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/micro-fight-chassis-mk4 Spiritus Systems Micro Fight Mk4 Chassis (MultiCam)] fitted with an [https://www.axladvanced.com/products/micro-fight-standard-full-zipper-insert?variant=42624737640517 AXL Advanced Micro Fight Zipper Insert (MultiCam)]
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/lunchbox-pouch-mk2 Spiritus Systems Lunchbox Pouch Mk2] mounted beneath the placard in its folded configuration, together with breaching charge strips
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:SS LV-119 V2 Lunchbox.png|The breaching charge strips
</gallery></li>
* A [https://www.spiritussystems.com/back-panel-molle-flap Spiritus Systems MOLLE Back Panel] attached the rear plate bag.
* A [https://blueforcegear.com/single-smoke-grenade-pouch-html Blue Force Gear Single Smoke Pouch] (Black), two Eagle Industries Strip Charge Pouches (Ranger Green), and an ACS Grenade Trigger Pouch (Green) mounted to the rear panel
* Two [https://www.spiritussystems.com/medium-gp-pouch-mk3 Spiritus Systems Medium GP Pouches in (MultiCam)], and a [https://www.spiritussystems.com/multi-platform-radio-chassis-mk5 MPRC Mk5 Radio Chassis] Mounted to the Cummerbund
Additional equipment includes [[HK MP7 4.6x30 30-round magazine]]s, an [https://persistentsystems.com/mpu5 MPU5] networking radio with compatible MPU5 Push-to-Talk (PTT), and a [https://thyrm.com/collections/darkvault/products/darkvault Thyrm DarkVault Critical Gear Case].

==Trivia==
The chest rig is modeled after a Spiritus Systems LV-119 (in Wolf Grey) configured with a range of commercially available accessories from Spiritus Systems and other manufacturers. The carrier is outfitted with:
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/micro-fight-chassis-mk4/ Spiritus Systems Micro Fight Chassis Mk4] equipped with a [https://www.spiritussystems.com/micro-fight-half-flap-mk2/ Microfight MK2 Half Flap] mounted to the front plate bag
* A [https://www.spiritussystems.com/recovery-handle-mk2/ Spiritus Systems Recovery Handle MK2] is mounted to the rear plate bag using a [https://www.petzl.com/US/en/Sport/Carabiners-And-Quickdraws/OK Petzl OK Carabiner]
* Spiritus Systems Trifold Shoulder Covers for cable management
** The placard carries three [[AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazine]]s, while the front utility pocket contains a Leatherman MUT EOD multitool, a [[Glock 9x19 17-round magazine]], a paint marker, and two [https://getcyalume.com/safety-lighting-products/chemlights/ Cyalume infrared chemlights].
** A [https://www.narescue.com/combat-application-tourniquet-c-a-t.html North American Rescue C.A.T tourniquet] is strapped to the bottom.
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/molle-hlt-cummerbund/ Spiritus Systems MOLLE HLT Cummerbund], mounted with:
** One [https://www.spiritussystems.com/jsta-pouch/ Spiritus Systems JSTA Pouch] loaded with one [[Glock 9x19 17-round magazine]] and one [[AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 W STANAG 30-round magazine]]
** One [https://www.spiritussystems.com/elastic-magazine-pouch-emp/ Spiritus Systems Elastic Magazine Pouch (EMP)] with one Magpul PMAG magazine
** One [https://www.spiritussystems.com/multi-platform-radio-chassis-mk5/ Spiritus Systems Multi Platform Radio Chassis Mk5] carrying a [https://persistentsystems.com/mpu5/ Persistent Systems' MPU5] networking radio connected to a Push-to-Talk (PTT) adapter
** One [https://www.sandsprecision.com/izlid-pouch-1.html S&S Precision IZLID® Quick-Draw Pouch] with a [https://tnvc.com/shop/izlid-ultra-infrared-laser/ B.E. Meyers IZLID Ultra] infrared laser emitter
** [https://www.spiritussystems.com/side-armor-bags/ Spiritus Systems Side Armor Bags].

==Trivia==
This chest rig is modeled after a [https://www.spiritussystems.com/lv-119-front-overt-plate-bag Spiritus Systems LV-119 Overt] configured in MultiCam Black.

Beyond the front and rear LV-119 Overt plate bags, the in-game carrier is fitted with several commercially available Spiritus Systems components, including:
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/molle-hlt-cummerbund Spiritus Systems Elastic HLT Cummerbund] with [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wq_FGpvE7gM Spiritus Systems Trifold Shoulder Covers]
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/micro-fight-chassis-mkv Spiritus Systems Micro Fight MkV Chassis] mounted to the front plate bag
* [https://blueforcegear.com/ten-speed-pouch Blue Force Gear Ten-Speed Quad MP7 Magazine Pouch] secured to the front of the MkV Chassis loaded with three [[Model 8230 CS gas grenade]]s and a Leatherman MUT multi-tool
* [https://www.spiritussystems.com/sack-pouch-mk3 Spiritus Systems SACK Pouch Mk3] suspended beneath the placard
* Spiritus Systems MOLLE Back Panel (Tegris) mounted to the rear plate bag.

Additional equipment visible on the carrier consists of a North American Rescue (NAR) C-A-T Tourniquet, Thyrm DarkVault protective case, Kagwerks Samsung Galaxy S7 case, and a custom [[Black Division]] ID patch.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SI Cobra) is a [[Weapon mods#Functional Mods|foregrip]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Cobra Tactical foregrip integrates the form with functionality. Its hybrid-designed shape works both as a regular foregrip and as a comfortable hand stop when going with the thumb over bore method. The grip allows you to handle the weapon with confidence and the organic design enables the operator to manipulate the rifle in a way that’s most comfortable at any given moment. Comes in black and flat dark earth.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (T-7) is a [[Helmet mods#Thermal vision devices|thermal vision device]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The T-7 thermal imaging binocular/goggles takes a clever approach to individual soldier imaging systems. The T-7 thermal binocular brings the best features of the night vision goggles and adapted them into a full function thermal imager. Requires adapters to fit on helmets.

==Notes==
* Cannot be insured.
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* The goggles range is ~250 m at 0° angle
* Since IR rays don't go through glass, it is recommended to use iron sights with these goggles, any other optics will be unusable.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Surv12) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An advanced surgical kit with additional high-quality tools, allows treating serious injuries right on the battlefield.

==Notes==
* The Surv12 field surgical kit restores a destroyed ("blacked-out") body part to 1 HP. The player can use medkits afterwards, to heal the body part further.
* Destroyed parts that are restored with a Surv12 field surgical kit will only have 60% - 72% of their maximum HP for the remainder of the raid. If the body part is destroyed a subsequent time, performing surgery again will lower the maximum HP of that body part further.
* Neither the head nor the thorax can be repaired after being destroyed.
*The Surv12 field surgical kit will not only restore a destroyed body part, but will simultaneously remove a fracture from that same body part when used.
* The kit is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Location==
* [[Medbag SMU06]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Weapon box (5x2)]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]

==Quest Rewards==
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from completing [[The Huntsman Path - Sadist]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Vector 9x19) is a [[Weapons#Submachine guns|submachine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The KRISS Vector SMG is the ideal choice for law enforcement and military seeking a controllable and compact weapon system for close quarter combat environments. The low bore axis and Super V recoil mitigation system allow for controllable shots when firing in full-automatic, or fast semi-automatic follow up shots. Compatible with Glock 9x19 magazines.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found for the quest [[Gunsmith - Vector 9x19]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (CR MK2 (R)) is a [[Chest rigs|chest rig]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The "Chest-Rig" tactical system can be used as an independent piece of equipment or as an addition to body armor without the MOLLE system. Suitable for combat training instructors, special forces units. Recon preset in A-TACS FG camouflage. Manufactured by Stich Profi.

== Quest rewards ==

* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Nothing Fishy About This]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Supplies (Rare)) is a [[Looting#Reward containers|Reward Loot Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
===Before Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Outside the border, the contents of this box can hardly be considered valuable. However, Tarkov has its own notions of value. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

===After Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Outside the border, the contents of this box can hardly be considered valuable. However, Tarkov has its own notions of value. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

==Notes==
* Can only be opened outside of a raid
** Must be un-locked at the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]] before it can be opened
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
* Only the locked version can be stashed in [[Lucky Scav Junk box]]

==Location==
* Possible reward from [[Ref]]'s daily and weekly quests for [[Arena]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Streamer items) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A case for compact storage of those strange souvenirs scattered throughout Tarkov, perfect for collectors.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 88 inventory slots in a 8x11 grid and only takes up 9 inventory slots itself. It can only store items required for the quest [[Collector]] from [[Fence]].

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Is This a Reference?]]

==Trivia==
This item was first introduced as a reward for a promotional event on [https://web.archive.org/web/20240822173215/https://blog.twitch.tv/en/2024/08/21/summer-of-rewards/#:~:text=1%20Sub%20to%20receive%20the%20exclusive%20Twitch%20Container. Twitch in September 2024]. Players that participated in the event can claim it for their PvP character on the [https://www.escapefromtarkov.com/profile Escape from Tarkov website] without having to complete the quest [[Is This a Reference?]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SKS) is an [[Weapons#Assault carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] 56-A-231.

==Description==
A Soviet semi-automatic carbine designed by Sergei Simonov for 7.62x39 cartridge and known abroad as SKS-45. Immensely popular both in CIS countries and in the West, this weapon is still in active service in some countries in form of various copies and modifications. This particular specimen comes from extended storage warehouses of Tula Arms Plant and haven't yet undergone the civilian weapon normalization procedure.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (T H I C C) is a [[Containers|Container]] in '' [[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A storage case for weapons, ammunition, and weapon parts. A special edition with an increased storage volume to accommodate larger and longer weapons.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Cannot be stored in a [[Backpacks|backpack]].

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 90 inventory slots in a 6x15 grid and only takes up 10 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
*[[Weapons]] (Besides [[Weapons#Melee_weapons|melee]])
*[[Ammunition]]
*[[Weapon mods]]

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Choose Your Friends Wisely]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (T H I C C) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

The T H I C C advanced storage case with increased storage volume for various items.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Cannot be stored in a [[Backpacks|backpack]].

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 196 inventory slots in a 14x14 grid and only takes up 15 inventory slots itself. It can store everything except:
* [[Item case]]
* T H I C C item case
* [[Weapon case]]
* [[T H I C C Weapon case]]
* [[Lucky Scav Junk box]]
* Some [[Loot#Special equipment|special equipment]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (KS-23M) is a [[Weapons#Shotguns|shotgun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
KS-23 is a Russian shotgun, although because it uses a rifled barrel it is officially designated by the Russian military as a carbine. KS stands for Karabin Spetsialniy, "Special Carbine". It is renowned for its large caliber, firing a 23 mm round, equating to 6.27 gauge using the British and American standards of shotgun gauges and approximately 4 gauge using the current European standards (based on the metric CIP tables), making it the largest-bore shotgun in use today.

== Notes ==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

== Quest rewards ==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Huntsman Path - Forest Cleaning]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Our Own Land]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TP-200) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
TP-200 is intended for use as charges in the production seismic surveys, intermediate detonators when initiating borehole explosive charges, crushing oversized items and performing special blasting operations.

==Quests==
* 3 need to be obtained for the quest [[Create a Distraction - Part 1]]

==Hideout==
* 2 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Security level 2]]

==Location==
*[[Grenade box]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]
*[[Jacket (204 key)]]

===[[Shoreline]]===
* In the shelves at the entrance of west resort with hole in wall next to fence

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the [[RB-ST key|RB-ST]]

===[[Interchange]]===
* On the shelves at the back warehouse of the Goshan store

==Quest Rewards==
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from completing [[Exit Here]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from completing [[Chemical - Part 2]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TKPD) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The TKPD (Tyazhelyy Karabin Podderzhki Dragunova - "Dragunov Heavy Support Carbine") is a modernized SVDK chambered in 9.3x64mm, commissioned by PMC BEAR. The weapon is noted for high accuracy and effectively suppresses targets at medium ranges. Manufactured by SniperArms Dynamics.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Trivia==
* The TKPD Sniper and TKPD Assault<ref>Originally mistranslated as "TKPD Storm" in English internationalizations of Contract Wars and Hired Ops.</ref> are quasi-fictitious custom weapons based on the real-life SVDK (GRAU index - 6V9) precision rifle. Originally conceptualized for the early 2010s cancelled ''Russia 2028'' game prototype, the weapons were later repurposed for Escape From Tarkov's predecessors and prequels, ''Contract Wars'' and ''Hired Ops'', appearing in every game in the series thus far.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Access) is a [[Keys & Intel|Keycard]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Notes==
* Will be consumed upon entering [[The Lab]]. Will not be consumed in the practice and practice co-op game modes.

* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

The ultra-light and skeletal TT Plate Carrier SK vest is made primarily from lightweight, thin and durable TPU-laminated Cordura nylon material with a claimed density of at least 700 denier. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Blue Folders) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The TerraGroup company documents in blue-colored folders. Especially valuable on the black market.

==Quests==
* 2 need to be obtained for the quest [[Return the Favor]]
* 3 need to be obtained for the story chapter [[The Ticket]] if the [[Armored case]] was given to [[Prapor]]

==Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* In [[Safe]]s
* In [[Plastic suitcase]]s
* On [[Rogues]]

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* On a desk in the trainyard warehouse
* Building 2 of the Water Treatment Plant

===[[Woods]]===
* In a stack of pallets, in the USEC camp
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Blue Folder Spawn Woods USEC Camp.png
</gallery></li>
* On a shelf inside the train depot offices
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Blue Folder Woods Train Depot.png
</gallery></li>
* In a sink inside the [[Old house toilet key|toilet of the old house]] with semi-circle windows in the train depot
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Blue Folder Woods Train Depot 2.png
</gallery></li>
* Inside the mountain bunker found on the desk in the second side room

===[[Ground Zero|Ground Zero (Level 21+)]]===
*Inside a file organizer in office no. 3 on the second floor of the TerraGroup main building
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Blue Folder GZ Office 3.png
</gallery></li>
*Inside a drawer on the floor in office no. 4 on the second floor of the TerraGroup main building
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Blue Folder GZ Office 4.png
</gallery></li>

===[[The Lab]]===
*On top of the oval table next to the [[TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key|laboratory manager office (O21)]].
*On top of the desk with one screen in the [[TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key|laboratory manager office (O21)]].
*On top of a desk in the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Green)|laboratory block (G22)]].
*On the 2nd level of the shelve in [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)|Kruglov's office(R22)]]
*Inside of the safe in [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)|Kruglov's office(R22)]]

{{PAGENAME}} (Tagilla) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A limited edition Tarko figurine. As a child, Tagilla fell into a tub of protein. His welding mask protects him not only from bullets, but also from blood spatter. Many parts of the Polikhim factory are rumored to be forged with his hammer.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Small Business - Part 1]]
* 1 of these, or 1 of the other Boss figurines, needs to be obtained for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 1)]]
* 2 of these, or 2 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 2)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Boss figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 5)]]
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 6)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Poster) is a [[Posters|poster]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
At one point, the whole Tarkov was flooded with advertisements like this. But for some reason this particular poster is subtly different.

==Notes==
*Can be installed in the [[Hideout]].

==Location==
*On walls all over Tarkov

==Trivia==
This poster is a reference to the 3rd season of Chronicles of Ryzhy ARG. Players had to find these posters in France, Japan, Russia and the US to get different Google Drive links, that were used to progress the ARG further. The text in the bottom left corner reads "We are waiting for you at the address: 1zOivDIyL3IClKLjq3upuPk91xUQEt5X9", hinting at a [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1zOivDIyL3IClKLjq3upuPk91xUQEt5X9 Google Drive folder published by "Mr Kermen"].

** Not lootable

==Trivia==
* The mask causes Shadow of Tagilla to resemble Minotaur, the creature living in the Labyrinth, from Greek mythology.
* In the Russian localization, "ZABEY" is spelled "ЗАБЕЙ", which is an imperative word meaning "to slaughter" (among [[Wiktionary:забить|other possible meanings]]).

==See also==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' ("ZABEY") is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''TarCoins''' (TarCoin) are a [[currency]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A mysterious currency that appeared in Tarkov after the Contract Wars had already begun. The motto stamped on the coin refers to a certain well-known company... A rare item, prized by everyone without exception.

==Notes==
* Not available in the PvE game mode
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Cannot be put inside [[secure containers]]
* Stacks to 100
* Cannot be brought into a raid
* Only 100 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* Spawns in stacks of 3-9

==Info==
* Used as a currency to purchase [https://www.escapefromtarkov.com/expansions expansions] in the in-game Expansions Hub.
* Does not take up space in the stash, all looted TarCoins are converted into Expansions Hub balance upon extraction.
* Can also be purchased for real money on the [https://www.escapefromtarkov.com/expansions/tarcoin Escape from Tarkov website] or in the Expansions Hub.

==Location==
* Can be found in [[Loot#Valuables|Valuables]] spawns with a low spawn rate

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In [[Bank cash register]]s

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TT) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] 56-A-132.

==Description==
A legendary pistol that has seen numerous military conflicts throughout the years and is still in service in certain regions of the world, in one variation or another. This one is a classic TT-33, the most mass-produced version. It features a Browning short-recoil tilting-barrel system, but other than that, the construction design is very unique - it is purposefully simple, single-action, and no safety measures except half-cock notch, which makes it be able to withstand horrible operating abuse. Thanks to the powerful 7.62x25 cartridge and relatively long barrel, the TT boasts high muzzle velocity, penetration, and impressive accuracy, even over long distances.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (REAP-IR) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|thermal vision sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Versatile thermal imaging telescope/sight. It can be installed on weapons for use in the form of sight, on a helmet - via adapter - as a monocular, and as a separate observation device.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Cannot be insured.
* Cannot be put in [[secure containers]]
* Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* The thermal detection range is ~230 m at 0° angle, it goes up to ~250 m aiming uphill or downhill

==Quests==
* 1 is needed for the quest [[Gunsmith Master - Part 9]]
* 1 is needed for the quest [[The Courier]] (1 is provided)
* 1 is needed for the quest [[Spotter]]
* 15 are needed for the quest [[Profitable Venture]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TT Gold) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. [[GRAU Index|GAU Index]] 56-A-132.

==Description==
A legendary pistol that has seen numerous military conflicts throughout the years and is still in service in certain regions of the world, in one variation or another. This one is a classic TT-33, the most mass-produced version. It features a Browning short-recoil tilting-barrel system, but other than that, the construction design is very unique - it is purposefully simple, single-action, and no safety measures except half-cock notch, which makes it be able to withstand horrible operating abuse. Thanks to the powerful 7.62x25 cartridge and relatively long barrel, the TT boasts high muzzle velocity, penetration, and impressive accuracy, even over long distances. A special gold edition.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[The Huntsman Path - Trophy]]
* [[The Good Times - Part 2]] requires 10 kills using this gun ("Edge of Darkness" game edition buyers only)

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Tetriz) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An ancient artifact of a lost past. May be of interest to Mechanic, an avid collector of electronics.

==Notes==

==Location==

===[[Customs]]===
* Can spawn in big red next to the mattress on the floor, in the back of the warehouse
* Can spawn on the first floor of 2 story dorms, on the couch closest to the fence line.
* Can spawn in the green screen room in the [[USEC stash key|Repair Shop]] building underneath the desk with the two computers.
* Can spawn in the room connected to the green screen room on a workbench.
* Can spawn on the wooden table inside the unlocked room at new gas station.
* Can spawn on the shelves in the new gas station.
* Can spawn on the floor amidst the garbage in front of cashier's counter.
* Can spawn in trunk of white car between new gas station and checkpoint
* Can spawn on shelf of red shed in crossroads storage area

===[[Woods]]===
* Can spawn in marked circle
* Can spawn in two story wooden house in Scav Town

===[[Shoreline]]===
* Can spawn inside the White House on the South West side of the town back room in the blue drawer.
* Can spawn on second floor of weather station, beside the safe, beneath the computer bank.
* Can spawn inside [[Health Resort east wing office room 107 key|East wing 107]], on the desk.
* Can spawn inside [[Health Resort east wing room 222 key|East wing 222]], on workbench.
* Can spawn inside [[Health Resort east wing room 328 key|East wing 328]], on the desk.
* Can spawn inside [[Health Resort west wing room 216 key|West wing 216]], on the box to the left.
* Can spawn inside [[Health Resort west wing room 301 key|West wing 301]], on floor next to white barrels.
* Can spawn inside Admin 2nd floor East side room with open safe, on the shelf.
* Can spawn inside of [[Health Resort office key with a blue tape|East wing 110]] (Sanitar's Office)

===[[Interchange]]===
* Can spawn in Texho on the shelving area.
* Can spawn in Rasmussen on the shelves and inside the desk
* Can be located inside electronics stores in the ULTRA shopping mall.
* Can spawn inside the power station on the shelf in the office next to the entrance.
* Can spawn inside Idea offices on the side desks.
* Can spawn on the Idea checkout.
* Can spawn on the tools shelves behind the Goshan food store in the ULTRA shopping mall.
* Can spawn inside [[EMERCOM medical unit key|EMERCOM medical unit]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* Can spawn on the server shelves on [[Reserve]].
* Very commonly found in the [[RB-AK key|RB-AK]] room.
* Can spawn in the Black Knight building, 3rd room on the left from main entrance on a desk.

===[[Factory]]===
* Can spawn on the desk on the first floor of the office building with a green light inside.
* Can spawn on the barrels under the Factory break room, near Gate 3.

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* Can spawn on the desk, next to the screens, in the shop between Corner Diner and Golden World

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (TA01NSN) is an [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|assault scope]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Designed to the exact specifications of the US Special Operations Command for use by elite US forces, the Trijicon ACOG TA01NSN is Trijicon’s most popular ACOG. The ranging reticle allows for bullet drop compensation out to 600 meters without any manual adjustments. Additional backup rear sights can be mounted. No batteries needed. Comes in black and tan.

The Ultra 5 sound suppressor is designed for use with 7.62x51 NATO rounds, but also functions as a superb multi-caliber suppressor for multiple hosts, providing excellent performance on 7.62 NATO, .300, 6.8 SPC, 6.5, and 5.56mm NATO. The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SVT-40) is an [[Weapons#Assault_carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The SVT-40 was the only mass-produced personal weapon in the early years of WW2, before the mass production of submachine guns began. The soldiers affectionately called this rifle "Sveta". When "Sveta" went to the troops, it turned out that not all Red Army soldiers were able to truly master this weapon. The SVT was best used by marine infantry units and snipers. The production of SVT-40 continued until the end of the war, and this semi-automatic rifle made an important contribution to the overall victory.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AVT-40) is an [[Weapons#Assault_carbines|assault carbine]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AVT-40 partially compensated for the lack of handguns and submachine guns at the beginning of WW2. The AVT-40 is similar to the SVT-40 in its design, but due to the presence of a fire selector, the role of which is played by the safety lever, it can fire both single and automatic fire.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (AK-50) is a [[Weapons#Designated marksman rifles|designated marksman rifle]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The AK-50 semi-automatic anti-materiel rifle is an experimental first-of-a-kind project that adapts the Kalashnikov platform to use the .50 BMG cartridge. The AK-50 has outstanding penetration and range, making it a very powerful sniper rifle. This prototype was developed by a firearms manufacturer and YouTube blogger Brandon Herrera and co. as part of The AK Guy LTD.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Toolbox) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An ordinary toolbox with an unordinary color. Most of the stickers on it are inexistent in Tarkov. Someone has paid a hefty price to smuggle it from outside the cordon.

==Notes==
* This item is only available as reward for players who have linked a Discord account to their game account on the [https://profile.tarkov.com/profile/accounts Escape from Tarkov website].
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 36 inventory slots in a 6x6 grid and only takes up 4 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
* [[Tools]]
* [[Building materials]]
* [[Paracord]]
* [[Leatherman Multitool]]
* [[Freeman crowbar]]

* 2 of these, or 2 of the other Trader figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 2)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Trader figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 3)]]
* 3 of these, or 3 of the other Trader figurines, need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[New Beginning (Prestige 4)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Tigzresq) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Sometimes nothing is more important than having a fracture splint within easy reach. The founder of Tigzresq knows this firsthand.

==Notes==
When applying the splint to your leg you will be unable to move for the duration of the application. You are able to move while it is applied to an arm.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Collector]]

==Location==

*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (6Sh112 S-S) is a [[Chest rigs|Chest rig]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Universal Modular Transport-Combat System (UMTBS) "Scout-Sniper" is officially part of the equipment of the armed forces of the Russian Federation. The vest is designed with a modular approach and can be transformed to suit various specific combat tasks. This system includes the vest base, various purpose pouches, and backpacks. Due to the fact that the vest is based on the MOLLE system, it can be used with various compatible pouches beyond those included with the kit. The belt system has soft bumper pads, and its inside is made from breathable materials.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (RFIDR) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A high-performance UHF RFID fixed reader. Based on proprietary efficient digital signal processing algorithm, it supports fast tag read/write operation with high identification rate. It can be widely applied in many RFID application systems such as logistics, access control, anti-counterfeit and industrial production process control system.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Import]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Special Equipment]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Weapon box (5x5)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* In the [[Concordia apartment 64 office room key|Concordia apartment 64 office room]] on the desk

===[[The Lab]]===
* On top of PC under the table against the toxic waste storage dome in the Main Working Area (O11)
* On top of the tables next to a keyboard in the Console Room (B22)
* In the conference room next to the gym, on top of the podium next to the laptop.
* On the server rack in the [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Violet)|laboratory security post]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SRS-02) is a [[Weapon mods#Sights .28Functional Mods.29|reflex sight]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Trijicon SRS Sealed Reflex Sight is compact and takes up less rail space while maintaining durability and performance. The large 38mm aperture allows for a wide field of view and rapid target engagement. The Trijicon SRS Sealed Reflex Sight features a 1.75 MOA dot for precision. The SRS is powered by a solar cell and a single AA battery.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Poxeram) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Trimadol) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An opioid synthetic analgesic developed for special forces operatives. It has a central and spinal cord action (promotes the opening of K+ and Ca2+ channels, causes hyperpolarization of membranes and inhibits the conduction of pain impulses). In addition to the analgesic effect, it increases combat characteristics. Overdose leads to exhaustion of the body after the effects wear off.

==Location==
===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Type 56 Chicom) is a [[Chest rigs|Chest rig]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The Type 56 Chicom vest is the forefather of modern tactical loadout harness systems. The Type 56 rifle magazine chest harness was developed for the People's Liberation Army of China in the 1950s and has since been widely used in many local conflicts of the 20th century. In the early 1980s, such harnesses made their way to Afghanistan, where they gained acceptance by select Soviet troops who used the trophy Chicoms. It is unknown whether or not the Chicom served as a prototype for the Soviet Belt-A chest rig or not.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M60E6) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The M60E6 is a 7.62x51 caliber light machine gun, a lightweight modification of the M60E4. The M60 was nicknamed "The Pig" due to its bulky size and design flaws. Despite its disadvantages, variants of the M60 are still used in some military units. Manufactured by U.S. Ordnance. Comes in black and flat dark earth.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (M60E4) is a [[Weapons#Light machine guns|light machine gun]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The M60E4 (Mk 43 Mod 1) is a 7.62x51 caliber light machine gun, a modification of the M60E3 with a more reliable trigger mechanism, ability to attach optics, and a number of other improvements. The M60 was nicknamed "The Pig" due to its bulky size and design flaws. Despite its disadvantages, variants of the M60 are still used in some military units. Manufactured by U.S. Ordnance.

==Notes==
* This weapon will never [[Weapon malfunctions|malfunction]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Tripwire) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
An improvised booby trap kit made of tent pegs and wire with a carabiner. Allows the user to install tripwires on flat surfaces or to conceal explosives on an object.

==Notes==
*Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* The kit is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]
* Only 4 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
* [[Partisan]] and [[Shadow of Tagilla]] do not set off tripwires.

==Usage==
* The kit must be placed in any inventory slot and equipped via the "Change weapon fire mode" keybind (Default: B) while holding any [[Weapons#Throwable_weapons|grenade]] besides the [[RDG-2B]] in hands.
** The tripwire can be placed freely on any flat surface, with a minimum of 0.8, and a maximum wire distance of 3 meters.
** The explosion delay depends on the used grenade.
** A placed tripwire will persist for 10 minutes before it automatically disarms.
:[[File:TripwirePlacement.png|500px]]
* Tripwires can be disarmed at the grenade with bare hands in 11 seconds, and with a [[Leatherman Multitool]] in the inventory in 3 seconds. The used grenade can be picked up again but the kit is destroyed.
:[[File:TripwireDisarm.png|500px]]
*Tripwires can also be activated/disarmed by bullets and shrapnel hitting their wire. Hitting the pegs or the grenade does not work.

==Quest rewards==
*2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Rough Tarkov]]
