'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Day 35) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A personal audio tape on which a USEC operative recorded a conversation with their commander during a rest stop.

==Content==
[[File:USEC operative's audio tape labeled Day 35 audio.mp3|282px]]

===Transcript===
USEC Operative: Commander! How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?

USEC Squad Leader: For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.

USEC Operative: You think they'll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.

USEC Squad Leader: Let them set their priorities themselves. We've already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup's docs. 

USEC Operative: But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There's no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.

USEC Squad Leader: They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.

USEC Operative: Like an EMP? Surely they're gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.

USEC Squad Leader: Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated. Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.

USEC Operative: What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?

USEC Squad Leader: There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse. Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.

USEC Operative: Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would've been screwed up without us involved… Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…

USEC Squad Leader: Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse! So shut up. SHUT UP!

USEC Operative: Uh, yes sir!

[[Category:Audio tapes]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Twitch) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This case is meant to store dogtags of fighters with special distinctions. Don't put ordinary mercs' tags in it.

==Notes==
* Only obtainable from paid Twitch Drops.
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 25 inventory slots in a 5x5 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. Only [[Dogtag]]s besides default ones can be stored in it.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (USEC) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to the USEC stash, located somewhere in the Customs area.

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Locations==
Door to a storage room on the first floor of warehouse #6 on [[Customs]].
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:USEC Stash location.png|Warehouse #6 location marked on map
File:The second Door.png|Door to the room
</gallery></li>

==Behind the Lock==
* 2x [[Weapon box (4x4)]]
* 2x [[Wooden crate]]
* [[Metal fuel tank]] or [[Expeditionary fuel tank]] spawn
* Loose loot ([[Weapon mods]])
* Possible weapon spawn ([[Steyr AUG A1 5.56x45 assault rifle|AUG A1]], [[Steyr AUG A3 5.56x45 assault rifle|AUG A3]], [[Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle (Taupe)|SR-25 (Taupe)]], [[Colt M16A2 5.56x45 assault rifle|Colt M16A2]], [[Colt M16A1 5.56x45 assault rifle|Colt M16A1]], [[Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle|M1A]], [[HK G36 5.56x45 assault rifle|G36]], [[Kel-Tec RFB 7.62x51 rifle|RFB]], [[FN SCAR-L 5.56x45 assault rifle|SCAR-L 5.56x45]] and others)

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Fuze) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
UZRGM (Universainy Zapal Ruchnoy Granaty Modernizirovanny - "Universal Hand Grenade Fuze Modified") - unliked UZRG, it contains a slow-burned pyrotechnic composition with high combustion stability and an azide detonator capsule in an aluminum sleeve inside the aluminum bushings.. A vital component for the production of grenades.

==Location==
*[[Grenade box]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]

*[[Weapon box (6x3)]]
*[[Ground cache]]

*[[Jacket]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Taiga-1) is a [[Weapons#Melee weapons|melee weapon]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
UVSR "Device for carrying out rescue operations" Taiga-1. A truly versatile survival tool. It is a weapon and a shovel and an axe and everything you can imagine. It was developed and produced in the USSR for various agencies.

==Quests==
* 8 need to be obtained for the quest [[Never Too Late To Learn]]

==Location==
* [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* [[Common fund stash]] 
* On [[Cultists]]

===[[Customs]]===
*In [[Reshala's bunkhouse key|Reshala's bunkhouse]]
*At the three-story dorms in the "[[Dorm room 314 marked key|marked room]]"
*At the "giving tree" behind the "Old Gas Station"
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

===[[Woods]]===
* On [[Shturman]]

===[[Shoreline]]===
* On [[Sanitar]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the "marked rooms" [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]], [[RB-PKPM marked key|RB-PKPM]] and [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]

===[[Streets of Tarkov]]===
* On [[Kaban]] and his bodyguards Basmach and Gus
* In the "[[Abandoned factory marked key|marked room]]" at the abandoned factory
* In the "[[Mysterious room marked key|marked room]]" at Chekannaya 13

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the "[[Shared bedroom marked key|marked room]]" at the peninsula territory
* In [[Leon's hideout key|Leon's hideout]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Shestyorka) is a [[Keys & Intel|Key]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A key to one of the VAZ cars commonly known as Shestyorka ("the sixth one").

==Notes==
* This key does not currently open any lock. 

==Key Location==
* In [[Jacket]]s
* In [[Drawer]]s
* Pockets and bags of [[Scavs]]

==Lock Location==
None.

==Trivia==
* VAZ, now AvtoVAZ is a automobile manufacturer. The company is best known for its flagship series of Lada vehicles
* Sixpack is probably a bad translation of SHESTERKA, meaning LADA-2106 or VAZ model 6 (thus six-rka). A Word created similar to tushonka (stewed-nka) or ushanka (ears-nka meaning a hat with ears)

Nothing unless the quest [[The Extortionist]] is active.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (UV Lamp) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A UV lamp for household use is a type of light bulb which source of light is invisible to the human eye, located on the border of the purple spectrum and x-ray radiation. UV radiation has beneficial effects on all the systems of human and animal bodies, contributing to the development of a strong defensive system against viral and infectious diseases, such as seasonal colds.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (VPX) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The VPX Flash Storage Module (FSM) provides high-performance, high-capacity, solid-state SATA storage with AES-256 bit encryption using an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC).

==Notes==
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Import]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Special Equipment]]

==Hideout==
*2 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center level 3]]
*2 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Bitcoin farm level 1]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Weapon box (5x5)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* On the round table of the conference room surrounded by large cat figurines on the 2nd level Recreation area (R21)
* In the conference room next to the gym, in the second last row of tables, next to a laptop
* On the servers in the Violet Keycard room
* On the shelf left side of dome top left shelf
* Various places in the ground floor working area

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the White King building as random loot on top the servers.
* Inside room [[RB-AK key|RB-AK]] on the Shelves.
* In [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]] marked room
* In [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]] marked room
* In the D2 tunnel, on top of the wooden crates, racks, and blades on the ground (room where the White Queen and Bunker tunnels meet)
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:VPX_Spawn_Reserve_D2.png
File:VPX_Spawn_Reserve_D2_02.png
</gallery></li>

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* Inside broken wooden boxes.
* On the Table with Laptops in the Southern Villa
*In the Water Treatment buildings
*In the buildings at the Lighthouse
*On the chair in the back of the drug lab
*In the bedside cabinet of [[Hillside house key|Hillside house]]
* In the courtyard of water treatment plant, in the tent with the APC as loose loot.
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Vpx.png|VPX as loose loot near the APC
</gallery></li>

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Huntsman Path - Woods Keeper]]
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Hunting Trip]]
* 3 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Snatch]]

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (VOG-17) is a [[Weapons#Fragmentation grenades|fragmentation grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The "Khattabka" hand-made hand grenade based on the VOG-17 grenade launcher shell. The grenade is a VOG-17 shell with a removed head part containing a detonator and self-destructor. A short fuse has been installed to speed up the ignition. An extremely deadly grenade.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (User) is a [[BattlePass]] document in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Documentation issued to every new TerraGroup employee upon signing. It contains both useful information and the obligatory, mind-numbing office rules like how to chip in for a coworker's birthday gift.

Can be found on:
* Ground Zero
* Streets of Tarkov
* The Lab

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

==Usage==
* Used to unlock rewards from the [[Seasons#Season 1: KORD BREACH|Season 1: KORD BREACH]] [[BattlePass]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Vaseline) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Vaseline, or, more precisely, petroleum jelly, is a versatile ointment used for a number of purposes where its water insulation and lubrication properties are required, for instance, treating small cuts and burns, coating corrosion-prone items or lubricating gear that requires non-acidic lubricants.

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Medcase]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Medical supply crate]]
*[[Jacket]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Virtex) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Specialized programmable military processor. The product is focused on high-latency broadband applications that require processing a large amount of data and minimal latency.

==Quests==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the quest [[From Hand to Hand]]
* 5 need to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Special Equipment]]

==Location==
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Dead Scav]]
* [[Weapon box (5x5)]]
* [[Ground cache]]
* [[Buried barrel cache]]

===[[The Lab]]===
Can be found in [[The Lab]] in the Main Working Area (O11), sitting on small pedestals in the assembly line (cage with an orange robotic arm) .
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:VirtexSpawn.png
File:VirtexLocation.png
</gallery></li>

===[[Reserve]]===
* In [[RB-AK key|RB-AK]]
* In [[RB-BK marked key|RB-BK]]
* In [[RB-PKPTS key|RB-PKPTS]]
* In [[RB-VO marked key|RB-VO]]
* In the White King building as random loot on top of the servers. 
* In the White King building on top of the wooden crates (2nd floor, with servers in the same room)
* In the D2 tunnel, on top of the wooden crates, racks, and blades on the ground (room where the White Queen and Bunker tunnels meet)
<li style="display: inline-block;"><gallery widths="300" heights="169" mode="packed">
File:Virtex-spawn-d2.png
File:Virtex-spawn-d2-another-spot.png
</gallery></li>

===[[Lighthouse]]===
* In the [[Merin car trunk key|Merin car trunk]].
* In a crate next to a crashed bus and blue car on the main road north-east of the Lighthouse.
* In the Usec Cottage Garage on the workbench under the fabric.
* In the [[Drug Trafficking|hidden drug lab]] on the armchair with a book.
* In a broken crate on the south center end of the train yard next to a semi-truck carrying a white shipping container. 
* In the [[Hillside house key|hillside house]], on the floor under the TV and in the sink
=====Stone Chalet=====
* On a flattened cardboard box in garage.
* On the kitchen table and chairs.
* On a body bag in an indoor pool on the bottom floor.
* On a wooden crate next to the outside stairs on the northwest side.
* On a wooden box in the attic
=====Water Treatment Plant=====
* In a small wooden crate on the southwest tower below a mounted grenade launcher.
* On a white workbench under the first green tent in the southwest part of the camp. 
* In a broken wooden crate with a fallen work light near the first green tent and a medical table. 
* On the ground next to a tank in the second green tent in the southwest part of the camp. 
* In a small wooden crate near the center of a water silo east of the second green tent. 
* In a small wooden crate inside a container next to the third green tent in the southwest part of the camp. 
* On a table on the roof of the large building in the south center of the camp. 
* In a broken wooden crate near the fourth green tent and an armored truck in the southwest part of the camp.
* In a broken crate next to some shipping containers south of Building 1 (West Building).
* In a broken crate next to a black car south of Building 1 (West Building).
* On some pallets in the southwest corner of Building 1 (West Building).
* In three spots inside the [[Operating room key|Operating Room]] in Building 1 (West Building).
* On a table in the middle medical room in the northwest corner of Building 1 (West Building).
* In a broken crate next to a forklift north of Building 1 (West Building).
* On a some boxes next to a white van north of Building 1 (West Building).
* In a broken crate in the center of Building 2 (North Building).
* On some medical boxes on the east side of Building 2 (North Building).
* In three spots inside the [[Water treatment plant storage room key|Water Treatment Plant Storage Room]] in Building 2 (North Building).
* Between two laptops in a room on the northeast side of Building 2 (North Building).
* A a table with injector props in a room on the northeast side of Building 2 (North Building).
* In Water Treatment Plant Building 3 in the broken crate on the walkway (East Building)
* In Water Treatment Plant Building 3 (East Building) as random loot by a projector

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Valuables (Rare)) is a [[Looting#Reward containers|Reward Loot Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
===Before Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Unlike cash, barter will always be viable, and the contents of this box may be more valuable than a few packs of crunchy paper. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

===After Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Unlike cash, barter will always be viable, and the contents of this box may be more valuable than a few packs of crunchy paper. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

==Notes==
* Can only be opened outside of a raid
** Must be un-locked at the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]] before it can be opened
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
* Only the locked version can be stashed in [[Lucky Scav Junk box]]

==Location==
* Possible reward from [[Ref]]'s daily and weekly quests for [[Arena]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Handdrill tool.png|frameless|link=Hand drill]] x1<br/>[[Hand drill]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Valuables crate Rare Icon.png|frameless|Locked Valuables crate (Rare)|link=Valuables crate (Rare)]] x1<br/>[[Valuables crate (Rare)|<font color="red">Locked</font> Valuables crate (Rare)]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]]</big><br/>1 minute
!<big>→</big>
![[File:Valuables crate Rare Icon.png|frameless|Unlocked Valuables crate (Rare)|link=Valuables crate (Rare)]] x1<br/>[[Valuables crate (Rare)|<font color="green">Unlocked</font> Valuables crate (Rare)]]
|}

==Loot Table==
The crate can contain various [[Loot#Valuables|valuables]], [[Loot#Info items|info items]], [[Keys & Intel|keys & keycards]] and [[GP coin]]s.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Voevoda) is an audio tape in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
This recording seems to capture one of Voevoda's reflections on the causes of the Tarkov conflict.

==Usage==
* Used in the story chapter [[Batya]]

==Content==
[[File:Voevoda's thoughts audio tape audio.mp3|282px]]

===Transcript===
Voevoda: Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.

Voevoda: The Bogatyrs got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.

Voevoda: This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…

Voevoda: People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it's very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls. It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…

Voevoda: What if it's the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?

Voevoda: I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.

[[Category:Audio tapes]]

[[ru:Аудиокассета с рассуждениями Воеводы]]

A durable and convenient waist pouch for a variety of things you would want to keep close.

==Notes== 
*Unlike other [[secure containers]], this one can be dropped in-raid
*Cannot be put inside of [[chest rigs]], [[backpacks]] or [[secure containers]]
* Can only fit:
** [[Documents case]]
** [[Dogtag case]]
** [[Gingy keychain]]
** [[Injector case]]
** [[Key tool]]
** [[Keycard holder case]]
** [[S I C C organizational pouch]]
** [[Simple wallet]]
** [[WZ Wallet]]
** [[Loot]]
** [[Provisions]]
** [[Medical|Meds]]
** [[Keys & Intel|Keys, Keycards & Maps]]
** [[Weapon mods]] (Besides magazines, special scopes and some mounts)
** [[Armor plates]]
** [[Currency]]
** [[Armbands]]
** [[Earpieces]]
** [[Face cover#Vanity|Vanity Face cover]]
** [[Headwear#Vanity|Vanity Headwear]]
** [[Eyewear#Vanity|Vanity Eyewear]]
** [[Weapons#Melee weapons|Melee weapons]]
** [[Loot#Special equipment|Special equipment]]

==Location==
*[[Hideout#Modules|Scav case]]

===[[Customs]]===
*"Old Gas Station":
**On the desk inside
**At the "giving tree" behind it

File:GivingTreeCustoms.png|Gas station and tree marked on map
</gallery></li>

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SLock) is a [[Headwear]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Skull Lock Head Mount-Lite is a lightweight, low profile fixing system for NVG or other optical attachments, completely made of fabric, with increased comfort and versatility in use and storage. The system allows the use of various attachments without the use of a heavy ballistic helmet.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Woods) is a [[Keys & Intel|map]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A paper plan map of Priozersk Natural Reserve.

==Notes==
* The map is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Wrench) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (WD-40) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Initially, this agent was developed for industrial consumers as an anti-corrosive water repellent. It was later discovered that it also has plenty of applications for domestic use. According to the producing company legend, the product formula was developed with the fortieth attempt (WD-40 as short for Water Displacement-40th Attempt). The product consists mostly of various hydrocarbon.

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Weapons) is a [[Containers|Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A storage case for weapons, ammunition, and weapon parts.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 50 inventory slots in a 5x10 grid and only takes up 10 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
*[[Weapons]] (Besides [[Weapons#Melee_weapons|melee]])
*[[Ammunition]]
*[[Weapon mods]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Xeno) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Xenomorph is a sealing foam with an excellent structure of cells and high mechanical strength. Easy to use, applied with a thin applicator tube. Foam is an expandable material that doubles its volume on solidification. Has excellent adhesion to most building materials such as wood, concrete, stone, metal, etc. This product does not contain any chloro-fluoro-carbon propellants. A reliable and cost-effective solution for sealing and filling the voids.

==Hideout==
* 1 needs to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Defective Wall level 6]]
* 6 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Lavatory level 3]]
* 5 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Weapon Rack level 1]]
* 5 need to be obtained for the [[Hideout#Modules|Hall of Fame level 2]]

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Toolbox]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Weapon repair kit) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

*Requires the [[Hideout]] module "Workbench" to be used
*Used to [[Item repair|repair]] weapons
*Cannot be used in raid
*Usage increases the [[Weapon Maintenance]] skill

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (WFilter) is an [[Loot|item]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A charcoal water filter used both in production in the food industry and at home. Designed to purify water from harmful impurities.

==Notes==
* Used to run the [[Hideout#Modules|water collector]]
* Can be removed once installed to not be used if module doesn't need to be active.
* The filter lasts for 8 hours, 12 minutes and 25 seconds.
** The equation to convert water filter durability into minutes is <code>4.92 × durability</code>.

==Location==
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Toolbox]]
*[[Dead Scav]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Technical supply crate]]

===[[Reserve]]===
* In the K Buildings
* In the underground, primarily in the area underneath of School and the long metal hallway leading up to the D-2 extract
* Inside the third floor of Queen

===[[Woods]]===
* In ZB-014
* In ZB-016

===[[Interchange]]===
* In OLI on shelves

===[[Customs]]===
* In the [[Dorm room 206 key|Dorm room 206]]
* In the backroom of green screen room in the [[USEC stash key|Repair Shop]]
* In the workshop room upstairs in the [[USEC stash key|Repair Shop]]
* In the warehouse next to ZB-1012 (warehouse 5) inside a shipping container on a wooden pallet

===[[Shoreline]]===
* On the shelf in the West Wing to the Health Resort broken wall entrance
* On the shelf in the bus depot in the back corner

==Quest rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[Operation Aquarius]]
* 2 can be obtained as a quest reward from [[The Survivalist Path - Zhivchik]].

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (xTG-12) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Removes most of the known poisons and toxins used in the combat industry. Can be used to relieve the effects of natural poisons. Gives immunity to poisoning while the components are in the blood system. Can reduce health status.

==Notes==
* Can be used in-raid to remove the effects of the [[Unknown toxin]] inflicted by the [[Cultists]] and barbed wire in [[The Labyrinth]]
* Only 10 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

==Location==
* [[Medbag SMU06]]
* [[Sport bag]]
* [[Weapon box (5x2)]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (WZ) is a [[Containers|container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The "WillerZ" leather wallet. Same as any simple wallet, but fancier.

==Info==
The {{PAGENAME}} is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 4 inventory slots in a 2x2 grid and only takes up 1 inventory slot itself. It can only store: 
* [[Currency]]
* [[Keys & Intel|Keycards]]

==Quests ==
* 1 needs to be found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] for the quest [[Collector]]

==Location==

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Weapons (Rare)) is a [[Looting#Reward containers|Reward Loot Container]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
===Before Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Contains ammunition, weapon mods, or even weapons if you're lucky. Everything you need to make your enemies respect you. But first, you need to find a way to open this box.

===After Unlocking===
A trophy for participating in Arena battles. Contains ammunition, weapon mods, or even weapons if you're lucky. Everything you need to make your enemies respect you. The lock has been crudely broken, which means there are no more obstacles between you and the contents of the box.

==Notes==
* Can only be opened outside of a raid
** Must be un-locked at the [[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]] before it can be opened
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market
* Destroyed after unpacking (Right-click "unpack")
* Only the locked version can be stashed in [[Lucky Scav Junk box]]

==Location==
* Possible reward from [[Ref]]'s daily and weekly quests for [[Arena]]

==Crafting==
{|class="wikitable"
|-
![[File:Handdrill tool.png|frameless|link=Hand drill]] x1<br/>[[Hand drill]]<br/>+<br/>[[File:Weapons crate Rare Icon.png|frameless|Locked Weapon crate (Rare)|link=Weapon crate (Rare)]] x1<br/>[[Weapon crate (Rare)|<font color="red">Locked</font> Weapon crate (Rare)]]
!<big>→</big>
!<big>[[Hideout#Modules|Workbench level 1]]</big><br/>1 minute
!<big>→</big>
![[File:Weapons crate Rare Icon.png|frameless|Unlocked Weapon crate (Rare)|link=Weapon crate (Rare)]] x1<br/>[[Weapon crate (Rare)|<font color="green">Unlocked</font> Weapon crate (Rare)]]
|}

==Loot Table==
The crate can contain various [[weapons]], [[Weapons#Throwable_weapons|grenades]], [[weapon mods]], [[ammunition]] and [[Helmet mods#Night_vision_devices|night vision devices]].

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (MP-443 Grach) is a [[Weapons#Pistols|pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
The PYa MP-443 (Pistolét Yarýgina MP-443 - "Yarygin Pistol MP-443", GRAU Index - 6P35) widely known as "Grach" is a Russian semiautomatic pistol chambered in 9x19 mm. It was designed by Vladimir Yarygin in the 1990s and adopted as a standard sidearm by the Russian military, law enforcement agencies, and special units of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. It features a high capacity magazine and can be equipped with the Zenit B-8 mount to install additional attachments beneath the barrel.

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Zarya) is a [[Weapons#Stun grenades|stun grenade]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
Intended to suppress the mental stability by creating a sudden sound effect and a bright flash. Used in special operations for apprehension of criminals and in riot suppression.

==Notes==
* When looking at the explosion, [[File:Stun.png|46px|Stun]] is added for 40 seconds, causing a blinding effect that starts to fade out after 20 seconds, as well as a visual impairment which lasts 90 seconds
* Within a 10m radius around the explosion, [[File:contusion.png|46px|Concussion]] is added for 20 seconds, causing tinnitus and muffled audio

==Location==
*[[Grenade box]]
*[[Wooden crate]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]
*[[Ground cache]]

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' (Zagustin) is a [[Medical]] item in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A military-issue drug. Inhibits activators of profibrinolysin and slows down its transformation in fibrinolysin. Temporarily stops the bleeding and increases resistance to bloodloss. Has side effects. Leads to severe dehydration.

==Location==
*[[Medbag SMU06]]
*[[Sport bag]]
*[[Weapon box (5x2)]]
*[[Ground cache]]
*[[Buried barrel cache]]

===[[The Lab]]===
* Laboratory experiment's area (G12) on the first level (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)]])
* Sanitar's room in the Laboratory block (G22) on the second level (Requires [[Keycard with a blue marking]])
* On the floor of the "Med Hut" on the main floor, first Level (O11)
* On the left hand table in the Laboratory quarantine zone (G11) (Requires [[TerraGroup Labs keycard (Blue)]])
* In the laboratories inside the containment block

The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (SP-81) is a [[Weapons#Signal pistols|signal pistol]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Description==
A smoothbore hand pistol designed for firing signal flare cartridges of various burning colors. Manufactured by V.A. Degtyarev Plant.

==Notes==
* Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
* Can be used to call in an [[airdrop]] when firing a [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Red)|red flare cartridge]].
* Can be used to open flare extractions when firing a [[26x75mm flare cartridge (Green)|green flare cartridge]].
* The pistol is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.
:[[File:Compass slot.jpg|frameless]]

==Quest Rewards==
* 1 can be obtained as a Quest Reward from [[Cease Fire!]]
